### P232 - FULLRES 50 MP ZSL: the memory budget before the N after the shutter, the ring frames kept (roadmap speed-ux A2)
- Evidence: owner's X7U log 2026-10-17 20:20:35.714 «50 MP ZSL: 5 ring frames + 7 N after the shutter» then «frames=14 (ZSL: N 1
  from the ring + 13 after the shutter) ... cut=memory»; ring frames kept per ZSL shot 1, 1, 1, 3, 1, 1, 2, 1, 6, 5 (test phone)
  and 1, 1, 5, 10 (owner), median 1. Cause: takeNativeZsl fixed the top-up (requested - ring) first, the budget
  (VivoSdkFullResCapture.zslNormals) then removed the oldest ring frames - the zero-lag ones.
- Now: takeNativeZsl returns the plan without N; captureVivoSdkFullResChecked asks the budget for the whole shot (max(ring,
  requested) N + the plan's ultrashort / long stills) and splits it with VivoSdkFullResCapture.zslSplit: the ring frames stay
  (only when even the extras do not fit do they go, the newest one always stays), the N after the shutter fill the rest up to the
  N asked. Log «50 MP ZSL: K of R ring frames + T N after the shutter (asked A, budget B frames); <plan>».
- Checked: FullResZslTest 11/11 (+1: the owner's case 5 ring / 6 extras / 14 budget -> 5 + 3; with A1's 2 extras 5 + 7; a tight
  budget drops after-press N first), VivoSdkFullResCaptureTest 17/17.
- Phone (not tested): «ZSL: N k from the ring» with k close to the ring size; fewer frames after the press, shorter hold.

### P233 - «Снято K из N кадров» counts the N the merge takes (roadmap speed-ux A5)
- Evidence: owner's shot 1 (X7U 2026-10-17 20:20:35) showed «Снято 1 из 12 кадров» while the worker merged 8 N («N frames 8 of
  8»): the toast's K was shotN, the ring's frames alone.
- Now: K = the ring's N + the N after the shutter (VivoSdkFullResCapture.zslTaken; the plan's ultrashort / bracketed stills are

  ring + s after the shutter, N t of them)». After the merge the worker's «HYBRID SERIES: merged … (N frames k of n)» still gives
  ScamHybridBurst.notice «Склеено k из n обычных кадров» when the worker merged fewer N than were sent (unchanged).
- Checked: FullResZslTest 12/12 (+1), ScamHybridBurstAnyResolutionTest 13/13.
- Phone (not tested): a memory-cut ZSL shot's toast K = the «N r from the ring» + «N t of them» of that line.

- Evidence: every ZSL shot sent «ScamZslCaptureStarted» (the instant UI: no capture ring, controls live) while the owner's 5

  onCaptureSequenceCompleted. Both ZSL routes use it (FULLRES 50 MP and the 12 MP Hybrid, whose plan stays <= 6: unchanged).

### P235 - FULLRES: the shot arena made at the press, the ring frames moved in while the stills arrive (roadmap speed-ux B3)
- Evidence: «HEX CLIENT PREP raw_write=606» (owner's X7U) / 903 ms (test phone): a 50 MP burst whose stills did not all fit the
  ring memfd's free slots (ZslRing.reserve gives what is free) had ring views and stills in two places, and
  ScamHybridBurst.moveIntoArena copied the whole burst into a new arena after the series, between the camera and the worker.
- Now (CaptureController.pressArena / pressArenaWanted, processing/RingArenaMove): when the reserved ring slots do not take every
  still (or a ring frame is not in the ring memfd) and the frames are above 16 MP, the shot gets its own ShotArena of ring + stills
  frames at the press; the stills are written straight into it (the saver's shotArena, as before), the FULLRES ring is released
  at the press (it takes no frame during the series and was released for the merge anyway, P200) and RingArenaMove copies the
  ring frames in on its own thread, one at a time under the frame's lock, each ring view freed after its copy (the released
  ring's slot pages are punched at once: the peak stays one frame above the burst, as moveIntoArena's). complete() waits for the
  move before the arena is released; failed() cancels it before the frames are discarded. A frame not moved (arena full /
  released, closed, another size) keeps its view and moveIntoArena moves the burst as before. Burst in one memfd already (the
  usual 12 MP and the PSL series that fit), 200 MP (own arena already), binning: unchanged. scam_dev fullres_press_arena 0 = as
  before (DevKeys). Log «FULLRES shot arena at the press: arena … for R ring frames + S stills (the ring's free slots held F)»,
  «FULLRES shot arena: R/R ring frames moved in T ms»; the merge's «hybrid burst moved into a shot arena» should be gone.
- Byte identity: the worker reads every frame at its own page of the memfd (NCH v12 header, pages from Allocator.arenaOf), the
  frames keep their bytes and order; only their slots differ. RingArenaMoveTest (new, CI) builds the burst both ways (the move
  after the series vs the press arena with the stills written concurrently from another thread) and compares the merge input
  byte for byte, plus each ring view freed once, a full / released arena leaving the rest in place, closed / odd frames skipped,
  cancel. FullResZslTest +1 (pressArenaWanted), DevKeysCoverageTest, ScamHybridBurstAnyResolutionTest, CameraResumeTest pass.
- Phone (not tested): raw_write in «HEX CLIENT PREP» drops by the move (~0.6 s on the X7U); no memory warnings during the series.

### P236 - shot timeline marks, one summary line per shot, the frames' release off the critical path (roadmap speed-ux B4 + F)
- Evidence (owner's X7U 2026-10-17 20:20:51): «reference RAW copied out of the shot arena» 51.832, «D/ImageFrame: Buffer is
  already null» 51.832, then nothing until «Alignment elapsed» 52.219: ScamProcessor closed the shot's frames there (the last
  views of a 50 MP arena: a punched hole per 96 MB slot, then the memfd's munmap / close giving back ~1.3 GB) before the post
  pipeline. The other part of the 0.4-0.6 s after «SCAM CAPTURE OK» is the client's output map (114 ms) and the reference copy.
- Now: ScamProcessor.releaseFrames closes the frames on one low-priority thread («shot frames released off the critical path: N
  frames, M MB in T ms») once the reference RAW is out; bursts of 16 MP or less and 200 MP shots (memory edge, P179) close in
  place as before; scam_dev release_async 0 = as before (DevKeys). Nothing reads the frames after the merge.
- ShotTimeline: marks series_done (FULLRES complete and the 12 MP path), arena_moved (P235's press arena or the merge's
  moveIntoArena), plain_ready (the plain session for the merge), w_detect («HYBRID MOSAIC: header block»), w_response /
  w_binning / w_merge (back from the native merge's «total … (before the merge P: pick a response b binning c, merge d, after it
  e)» line, the stage ends computed from the worker's own times), w_chroma (the chroma median line's end), ref_copy,
  post_compile (GLProg.takeProgramStats, with a note «post_compile_ms=compiled/ms+binaries bin/ms»); notes thermal_press /
  thermal_end (util/ThermalState: PowerManager thermal status name / headroom) and vf_fps_press / vf_fps_end (VfDrawMeter.fpsLast2s:
  the frames drawn in the last 2 s, recorded at every draw). The timeline line is printed in time order. Fix on the way: worker
  lines starting with 'S' were filtered out, so «SCAM STOCK MOTION» (w_align) and «SCAM CAPTURE OK» (w_ok) never marked.
  One line per shot «SHOT SUMMARY ms: hold= to_worker= merge= gap= post= save= total= <notes>» (-1: a stage the route does not
  have) in the log and, whatever the profiling switch, in Download/SCAMERA/SCAMERA-timings.txt (ScameraTimingLog.summary).
- Checked: ShotTimelineTest 4/4 (new, CI: the owner's total line parsed, the marks in order, the summary's fields, no timeline
  opened by a GL pass outside a shot), VfDrawMeterTest 2/2 (+1), ScameraTimingLogTest, DevKeysCoverageTest, FullResZslTest,
  GLProgramDiskCacheTest, ShotSpeedBitExactTest.
- Phone (not tested): «SHOT SUMMARY» per shot with gap close to the client's output map (~0.1 s) instead of 0.4-0.6 s; the
  release line after the post pipeline has started.

### P237 - the shader disk cache: counts, fsync, idle compile of missing programs (roadmap speed-ux B5)
- Evidence: the X7U compiled all 36 post-pipeline programs on its first shot (790 ms, owner's log 20:20:54) and again after the
  P211 reboot (746 ms, 20:44:41) although GLProgramDiskCache (P69) keeps their driver binaries; the X300U 493 ms. The P211 reboot
  was a kernel panic: binaries written by the writer thread were still in the page cache. The cache said nothing about hits.
- Now: each binary (and source) file is fsync'ed before its rename; the cache counts hits / misses / damaged / written / evicted,
  and «runAll programs: N compiled in X ms, M from driver binaries in Y ms (disk H hit / M miss / D damaged / W written / E
  evicted)» says it per shot (GLProg.takeProgramStats). Every compiled program's cache key (its source) is kept driver-independent
  as gls-<sha>.src (LRU, 160 files / 16 MB, touched on every hit); GLProg.warmUp compiles, in its own 1x1 context on a
  background thread, the kept sources whose binary this driver lacks (a driver update, an evicted or lost binary), at most 64,
  stopping between programs when a shot starts. CaptureController.scheduleProgramWarmUp runs it once per process 4 s after a
  session opened when the camera is idle (no shot, nothing processing, no FULLRES merge); scam_dev gl_warm_up 0 = off (DevKeys).
  Log «program warm-up: K of N missing binaries compiled in idle time in T ms». A first install has no kept sources: its first
  shot still compiles (the defines of the post pipeline come from the shot).
- Checked: GLProgramDiskCacheTest 5/5 (+2: counts, the missing sources of a new driver, a damaged source deleted), DevKeysCoverageTest,
  CameraResumeTest, ShotTimelineTest.
- Phone (not tested): after an app update / reboot the first shot's line shows «0 compiled ... 36 from driver binaries», the
  warm-up line once per start when something was missing.

### P238 - thermal awareness: the state at the press and the merge end, a policy at SEVERE (roadmap speed-ux D2)
- Evidence: the app never read the thermal state; ColorOS force-stopped it for heat mid-merge (P200, «o-stop(22)», 53 °C) while
  the FULLRES session developed and ringed 96 MB frames at 24 fps; P200's open question (GPU throttling or the low priority) had
  no data.
- Now: util/ThermalState (PowerManager.getCurrentThermalStatus, getThermalHeadroom(0) at most once a second) is logged
  «THERMAL at the press: <status>/<headroom>» (SCAM_CAPTURE) and «THERMAL at the merge end: …» (SCAM_HDR, also the timeline note
  thermal_merge_end; P236's thermal_press / thermal_end are in the SHOT SUMMARY). util/ThermalPolicy follows the platform's
  thermal listener (registered once per process at the first session; «THERMAL status a -> b» lines) and every press's sample.
  At SEVERE or worse: the developed RAW viewfinder publishes at most 15 frames a second (ThermalPolicy.viewfinderFrameDue: every
  second frame of a 30 fps stream; the AE, the ring and the stream still see every frame; the ISP preview's texture draw is
  left alone - its buffers must flow back to the camera); the FULLRES ring pauses («50 MP ZSL ring paused: the phone is hot
  (thermal status SEVERE)», its frames dropped so no stale frame becomes a ZSL frame; a press takes the series after the
  shutter; «… runs again» after); a FULLRES press shows «Телефон горячий — 50 Мп будет дольше» (the shot's megapixels; at most once
  in 5 min). scam_dev thermal_policy 0 = log only (DevKeys).
- Checked: ThermalPolicyTest 4/4 (new, CI: no cap below SEVERE, 15 of 30 fps at SEVERE, the notice once in 5 min, the status
  names), DevKeysCoverageTest, CameraResumeTest, FullResZslTest, NativeViewfinderTest, ScamHybridBurstAnyResolutionTest;
  check_ui_language PASS.
- Phone (not tested): the THERMAL lines per shot; a hot phone (or `adb shell cmd thermalservice override-status 3`, a system
  setting change the owner does himself) shows the viewfinder at ~15 fps in VF_DRAW, the ring pause line and the notice.

### P239 - the FULLRES ring copies 8-12 frames a second and rests on a still, untouched phone (roadmap speed-ux D1)
- Evidence: ringCopyDue only waits twice the last copy's time; with 7-10 ms copies every frame went into the 50 MP ring (150
  copies in 6.35 s, ~23.6 a second x 96 MB = 2.3 GB/s) for a ring of 3-10 slots; ColorOS already killed the app for heat (P200).
- Now (capture/FullResRingPolicy): at most 12 copies a second (rateDue: every 2nd frame of 24 / 20 fps, every 3rd of 30), and the
  ring rests after 10 s with no touch-down / key on the camera screen (CameraActivity.onUserInteraction) and the gyro still for
  as long (Gyro.getFilteredShakiness below the tripod threshold 25): its frames go (P238's pause path: «50 MP ZSL ring paused: no
  touch for 10 s and the phone still»), a touch or a moving gyro starts it again («… runs again»). scam_dev fullres_ring_fps
  (1-30, 0 = every frame as before) and fullres_ring_idle_s (0 = never rests), DevKeys. The ring copy line says «at most 12 a
  second».
- Default on, decided from the merge's frame selection (selectHybridRing / drainZslNormalFrames): frames 83-100 ms apart stay far
  inside its stale gap (ZSL_RING_MAX_GAP_NS 500 ms), the exposure-tier and crop rules do not depend on the rate, the ring keeps
  its slots (the same candidates once it ran slots / 12 s: <= 1 s for the 50 MP ring's <= 10 frames), and a press while the ring is
  short (just after an AE change, a resume) takes the missing N after the shutter (P232's split): the merge's N count is
  unchanged. What changes: the ring's N span about twice the time (10 frames: ~0.8 s instead of ~0.4 s) - more hand motion
  between them for the alignment / rejection; a press right after a rest is a PSL series. Both to check on the phone.
- Checked: FullResRingPolicyTest 2/2 (new, CI: 12 of 24, 10 of 30, 10 of 20 fps, 0 = every frame; rest / wake by touch and
  motion, 0 = never), DevKeysCoverageTest, CameraResumeTest, FullResZslTest, ZslRingBudgetTest.
- Phone (not tested): «50 MP ZSL ring: copy … (N frames this session …)» grows ~12 a second (was ~24); the battery current_now
  and the temperature against the old build; HYBRID rejection counts and photos of handheld 50 MP ZSL shots with
  fullres_ring_fps 0 vs default (A/B); the pause / resume lines on a phone lying on a table.

### P240 - «Камера перезапускается…» during a camera recovery; an untested route says «experimental» on its first use (roadmap speed-ux C4)
- Evidence: the X300U 200 MP attempt (older build): error 4, then 7 retries of 700 ms, the viewfinder frozen 7.4 s (21:41:34 ->

  ещё не проверено на телефоне. Если снимок не выйдет — выключите «vivo_fullres200_stock» в «Для разработчика»» on the message
  card; log «experimental route p208_stock_200mp: first use».
- Checked: ExperimentalRoutesTest 1/1 (new, CI), CameraResumeTest 24/24, LangTest, MessageCardTest; check_ui_language,

- Phone (not tested): a HAL error (or a camera switch into a failing module) shows the overlay until the viewfinder runs again;

### P241 - diagnostics: a «DIAG» badge, off by itself after 24 h, the dumps written off the processing thread (roadmap speed-ux C6)
- Evidence: with diagnostics each shot writes 5 SCAM_DIAG dumps; on the X300U debug log (08:56:53-57) a 12 MP shot took 5.6 s
  against 3.0-3.6 s without (x300u_log.txt 21:41); timing complaints may come from diagnostics sessions nobody remembered.
- Now: ScamDiagnostics.buffer samples the stage on the calling thread (its own copy) and writes the PFM, the PNG (compress 100)
  and stages.txt on the single «SCAM-diagnostic-export» thread, in order with the ZIP export (queue 32; full: written in place as
  before). ScamDiagnostics.gpu reads the sampled rows through a pixel pack buffer, 64 rows per fill and one map each (11 waits for
  a 50 MP stage instead of 682 per-row readbacks); the same rows and pixels, any GL error falls back to the row-by-row read. The
  photo is not touched (the dumps only read).
- settings/DiagnosticsAutoOff: the stored switch (pref_scam_hybrid_diagnostics, legacy pref_scamhdr_diagnostics) goes off 24 h
  after the camera first saw it on (the time in prefs file scam_diag; a clock set back starts the 24 h again), said on the card
  «Диагностика выключена: прошло 24 часа (она замедляет каждый снимок)», log «diagnostics switched off: on for 24 h». A scam_dev
  hybrid_diagnostics line is left alone. CameraFragment shows «DIAG» (res diag_badge, amber on a dark plate, top left of the
  viewfinder) while the stored switch or the scam_dev line is on; checked at every camera start (onCharacteristicsUpdated).
- Checked: DiagnosticsAutoOffTest 2/2 (new, CI), SettingsMenuTest, HybridSettingsTest, SettingsAuditFixTest; check_ui_language,
  check_settings_model PASS.
- Phone (not tested): the badge with «Диагностика» on; the 12 MP shot time with diagnostics against without (SHOT SUMMARY); the
  ZIP still complete (stages.txt, the PNG / PFM of each stage).

### P242 - scam_dev worker_gpu_normal_priority: the merge worker's GPU priority for an A/B (roadmap speed-ux B6)
- Evidence: the app's merge took 0.86-1.15 s a frame, the P204 replay ~0.63 s; during a FULLRES merge the viewfinder is the cheap
  ISP one (displaying=ISP), so P57's low-priority worker contexts (scam-superres-gpu.h scamProcessingContext,
  EGL_IMG_context_priority LOW unless SCAM_GPU_NORMAL_PRIORITY is set) may only slow the merge down.
- Now: util/WorkerEnv builds the worker's environment (WorkerSpawn.environment, the merge and the GPU prewarm) and adds
  SCAM_GPU_NORMAL_PRIORITY=1 with scam_dev worker_gpu_normal_priority 1 (DevKeys, «Склейка Hybrid (воркер)»; default 0 = low, as
  since P57). Each job logs «WORKER GPU priority: low (EGL_IMG_context_priority, P57 default) | normal (scam_dev
  worker_gpu_normal_priority 1)» into the worker report, and the SHOT SUMMARY note w_gpu_priority=low|normal sits beside the
  thermal state (P238) and the merge time. The worker source is unchanged (it read the variable already); results are
  unchanged (a scheduling hint).
- Checked: WorkerEnvTest 1/1 (new, CI: the environment as before P242, one variable more with the key), DevKeysCoverageTest,
  WorkerWatchdogTest, ScamHybridBurstCrashTest.
- Phone (A/B, not run): the same scene 3x with the key 0 and 3x with 1 - «HYBRID STAGES ms: merge=», «SHOT SUMMARY … merge=»,
  thermal_merge_end and VF_DRAW during the merge; keep the default unless the merge is clearly faster without a stutter.

### P243 - «DNG colour = JPEG»: the DNG carries the JPEG's white balance and colour matrix (the P221 follow-ups, defined from the code)
- What was planned: nothing - no P221 entry in PLAN.md, no «P221» / «DNG colour» / «native colour pass» in the code or the
  research notes of this tree. Defined here from the code:
  - «DNG colour = JPEG»: DngCreator wrote the camera's static dual-illuminant profile (SENSOR_COLOR_TRANSFORM1/2, FORWARD_MATRIX1/2,
    CALIBRATION_TRANSFORM1/2) with AsShotNeutral = Parameters.whitePoint, while the JPEG renders with whatever Parameters chose:
    the ISP's colour transform of the result (vivo: the DNG matrices are generic, «Using the ISP colour transform»), the OPPO tuned
    forward matrix per CCT (OppoTunedColor), the plain-session matrix of a mosaic shot (PlainColourMemory), a DCP (DcpProfiles), or
    the DNG interpolation itself - only the last matched Lightroom / ACR. Implemented below.
  - «native colour passes»: the worker's native mosaic merge switches the colour-difference, clip-border (rim) and Bento colour
    passes off («HYBRID MOSAIC NATIVE: colour-difference, clip-border and Bento colour passes off (they work on the binned frames;
    native variants not built)», scam-hybrid.h). Native variants of them change every FULLRES / ISZ photo and can only be judged on
    the owner's photos with replays and new reference md5s; not implemented here (left as a plan item: build them behind a default-off
    tuning key, replay the syn_b* / x7u / hand / isz2 series, compare photos, then decide the default).
- Now (processing/color/DngColour): the JPEG's linear render of a camera value c is intermediateToSRGB · sensorToProPhoto · c
  (why/low.glsl, combine.glsl); with the render's own XYZ -> sRGB (Converter.sXYZtoSRGB, D50-adapted) the DNG's tags are
  ForwardMatrix1 = sRGB->XYZ · intermediateToSRGB · sensorToProPhoto · diag(n), scaled to Y(FM · 1) = 1, and ColorMatrix1 =
  diag(n) · FM^-1 · Bradford(scene light (Parameters.sceneCct, CIE daylight / Planckian locus) -> FM · 1), one illuminant (label 21
  written for both CalibrationIlluminant tags), no ColorMatrix2 / ForwardMatrix2 / CameraCalibration: a raw converter has nothing to
  interpolate and renders FM · diag(1/AsShotNeutral) - the JPEG's colour; the temperature readout follows the scene light. The «Цвет»
  look's white matrix (warmth / tint) and the tone are not camera colour and stay out. ScamProcessor sets Parameters.dngColour
  for its DNG writes (the merged DNG and the reference RAW), DngCreator writes it and logs «DNG: the JPEG's colour: CM1 … FM1 …
  (FM white xy …), illuminant 21, single»; not usable matrices -> the camera's profile with a warning. scam_dev dng_colour_jpeg 0 =
  the camera's profile as before (DevKeys). The gallery's DngPreview (FM1 · diag(AsShotNeutral^-1)) shows the same colour.
- Checked: DngColourTest 4/4 (new, CI: the ISP-matrix case renders the JPEG's colour through the DNG model for four camera
  values, white stays D50; the DNG-interpolation case gives back its normalised forward matrix; CM1 · XYZ(scene) = the neutral
  at 2856 / 4300 / 6504 K; the D65 / A locus points; the guards), DngMetadataTest, DngPreviewTest, ParametersHandSetWbTest,
  OutputColourTest, DevKeysCoverageTest.
- Phone (not tested): open a vivo / OPPO FULLRES and a 12 MP DNG in Lightroom / ACR with the «Embedded» profile, «As Shot» white
  balance, beside the JPEG (no tone: compare the colour of neutrals and skin, not the contrast); the log line per DNG.

### P244 - import of a camera's linear tone curve (owner, 2026-10-18: ToneCurve_imx06A.txt, «Добавь поддержку такого формата кривых нам»)
- The file: 128 pairs x0, y0, x1, y1 ... as a bare comma list, x 0..1 in steps of 1/127 - vivo's DNG ProfileToneCurve for the
  IMX06A (the tag is in vivo's camera, evidence/vivo_camera_2026-10-13/dexstrings.txt), which the DNG specification gives «in
  linear gamma»: linear in, linear out.

  words); fromLinearCurve turns it into our curve (x = 0.5 + EV / 10 around linear 0.18, y = sRGB display): sampled every 0.03 of
  x up to the curve's white (linear 1 = +2.47 EV), flat above. ToneCurve_imx06A puts middle grey at y 0.571. Import and the
  ToneCurves folder listing take it through fromFileText. Test: ToneCurveTest.aCamerasLinearToneCurveFile (the owner's file in
  test resources).
- Phone (not tested): the look of the imported curve against vivo's own JPEG.

### P250 - the diffusion filters as a physical model (owner, 2026-10-18: «Посмотри как симуляция сделана ... и исправь у нас»)
- Before: the light above a knee spread by a fixed six-level Gaussian PSF, plus a separate lift and veil - a threshold edge,
  a look that changed with the frame's level, and no colour structure in the halo.
- DONE 2026-10-18: DiffusionModel - a share p of all the light (from the filter grade: our strength 0.5 = grade 1/2) spread by
  the filter's PSF, energy kept: out = (1 - p) E + p (K * E). K = core + halo + bloom, each a geometric range of 2D
  exponentials (the bloom with a power-law tail); sizes in micrometres of a 36 mm frame (the same share of the frame at any
  resolution); the halo tinted by moving warm light to its rim and cool light to its core without adding energy. Families:
  Glimmerglass, Black Pro-Mist, Pearlescent, CineBloom, Fog, Double Fog. Fine controls: «Ореол» the halo's share, «Радиус» the
  size, «Дымка» the bloom's share, «Тон свечения» the warmth. On the GPU / CPU the PSF is a sum of the image's own pyramid
  levels (to ~2 px) with per-channel non-negative weights fitted to its encircled energy (photo: gaussdown + B-spline widths;
  viewfinder: the mip pyramid's); Glimmerglass keeps its short star, Pearlescent its pastel; no exposure dependence left.
- Tests: DiffusionModelTest (grade table, warm halo energy, fit within 1 % encircled energy, size invariance), LensFiltersTest
  (energy kept exactly, the glow falls off, the controls), LiveLensFilterTest. Phone: OPPO viewfinder / photo, see below.

  rows stay live with the switch off.

### P268 - the 2x2 / 4x4 grid and the highlight artefacts of the mosaic merges (owner, 2026-10-19, X200 Ultra 10:04-10:05 shots + 4 bursts: «нужно исправить сетку на 2x2 4x4 ... особенно она заметна на сверхширике»; 2x crops with ragged clip borders; «нам нужно чтобы таких артефактов не было и без бенто, причём в любом режиме»; «никогда не было фиолетовых засветов»; «С баером тоже не должно быть артефактов»)

- Cause of the grid: the IMX06C (wide cam 4 and main cam 3, sensor mode 3, Quad) has one microlens per 2x2 block: each site
  class's response changes smoothly over the field (wide: -16..+16 % from corner to corner, main ~1.4 % rms), and the merge
  corrected it with ONE gain set per class: a 4 px hatch whose phase flips across the frame (JPEG: period-4 diagonal peaks 170-220x
  the background on the wide, 11x on the main; HP9 tele fine).
- Done (7a998ea4, 12c24b88, local): HybridGainField - the robust estimate also sums its tiles per zone (24 across the longer side),
  a second pass with that field divided out and the strict tile test, each class a cubic of the zone position fitted with Tukey
  weights (scene-biased zones drop out), applied only where it differs from the global set by more than 1 % rms (else the merge is
  bit for bit as before). Applied on the GPU (kHybNatAccess / kHybNatMark natGainAt, binding 19, bilinear between zone centres)
  and in the CPU binning (native and the sub-frame split; per row once for all frames). Tuning mosaicGainField 1, mosaicGainZones 24.
  Replays (OPPO, worker on the owner's bursts): wide grid tiles median 256 -> 20-31, p90 940 -> 72-136; main 22 -> 15, max 1006 -> 332;
  tele 4x Tetra p90 25 -> 10; tele 2x Quad (0.40 %) and every OPPO / synthetic series (<= 0.63 %) unchanged; cost +0.3 s response.
- Done: the mosaic paths' ultrashort check measures on smooth tiles (hybridMeasuredGain smooth): the main 2x burst's three
  ultrashort frames were refused at a MAD of 16.8 % (median 1.2 % from the metadata; hand shake on textured tiles), so no Bento and
  every highlight stayed clipped. Now Bento applies there (mosaicUsSmooth 1; the plain path unchanged).
- Done: a clipped sample is a lower bound in the native mosaic merges (kHybMergeMosaic / Fast, not kHybMergeMain1): a pixel whose
  own sites clipped took the mean of its dark neighbours (G 0.90 -> 0.45 -> 1.00 across a screw head: the dark dots / ragged
  borders of the 2x crops, also without Bento). Now max(unclipped mean, mean with the clipped samples at their clip).
- Done: scamrgb.glsl never makes a censored G end below both R and B (magenta) - G is raised to min(R, B) by its censoring weight.
- Checks: tools/check_gain_field.cpp (smooth field found within 0.65 %, uniform set / gratings / biased zones: no field; in CI),
  check_dng_ceiling, check_highlight_* (scene C: G clipped in the ultrashort under a blue sky), replays md5: plain series identical
  (syn_b1, x7u_1x, hh_1, zip), mosaic series change only near clipped samples (hand: 14403 px, 0.007 max away from clip flags).
- Phone: OPPO 50 MP Quad before / after (31127 / 31128, same scene): magenta highlight pixels 590 -> 186 (> 8), 21 -> 0 (> 16),
  the speckle inside the clipped windows gone. Not yet shot on the X200 Ultra.
- Open (P269): a 12 MP plain Bayer shot on a resting phone (no shifts between frames) keeps orange / blue dashes along slanted bright
  edges, inside the Bento mask where G clipped even in the ultrashort (the Bento colour pass skips any window with a clipped G)
  and outside it (single-frame demosaic false colour).

### P269 - the Bento mask and its processing (owner, 2026-10-19: «Займись затем маской бенто, нужно улучшить маску бенто и её обработку»)

- Start from P268's open item: the orange / blue dashes along a slanted sill edge (OPPO 12 MP, 2026-10-19 11:40, burst kept as
  scam_burst-20261019-114017.bin): kHybBento returns when its wide window holds any clipped ultrashort G; rebuild the colour from
  the unclipped real-site ratios there (as kHybRim does), and look at the mask edge (bentoNearClip, dilate, smooth) for steps.

- Owner: «Посмотри как работает маска бенто в Why кам и посмотри как можно улучшить нашу». Comparison (agent, from
  research/lmc/audit/part2_bento.md + errata v4.1, research/why12, why23/quad_report.md; notes in the session scratchpad
  bento_research/notes.md): LMC 9.6 / WhyCam v1.23 = replacement (rej *= 1 - mask for every frame but the ultrashort, the
  ultrashort's map = the mask), mask from a ramp 0.98..1 on the base RGB max, binary dilation r 4, Gaussian sigma 1, the ultrashort
  rendered ALIGNED (biquadratic) before the error test, the mask read bilinearly in the merge; the standalone WhyCam app: a soft
  mask from 0.88 (smoothstep 0.88..0.98, max-dilation, a soft near-clip product 0.70..0.88), the short frames on a wider kernel
  (G 1.26 / RB 1.50 px) and a highlight chroma dezipper (3x3 bilateral of R-G, B-G inside the mask).
- Done (local): bentoSubpixel 1 - the ultrashort check reads the aligned position bilinearly (LMC) instead of the nearest cell:
  invalid cells wide Quad 148 -> 101, main inpaint hole 1 -> 0, the tele / OPPO bursts unchanged.
- Not taken: the mask's bilinear read and the per-colour ultrashort kernel live in kHybMergeMain1 (never edited: any edit of the
  merge program made it ~15x slower on Adreno 750); the soft 0.88 mask lets the x8-noisier ultrashort replace unclipped bright areas
  (skies at 0.9 of the clip) - worse noise there; the 3x3 dezipper does not reach the OPPO sill dashes (they alternate along a line

### P274 - ISZ does not work on the X300 Ultra (owner, 2026-10-19, log-2026-10-19_2, build 31093: «isz не работает на X300 Ultra ... должен быть доступен просто через реквест vivo.control.forceSensorMode»): done, pushed.
Cause: every ISZ session streamed a plain Bayer at the normal sensor mode index 2 (the result key), «камера не включила ISZ-режим».
vivo.control.forceSensorMode (0x811b0126) is in the camera's android.request.availableSessionKeys (x300u_camera.txt), and the
camera service compares the session keys of every request with the session parameters: a request without the key removes it
and reconfigures the session at the normal mode. We sent it on the session only («no request copy», P214i). Fix:
VivoQcomIsz.sessionBuilt / mirrorRequest - the forceSensorMode of the session parameters (ISZ module or DCG) is repeated on every
request (VendorTagUtils.builderSessionApply); the old trials (BAYER notes) are void (stamp "#req"). Test VivoQcomIszTest
sessionModeIsRepeatedOnEveryRequest; CI list 252 classes / 1533 tests pass. Not device-tested: check «4.8×» / «9.6×» / DCG
on the X300 Ultra (log: «X300 Ultra camera 5 sensor mode: vivo.control.forceSensorMode 5 on the session and on every request»,
«sensor mode index 2 -> 5»).

the mosaic on the default stream), old notes void (stamp "#lease"); (2) the vivo SDK lease of FULLRES (VivoCameraManager 33 = 2

### P277 - «Гайд и лаборатория»: the settings shown on the owner's own RAW series (owner, 2026-10-19: «гайд как небольшое приложение в котором всё будет полноценно показано ... чтобы в приложение можно было подгрузить например свою Рав серию»; «тогда лучше всё-таки встроить в наше приложение»; «Может мы сделаем отдельный тогл специально для этого раздела?»; «Сохранять будем в /storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/Lab и разделять по дате и времени по папкам»; «нам нужно чтобы было наглядно видно что и как работает, те же настройки склейки и тд чтобы можно было понять разницу»): done, local commit, not device-tested.
Capture: «Сохранять снимки для лаборатории» (pref_scam_lab_keep; the lab page and Diagnostics) keeps each SHDR shot in
Download/SCAMERA/Lab/yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss (ScamLab): burst.nch = the worker's input copied by the worker's keep-burst marker (the
lab's folder wins over keep_burst), its header's merged-DNG and diagnostics flags cleared at the end of the shot; meta.json = the
post pipeline's Parameters right before the post pipeline (ScamLabParams, reflection over the plain fields + CCT + noise model;
the shot's metadata path needs the live CaptureResult), the worker tuning (settings' part and the burst's own lines apart), every
default preference typed, sizes, lastNormals, and "orient" - how the photo lies over the sensor frame, found by correlating the
worker RGB's luma with the photo (ScamLabOrient, 8 codes); preview.jpg (1600 px, the pipeline output before the zoom / ISZ crops).
An incomplete folder (failed merge, DNG-only shot) is removed. ScamLab.LOCK: a shot's processing and a lab run never overlap.
Replay (ScamLabRun): ScamLabBurst (a ScamTransport from the file: whole = the file's fd mapped by the worker, or a fragment =
a v11 transport of a 32-aligned window of every frame), the job's ScamHybridBurst-only branches now interface methods
(hybrid, rgbHalfTransport, creOff, settingsTuning, burstTuning, keepable); while a side runs PreferenceValue.overlay makes the
default preferences read as the shot's snapshot (+ the tried value for B), so the tuning, the denoise, tone, colour, sharpening
take the side's value. A merge setting (B's tuning differs) merges again; A of a shot and fragment is cached. The fragment gets
its lens-shading map cropped (RawCrop.cropGainMap), its size and final size. PostPipeline.getRotation no longer needs an open camera.
UI (ScamLabFragment, settings root «Гайд и лаборатория»): the shots (thumbnail, device, size, frames, file size; hold to delete),
a shot's page (the photo with the fragment, tap to move it; 1/9, 1/4, whole frame; the groups SHDR photo / sharpening / tone /
merge, style, LUT, lens filters, colour fine), a group's settings with the value at the shot, a value sheet (switch: the other
state; list; slider), and the comparison (LabCompareView): before / after with a draggable border, double tap x3, pinch, a held
magnifier; «Разница ×4»; «Карта кадров» (the worker's effective-frame map of A and B, few frames dark blue -> twice the median
yellow); the times, whether the merge ran again, «A и B совпадают до пикселя» with why; «Другое значение», «Сохранить B в
настройки». Tests ScamLabOrientTest, ScamLabBurstTest, ScamLabParamsTest. Not device-tested: the capture, the replay, the UI.
To check on the phone: switch on, an SHDR shot -> Lab/<date_time> with three files (log «SCAM_LAB: lab shot kept», «photo over
the sensor frame: code N»); the lab page lists it; a merge setting (e.g. a rejection strength) and a processing one (sharpening)
on the 1/9 fragment; the frame map; the fragment lies where it is on the photo.
P277 round 2 (owner, 2026-10-19, screenshots + video): (1) «при любом кропе экспозиция и тон считались по всему кадру» -
LabFrame: the shot's pipeline records the whole frame's statistics (WhyAe stats of every metering mode, the gain clamp's noise
scale, whyLow width, ScamRgb clip levels, the denoise's p50 / p90, the lens-shading term, the lens filter's level and size) in
frame.json; a fragment run uses them (PostPipeline.frozen) and still decides exposure / tone with each side's settings; a shot
without frame.json gets one whole-frame run first. (2) both A and B have their own control on the comparison page (switch,
list, slider; «как снято»), only the changed side renders again, the last result stays on screen while it does. (3) the border
belongs to the screen (zoom / pan never move it off). (4) the tone curve, the LUT and the lens filter are comparable (LINKS:
curve + its switch, LUT + strength, filter + strength; the curve «как сейчас в настройках» with «Изменить в настройках»).
(5) a fourth area, 1/16. Test LabFrameTest.

### P280 - our DNGs do not open in Lightroom (owner, 2026-10-19 screenshot: «Похоже, что файл имеет недопустимый или поврежденный формат», 0 x 0, no EXIF): done, not device-tested in Lightroom.
A DNG of build 31127 (OPPO, SCA_20261019_102218) checked with a strict TIFF / DNG walker: ColorMatrix2, ForwardMatrix2 and
CameraCalibration1 / 2 all zero (a single-illuminant profile written as two, CalibrationIlluminant2 = 1's), AsShotWhiteXY (0, 0)
beside AsShotNeutral, WhiteLevel a RATIONAL (the spec: SHORT or LONG), and every value outside the IFD, the strip and the IFD at
odd offsets (TIFF word-aligns them). The gain-map opcodes parse fine. Fixed in dngCreator.cpp (only usable matrices; the second
illuminant only with its own valid matrix; calibration only when non-zero; AsShotWhiteXY only without AsShotNeutral) and in
tiny_dng_writer.h (WhiteLevel LONG; a pad byte before an odd position and after an odd length of any value, of the strip).
tools/check_dng_memory.cpp now also walks the file (IFDs, values, strip at even offsets, tags ascending, WhiteLevel's type) with
an odd-length value and an odd strip; built with the NDK and run on the OPPO: six files valid.

### P281 - film simulation (owner, 2026-10-19: screenshots of a film-stock / print / format app; «реализуй это у нас, но не копируй один в один, сделай по-своему»; the same settings structure as the LUTs and the filters; the reference is not to be named in the changelogs): done, not device-tested.
Our own model (processing/color/FilmSim, no code or data of the reference: its code is GPL, its data CC BY-SA): the display
colour back to scene light (mid grey 0.18, the tone's shoulder undone, shadow stops x0.62), three film layers exposed through
Gaussian spectral sensitivities over a partition-of-unity spectrum of the sRGB primaries (35 % of the spectral overlap kept: the
masking / DIR correction), a characteristic curve per layer (difference of two softplus terms, mid grey at the stock's mid
density), an interlayer effect on the log-exposure scale that keeps the neutral scale, dye bands with side absorptions on the
base (the negative's orange mask), printing with a 3200 K lamp onto the paper's three narrow sensitivities balanced on mid grey
(print exposure, tone), the paper's curve and dyes, viewed under D65 (CIE 1931 as the Wyman-Sloan-Shirley lobes, XYZ -> sRGB),
paper white as white, a grey balance over the neutral scale; slides and B&W reversal projected, B&W one silver layer. 20 stocks
(Portra 160/400/800, Gold 200, UltraMax 400, Ektar 100, C200, X-TRA 400, Pro 400H, Vision3 50D/250D/500T, E100, Velvia 50,
Provia 100F, Kodachrome 64, Tri-X 400, T-Max 100, HP5, Tri-X 7266), 7 prints (Endura Premier, Ultra Endura, Ektacolor Edge,
Portra Endura, Crystal Archive, Vision 2383 / 2393), 9 formats (off, 8 mm 4.8, Super 8 5.79, 16 mm 10.26, Super 16 12.52, Super
35 24.89, 35 mm 36, 645 56, 6x7 70). A 33^3 LUT in ~65 ms (PC); FilmChain bakes the simulation then the chosen LUT into the one
table WhyCombine (FILM_LUT) and both viewfinders apply. Effects on the GPU in micrometres of film / frame pixel size:
FilmHalation (linear light before the tone: the image's gaussdown pyramid around 65 um still / 50 um cine, three bounces, energy
kept, R > G > B by the antihalation), FilmGrain (after the final resize: film MTF blur, grain by Selwyn's law from the stock's RMS
at the larger of the pixel and the grain, through the print's contrast, tonal weight, layers partly shared, blue coarser).
UI: «Плёночная симуляция» page (FilmSimPreference: preview on the samples, tabs Плёнка / Печать / Формат / Эффекты: grain,
halation, softness, film exposure, print exposure, print tone, strength), the viewfinder tray's film row (after the filters), the
pill names the stock; the lab compares every film setting. Tests FilmSimTest (every stock x print: monotonic neutral grey scale,
mid grey, hues kept, B&W grey, LUT time, the chain, grain vs format). Not on the phone yet: the look, the grain size, the
halation; the viewfinder shows the colour and tone only.

### P282 - single-frame remosaic where the donors were rejected (owner, 2026-10-19: «улучшить ремозаик для однокадра sabre чтобы улучшить движение в случае реджекта для quad и quad quad, заодно и для bayer»; WhyCam 1.70 / 1.71 shown as the example): Quad and Tetra pushed in 52adf573; Bayer done locally.
A pass after the native fast merge (NAT_DEMOSAIC program of kHybMergeMosaicFast; kHybMergeMain1 untouched): where the donors'
accepted frames F are below the widening's K the output takes t = baseDemosaic (1 - smoothstep(0, K, F)) of the base frame's
own demosaic at the site position (skipped inside the Bento mask, at clipped or flagged sites, with the ultrashort frame).
The demosaic (our own, after WhyCam 1.71's idea of a green-equivalent subpixel luma): cells of 2x2 sites (3x3 Quad, 5x5 Tetra
around the site); direction from the intra-cell gradients, same-colour cells and - only where one pairing finds no colour -
the row / column cross-phase disagreement (a saturated flat colour gave a false direction); colour differences R - G, B - G per
red / blue cell against its own row's and column's nearest greens, cells weighted by distance (narrowed across the edge) and by
how close their green is to the green at the site (a red / green edge flips R - G: the side the site belongs to); Gr / Gb
disagreement damps the colour (aliasing); every site of a cone stretched along the edge gives a green equivalent (red / blue
weighted down where the colour is strong; Quad: also by the distance to the greens' value), luma clamped to the greens' range.
Tuning baseDemosaic (1; 0 = off, as before), baseDemosaicAniso (0.6), baseDemosaicDetailLo / Hi (0 / 0.01: the noise gate
is off - the base noise model reads too low to gate on it). The program is prewarmed with the native set.
Replay on the OPPO (syn_b2 / syn_b4 with GT, cdm 1e6 = no donor anywhere; dB luma full / low-passed): Quad zone plate
+2.5 / +2.2, bars +4.8, bars false colour 0.083 -> 0.001, coloured bars +2.1, lattice 2487 -> 176, edges -1.8 / +0.7 (the
remaining loss: red / green edges); Tetra zone plate +3.2 / +5.3, bars +5.6, false colour 0.016 -> 0.001, coloured bars +3.3,
lattice 3612 -> 133, edges -0.1 / +4.3. Moving bursts (syn_b2m / b4m): moving zone plate +1.0 dB both, static regions
unchanged. Real bursts hand / isz2 / t100546: 0.6-1.9 % of the pixels change, no artefact seen, merge time within run noise.
Cost (Adreno 750, programs cached): Quad +0.24 s with motion, +0.85 s with no donor at all; Tetra +0.9 s / +2.5 s. A shared-
memory tile of the sites was tried and was slower (9 s): dropped. Open: the red / green edges of Quad, the Tetra cost, phone shots
of moving subjects.
Round 2 (local, after f89d4ce0): Quad red / green edges - the colour differences were mixed by cells lying on the edge
(their own sites disagree): such a cell (or its row / column partner) is weighted down by its intra-cell spread (Quad only:
on Tetra it lost detail), the green-similarity tau tightened (1.5 sigma + 1.5 % instead of 3 sigma + 8 %). syn_b2 no donor:
edges 41.7 -> 42.4 dB (base 43.5), the rest within 0.1 dB; Tetra edges 38.7 -> 38.9. Speed: the per-cell arrays sized by the
block (9 Quad, 25 Tetra) and the cell offsets kept in an array - recomputing them, a cache of the sites (100 floats) or a
shared-memory tile all made Adreno 750 spill registers and run 1.3-2.5x slower. Cost with no donor at all (cached programs):
Quad 1.37 s vs 0.50 s off, Tetra 3.2 s vs 0.65 s off - the same as before the edge fix; with ordinary motion only the rejected
area pays. A faster Tetra needs one invocation per 2x2 sites (shared cell statistics): not done.
Bayer (local, after 52adf573): kHybChroma (the plain merge's colour-difference pass, on by default) blends the base's own
demosaic by the same share (1 - smoothstep(0, K, F); by the cover without the 6.1 mode): a 9x9 site neighbourhood (false at a
clipped / flagged site, outside the Bento mask), direction from the 3x3 sites' green differences and same-colour Laplacians,
green at red / blue sites along it with half the Laplacian correction (bounded to the four greens' range +-50 %), green at the
position bilinear, R - G / B - G from the 5x5 core weighted by distance (narrowed across the edge) and green similarity. A noise
gate (structure / noise of the 3x3 gradients, ~1 on noise; baseDemosaicBayerLo / Hi 1.3 / 2.5) keeps flat areas on the merge's
wider kernel (the sky's noise doubled without it). zip.nch with no donor (eval_zipper): edge PSNR 34.8 -> 40.4 dB, zipper
1.64 -> 0.82 %, edge false colour 0.028 -> 0.022, sky noise 0.289 % unchanged. syn_b1 (GT = gt_shift_b2 shifted by half a
site, cubic: its high frequencies are soft) with no donor: edges +3.5 dB, zone plate +1.8 / +15 low-passed, coloured zone plate
-2.5 (beyond Nyquist), bars +-0.5; with donors unchanged. Cost: +1.45 s with no donor at all on 12 MP, real bursts within run
noise (x7u_1x, o12; Quad main511 / uw452 0.001-0.1 % of the pixels change by more than 1 %).

### P286 - film simulation as the reference app (owner, 2026-10-19: «Перепроверь также все пленочные симуляции, у нас все не работает нормально, сделай максимально близко к [приложению-образцу] ... если можешь один в один, делай один в один. Но стиль меню и тд делай наш»; licence choice: one to one with attribution): done, not device-tested.
The reference app is a closed Vulkan port of spektrafilm (Andrea Volpato, GPL-3.0 code, CC BY-SA 4.0 profiles; its .so shows
the shader and data names). We port spektrafilm itself:
- data: research/filmsim/export.py runs spektrafilm 0.3.4 (commit 3bb2c2d, a Python 3.12 venv with stubs for its image I/O)
  and writes assets/film/<stock>.bin (SFD1 container): per film the linear sRGB -> XYZ matrix (CAT16 to its reference
  illuminant), the Hanatos 2025 raw LUT 192^2 (fp16, its input gamut compression baked in), log exposure, density curves, the
  sub-layer curves, channel and base densities, the DIR matrix of its stock defaults; per paper the sensitivities, the fitted
  curves and the scan (density -> encoded sRGB with its CAM16 output gamut compression) as a 33^3 LUT; per slide its scan;
  shared.bin the TH-KG3 lamp, the dichroic filters, the neutral print filter database. 7.2 MB. LICENSE-spektrafilm.txt and
  CHANGELOG.txt beside them, the credit in Settings -> About («Данные плёночной симуляции»).
- FilmSpectral (Java): the per-pixel pipeline - Hanatos raw (Mitchell cubic, reflected edges), film exposure, develop with
  the curves before the couplers and the DIR inhibition, the enlarger (neutral filters + the user's M / Y shifts) through the
  dye densities onto the paper (NaN densities pass no light, as density_to_light), print exposure normalised on the mid grey
  of this film exposure, the paper curves, the scan LUT. Matches spektrafilm's output (spatial / stochastic effects off) within
  0.003 of the encoded value on 13 film / paper / exposure / filter cases (research/filmsim/refs.py, FilmSpectralTest).
- FilmSim: the stocks are the reference's 20 colour films (Portra 160/400/800/800 push 1/2, Gold 200, Ultramax 400, Ektar 100,
  C200, X-Tra 400, Pro 400H, Vision3 50D/200T/250D/500T, Verita 200D, Ektachrome 100, Provia 100F, Velvia 100, Kodachrome
  64) and its 8 prints (Portra / Endura Premier / Ultra / Supra Endura, Ektacolor Edge, Crystal Archive Type II, Vision 2383 /
  2393); a stock without a chosen print takes its maker's; the P281 ids map to the new ones; the black-and-white stocks (no
  data in the reference) stay on our model with its paper. Settings: «Контраст плёнки» (density_curve_gamma x0.7..x1.4),
  «Фильтр M / Y увеличителя» (+-30 CC). The LUT input: the display colour back to scene light as before.
- Grain (FilmGrain, film/grain_sf.glsl): the reference's particle model (Poisson-binomial per sub-layer; its variance formula
  checked against its Monte Carlo within 1 %, research/filmsim/grainchk.py), per layer independent Gaussian density noise
  blurred 0.65 px, seen through the print and the scan by a 17^3 LUT over the picture's colour of |d out / d density| x sigma.
- Halation (FilmHalation): the reference's in-emulsion scatter (core 2.2 / 2.0 / 1.6 um + exponential tail 9.3 / 9.7 / 9.1 um,
  weight 0.78 / 0.65 / 0.67, the tail as its three-Gaussian fit; «Мягкость плёнки» = the scatter's size; film/scatter.glsl,
  separable) and its halation sum of three bounces G(sigma_h sqrt(k)) weighted 1, 1/2, 1/4 (film/blur.glsl on the pyramid
  level under half the first bounce's width, film/halo_sum.glsl), energy kept.
Not on a phone yet: the look of every stock, the grain and halation sizes, the LUT build time (~0.1 s on the PC).

### P288 - exact FFT convolution of the lens filters (owner, 2026-10-19: «Сделай точную FFT-свёртку, если это возможно»): done, not device-tested.
A full-size FFT of the whole PSF does not fit a phone (the bloom reaches across the frame). DiffusionFft: each exponential of
the PSF on the box-pyramid level where its decay is 4..8 px (narrower ones on the image itself), cut at the reference's
radius (8 x the bloom's largest decay, at most half the image; a narrow one at 12 decays), the PSF normalised as one like the
reference; one FFT per level (overlapping tiles of 1024 with the kernel's radius as border where a level is larger); the
levels summed from the coarsest, each bilinearly enlarged. Against the reference's single full-size convolution on a 320 x 240
night scene at a 12 MP frame's scale: glow error 0.04 / 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.1 % of the peak (Glimmerglass / BPM / Pro-Mist /
CineBloom), energy within 1 % (DiffusionFftTest). A component under half a pixel (only on a preview) is its pixel mean
instead of a point sample (a point sample left no glow). The photo: LensFilter on the GPU (lensfft/load, fft - radix-2
Stockham passes, the same index math as the Java -, mul, store, down, carry); the settings' preview the same plan on the CPU;
the live viewfinder keeps the pyramid fit (LiveLensFilter). Not on a phone yet: correctness of the GPU passes, the time
(12 MP: about 70 FFT planes of 1024^2 at level 0).

### P289 - film settings' sliders and lens filters on the photo (owner, 2026-10-20: «фото сохранилось без фильтра. все эти ползунки не работают нормально, исправь», «посмотри как это реализовано в [приложении-образце] и исправь у нас»): done, not device-tested.
Causes: the GPU FFT passes left the photo without its filter (no glow in the owner's shot); the film's exposure was
compensated by the print (the EV slider changed nothing); grain, halation and softness were only in the photo's spatial
passes, never in the settings' preview. As the reference: each exponential of the filter's PSF is three Gaussians
(DiffusionGauss.FIT, amplitudes .1633 / .6496 / .1870 at sigma / decay .536 / 1.5236 / 2.7684), each blurred separably on the
box-pyramid level where its sigma is 3..6 px (mirror edges), the levels summed from the coarsest with bilinear enlargement;
on the GPU lensgauss/down, blur (x, then y accumulating), up; the settings' preview the same plan on the CPU. Error against the
exact convolution (DiffusionFft, now a test reference) under 0.1 of the peak, CineBloom 0.25, energy within 5 %
(DiffusionGaussTest). Film exposure uncompensated (the print normalised on the mid grey at EV 0). The settings' preview shows
scatter, halation (FilmEffects.light) and grain (FilmEffects.grain) as a 1:1 crop of a 4000 px photo. Grain: the reference's
defaults (particle area 0.1 um2, colour scale 1.2 / 1.0 / 2.5, sub-layers 6 / 1 / 0.4, dmin .04 / .05 / .06, uniformity
.99 / .97 / .98) and its final blur of 11.8 um; on the GPU film/noise -> film/blur x / y -> film/grain_sf. Slider ranges as the
reference: grain 0..200 %, halation 0..400 %. Viewfinder tray (owner: «сделай красивый интерфейс для списка, который
вызывается в видоискателе, и дай возможность закрывать это подменю нажатием на пустой видоискатель»): three titled sections
(LUT with «Все LUT ›» and the strength, lens filter, film) with the current choice after each title, rounded chips with the
chosen one filled in the accent; a tap on the empty viewfinder closes the tray without focusing (Swipe.onSingleTapUp).

### P290 - stepped contours on a lamp-lit sheet, echo sounder (owner, 2026-10-20, X200 Ultra bursts scam_burst-20261019-231619 / 231640; then «переходы плавные и мягкие, как на Why, но больше информации»): merge fixed (replay), tone open, not device-tested.
Cause (replay on the OPPO, clip-flag trailer): inside the base's clipped highlight the result comes from the ultrashort frames alone
(Bento), scaled by one ratio for the frame (GAIN CHECK 0.1399, MAD 9.6 %: consistent; row profile: 15 of 48 bands agreeing, none).
The 2.8 ms frames caught the desk lamp on another flicker phase than the ceiling lamps: under the desk lamp the per-colour ratio
was 0.08..0.11, so the clipped part of the sheet came out up to 30 % darker and greener than the unclipped paper, the border along
the clip on the binned cells. Fix: hybridUltrashortLocal after the row profile - 16 x 16 tiles of the ultrashort frame against the
base (both unclipped, colours with signal, smooth base, 5 x 5 median outlier test), log green ratio and R/G, B/G, filled into
unmeasured tiles (the clipped highlight) by normalised convolution from 32 tiles to 1; applied when a factor within 4 tiles of the
base's clipped tiles departs by mosaicUsRowsMin (8 %) or more (binned frame, split sub-frames, native sites at upload via
HybridMosaicNative::local, T2 Quad sites, plain path copy). Tuning key usLocal (1; 0 = rows only). Replay: 231619 and 231640
contours gone (smooth gradient), ceiling lamp unchanged in look; static references syn_b1/b2/b4, hand, isz2, q1x, o12, main511 bit
for bit with the previous worker; t100526 / t100546 (flickering scenes) changed <1 % on average in the most changed area.
check_hybrid_us_rows: lamp case (ring error 19.9 % -> 1.8 %, under the clip 27.7 % -> 9.2 %; native vs binned 1 DN).
Echo sounder: the red top line's blue segments are on the screen itself (the reference camera's shot shows them the same); the
screen is not clipped in the merge, nothing of Bento there. Open: the tone of the sheet («мягко, как у Why, но больше
информации») - post pipeline (WhyCombine highlight roll-off), needs a shot of the new build / lab A/B.

### P291 - soft light on the lamp-lit sheet, «максимально похоже на Why, но с чуть большим количеством информации» (owner, 2026-10-20): done on the host, not device-tested.
After P290 the sheet still had a dark ring round the white core. Host stand (session scratchpad art289/why_host.py: the app's
why/low, bracket_dn, gf/box/ab fusion, hlmask, combine on the PC GPU with the shot's AE values from the phone log; it reproduces
the phone JPEG of 231619 incl. the steps; colours calibrated to the JPEG by a 3x3 fit): the exposure fusion itself is not
monotonic with Bento headroom - em = (0.029, 1, 1.5, 2.25): past the base layer's saturation the weights move to the 5 EV darker
layer and the fused luma falls (0.81 at I 0.55 -> 0.72 at I 2.3) before it climbs to white. Shoulder / landing / guide /
radius / eps changed nothing of it. Fix (why/gf.glsl MODE 3, monoU, key hybrid_why_fusion_mono, default 0.04): the fusion's
own neutral curve F(I) lifted to its envelope max over I' <= I with F(I') >= 0.5 of F(I') + monoU ln(I / I'), the difference
added to the guided result; a curve that never falls (usual layers, em.x >= 0.15) is unchanged. 231619 profile from the core:
254 .. 223 203 166 160 163 171 179 .. (ring) -> 254 .. 234 229 218 212 209 203 199 193 (monotonic); 231640: 11 % of the
pixels change (lamp-lit areas). check_why_tone: vivo cases pass; its two synthetic cases fail the same on HEAD (not this change).
Owner's idea (2 ultrashort + 1 short frame between them and the normal ones): answered in chat, not built.
P291 round 2 (owner: «сделай ещё ближе к Why камере», «белый никогда не уходил в серый»): the lit paper was grey because with
Bento headroom the fusion's highlight layer is ~2 EV darker than WhyCam's (em.x 0.038 at hr 22 against ~0.125 on clipped data)
and the kernel's weights (centre 0.6, highlight layer 0.8) take it. With headroom (r.hr > 0) WhyFusion now uses centre 0.75 and
highlight-layer weight 0.4 (keys hybrid_why_weight_center_hr / _weight_hl_hr); without headroom as before. Host replay, sheet
points 255 255 254 249 227 210 / shaded part 132 against WhyCam 246 248 249 249 234 199 / 130 (before 208 .. 147 / 95);
231619 from the core 255 .. 254 251 248 243 238 231 227 217 209 205, monotonic. Left as is: WhyCam's frame is ~1.3 EV brighter
in the mid-tones and lifts the shadows (median luma 77 against 28) - a global AE / shadow change, not this scene's highlights.

Those sessions show the developed RAW (no ISP stream); it had no lens-filter pass. With a filter chosen MainRenderer draws the RAW
frame into an off-screen RGBA8 target of the viewport's size and puts it on screen through the ISP viewfinder's own shaders made
2D (LiveLensFilter.to2d: main_fs + lensfilter_live, lensfilter_prep; VS_2D), a second LiveLensFilter without its own LUT (the RAW
frame has it: the filter comes after the LUT here, before it on the ISP path). No filter: as before, no extra pass. A failed
program or target leaves the RAW viewfinder as before. Shaders: glslc ES 3.1 and desktop link OK; LiveLensFilterTest.
P295 follow-up (owner's SD870 timings with worker_gpu_normal_priority 1): the GPU passes are the same (merge 2555 ms against

### P302 - photos and RAW back to DCIM (owner, 2026-10-20): done, not device-tested.
«/storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/Camera/ и /storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw/ перенести обратно в
/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/. Это всё не нужно хранить в загрузках.» Cause: SimpleStorageHelper.updateFileManagerPaths took the first
lasting folder grant whatever it was and appended "DCIM/" - since P191 that was the Download/SCAMERA grant, so photos and DNGs went
to Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/...; hasStorageAccess counted that grant as DCIM access (the DCIM picker was never shown). Now dcimOf
takes only a grant of DCIM, of a folder in it or of a storage root (primary first), else the primary DCIM (the File API writes
photos and DNGs there); hasStorageAccess the same. DcimMoveBack (once, in the background at the camera's start): the files of
Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/Camera and .../DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw go to DCIM/Camera and DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw - renamed where the File API allows,
else copied, read back and compared byte for byte, then the old one deleted (File API, else through the Download/SCAMERA grant);
the same bytes already there: the old one goes; another file of the name: "_1"; anything that cannot be read or deleted stays for
the next start; media scan of both places; empty old folders removed; done once nothing is left. DcimMoveBackTest (CI).

### P301 - the viewfinder shows the photo's tone (owner, 2026-10-20: «тонмапинг ... в живом видоискателе? Результат должен совпадать с итоговым фото», «Делай»; «нужно, чтобы RAW-видоискатель можно было включить не только для ISZ и фулреза»): done, not device-tested.
Before: the ISP viewfinder shows the ISP's own tone (our LUT / film / filter on top); the RAW viewfinder WhyCore at its library
defaults (ACES, per-pixel fusion, its own meter) - neither the photo's WHY tone. Now the developed-RAW viewfinder runs the photo's
own shaders (LiveArkTone, the viewfinder's GL thread): rawdevelop_fs u_linear_out gives the frame's linear sRGB (WB, lens
shading, color_transform; no tone), then why/low, WhyAe on a factor-8 whyLow read back every 4 frames (smoothed), why/gf + box +
ab (the guided-filter fusion with the photo's weights and P291 envelope), why/combine with the photo's settings (tone operator,
colour look, film simulation / LUT), into the off-screen target; the 2D filter pass (P300) puts it on screen with the lens filter
and the focus peaking. Differences left: the merge's noise and detail (detail off), no Bento headroom (one frame), the AE's noise
clamp from the frame's noise over 0.55 x the burst's frames, the AE's statistics at factor 8. Any GL failure switches it off for
the context (the RAW viewfinder's own look). scam_dev.txt "vf_why 0": as before. The RAW viewfinder on any module: «Живой
видоискатель» (settings and the sheet's «Для опытных»), or the module's «Поток ISP: Выкл»; DeviceDefaults v6 turns it on once on
flagship SoCs (SM8650 / SM8750 / SM8850, MT6989 / MT699x). Open: frame rate and look on a phone.

Every settings screen inflates the whole preferences.xml, the developer page (DeveloperPreferences.populate, 179 DevKeys) with it,

listed file cannot be read directly (its keys were silently ignored before).

### P305 - 50 MP: stripes on a distant ship in the frame's centre (owner, 2026-10-20): done, not device-tested.
«На 50мп по центру на судне в далеке есть полосы, нужно исправить»; «Полосы — это не фактура корпуса судна». Inputs:
C:/Users/MECHREVO/Desktop/т/p7/SCAMERA.zip, scam_burst-20261020-115603.bin, scam_burst-20261020-115634.bin. The merge, the finish
denoise (nearly transparent at this SNR) and the WHY sharpening are smooth on the hull; the stripes came from the dither of
why/combine.glsl: its ints were mediump, fp16 on Adreno, so float(xy) and the dither phase made plates 1-4 px wide and 11-43 rows
tall instead of +-0.5 LSB noise, and jpegli's quantisation kept them as vertical streaks on smooth dark areas (the hull, the sky;
at 200 MP the merge's noise hid them). combine.glsl declares precision highp int (host replay with the fp16 emulation reproduces
the phone's streaks, without it they are gone; desktop GL runs mediump as fp32). check_colour_output.py checks the line. Same
class, not fixed (off by default or negligible): the grain of why/sharp_compose, the watermark, the lens-shading lookups.

### P308 - everything on the GPU (owner, 2026-10-20: «нам нужно перевести всё на гпу»): DONE, not device-tested in the app.
The CPU steps of a shot today: the chroma median and false-colour suppression above 16.8 MP (MosaicChromaStream: every 50 / 200 MP
mosaic merge; ChromaMedianGpu below that size), the oscillation map of the base sites, the site-class response and its field, the
binning of the native mosaic frames, the shift to the RGGB origin, the outlier statistics, the row profiles of the ultrashort
frames; app side: the Java steps around the merge. Each one on the GPU with the same results (bit-exact where the CPU path
promised it, else float rounding), memory at 200 MP in strips, timings before / after on the X200 Ultra and the OPPO.
Owner, same day: «сделай гпу выравнивание и дай возможность выбора»; «один в один выравнивание как Why Кам не делаем, если возможно
переводим наше на гпу»; «постарайся ускорить гпу выравнивание когда закончишь перенос»; «на качество ускорение не должно влиять».
- F6 on the GPU: DONE, not device-tested in the app. `scam-la-gpu.h` (LaGpu): our laGray / laDown / laBaseLevel / laTilePass / laLK /
  laMedian3 / laMotionExtent / laFrameField as GLES 3.1 compute, 16 invocations per tile (4 tiles a workgroup, shared-memory
  reduction), base levels as rgba32f textures (masked value, gx, gy), the donor's bilinear quad one textureGather, two frames in
  flight (submit / collect; no zero uploads: the first LK iteration clears the stop flags). Context, programs and base pyramid built
  on a thread of their own during the alignment (laGpuAhead), released there and taken by the merge thread; any failure -> the CPU
  field (whole-field path). Worker key `laGpu` (default 0: replays unchanged); app ListPreference `pref_scam_hybrid_la_engine`
  «Где считать F6» GPU (default, HYBRID_DEFAULTS la_engine 1) / CPU, greyed out with F6 off; HybridSettingsTest p308.
  OPPO Find X7 Ultra replays (same worker): the field equals the CPU's up to float rounding (merge max abs 0.00043, PSNR 124.5 dB;
  stats identical), laGpu 0 bit-identical to before (b50 50e4f6ad, hh_1 63519568, x7u_1x c2f295fa); every GPU variant below gave
  the same output (b50 6433c787). Per 12 MP frame: thread per tile 77 ms -> workgroup 67 -> textures + vec4 sums ~55 -> pipelined
  21.6 ms (b50: 12 frames 266 ms; hh_1 24 frames 159 ms; x7u_1x 34 frames 592 ms). Shot totals GPU / CPU: b50 12144 / 12196 ms,
  hh_1 3427, 3366 / 3344, 3395 ms, x7u_1x 3347, 3366 / 3340, 3469 ms; the merge 0.3-0.7 s faster with the processor free.
  hh_1 still waits ~100 ms for the context (its alignment is shorter than the compile).
- Speed-up of the GPU F6 (owner: «постарайся ускорить гпу выравнивание», «на качество ускорение не должно влиять»): DONE, every
  step bit-identical (laGpu 1: b50 6433c787, hh_1 8f1f7a28, x7u_1x 105b7c1d; laGpu 0 unchanged):
  - LaGpuWorker: the context lives on a thread of its own from the alignment on, each frame handed over as soon as its homography
    is known (streamFeed; in the translation path from the alignment threads, one core left to the feeder), two in flight, a frame
    handed over again with another homography computed again; the statistics (hypot, medians) after the wait on all cores;
  - the programs from the merge's program binary cache (files la-*.bin, newest 24) and in the app's GPU prewarm
    (hybridPrewarmGpu): context + programs + base 260 -> 51-58 ms;
  - the passes without gradients (L0 start, acceptance) read an r32f copy of the base's masked value (a quarter of the bytes), the
    start's two windows share it in one loop; workgroup 4 tiles (1 / 2 / 8 / 16 measured, all bit-identical, 4 fastest).
  GPU per 12 MP frame ~20 ms (L1 3.5, start 4.6, L0 3 iterations 9.2, acceptance 2.8). x7u_1x F6 stage 592 -> 290-330 ms.
- Measured with the program cache warm (as in the app; OPPO X7U, two runs each): the streamed CPU field is hidden in the merge and
  stays faster than the GPU field (hh_1 2.35 / 2.37 against 2.55 / 2.59 s, x7u_1x 2.81 / 2.80 against 3.12 / 2.95 s, b50 11.37 /
  11.27 against 11.42 / 11.42 s); where the CPU field comes whole before the merge (laStream 0, Sabre 2x checked with the whole field,
  sub-frames, large frames) the GPU wins (x7u_1x 3.95 -> 3.06 s, hh_1 2.59 -> 2.57 s). Hence laGpu 2 = auto (the app default,
  «Где считать F6» Авто / GPU / CPU): the GPU exactly where the CPU field could not stream (verified: auto = the CPU md5 when it
  streams, the GPU md5 with laStream 0).
- Pre-push review (two read-only workflows, findings verified adversarially; fixed): the GPU field is skipped for large frames
  that do not fit a quarter of MemAvailable (~11.5 B per RAW pixel) and when the RAW exceeds a storage block; the worker is
  reset when nothing is refined and right after its fields are taken (the context and buffers gone before the merge); frames the
  merge left out leave its queue (retain); a low-priority context (scamProcessingContext, P57); the note no longer truncated.
  P302: copies go to a hidden temporary name first (an interrupted copy never leaves a broken photo under a real name, leftovers
  removed on the next start), an earlier copy under "_1", "_2"... is found (no second copy), sizes compared before reading, the
  file time kept, the move stops after three starts without progress. P306: a 200 MP shot never reaches the full-grid NLM denoise
  (engine "nlm" or a failure of the 2x2-means one: the merge alone); a lab fragment of a 200 MP shot takes its 200 MP denoise.
  Second review (7 confirmed, fixed): P309 bit 16 of the clip flags ("inside the Bento mask": hlrecovery's light statistics) only
  on the previous mask's cells (the ramp had widened it 1.3-2.9x); the check's validity scales the mask at the weights it was made
  for; the ramp's planes freed as soon as they are used; no CPU base pyramid when the GPU field has nothing to refine. P302: the
  copy is synced to the storage before the old file goes; the move is done only once the old folders are gone (with access to
  selected photos only, the rest waits for the full access, no try counted). P306: the 200 MP NLM gate of a lab fragment by its
  shot's size. Rechecked: every md5 above, hh_1 with the ramp = without, ramp metrics unchanged, bit 16 counts = bentoRamp 0.
- Seen on the way (not P308, not changed): the merge's own program binary cache changes its rounding. x7u_1x with the cache warm
  eae6a769 against 105b7c1d compiled (PSNR 52.9 dB on the image, 2253 px > 0.01, max 2.17); the F6 programs from the cache give the
  same field. md5 checks of replays therefore run without SCAM_GL_CACHE.
- The CPU steps before the merge (all bit-identical: b50 50e4f6ad / 6433c787, b200 6fc74e0f, hh_1, x7u_1x unchanged). b50 before the
  merge 3131 -> 759-786 ms, b200 2460 -> ~1.3 s:
  - site-class response (hybridMosaicGainsRobust): every picked tile's means, group means and prediction once on all cores (RespTile),
    the rounds and the field's second pass over them in the same order (b50 1538 -> ~220 ms, b200 1320 -> 210-620 ms). Not on the
    GPU: its sums are double (GLES has none), float sums would move the gains.
  - binning (Quad / Tetra T1): by sensor rows, the same float steps vectorised (the captures copied to locals: the loop did not
    vectorise), block sums in double in the old order (mosaicBinBlocks<2/4>), lround as floor + 0.5 test, the buffer not zeroed
    (HybridNoInitAlloc): 713 -> ~335 ms. Not on the GPU: it would first copy every frame's RAW (1.6 GB at 50 MP), as long as this.
  - the ultrashort checks (hybridUsRowsCheck): the frames at once (hybridUsRowsChecks, report lines in frame order) and
    hybridGridBlur on all cores with four independent sums at a time (each the same order): 3 x ~250 ms -> ~215 ms for all.
- Left on the CPU on purpose: the chroma median / oscillation map / RGGB shift above 16.8 MP run during the merge
  (MosaicChromaOverlap; b50 done 49 ms after it, b200 47 ms): on the GPU they would slow the merge, which is the GPU's.
  The merge itself is the shot now: b50 12.2 s of 13.1, b200 60.5 s of 62 (OPPO X7U, 5 frames).

### P311 - LED rings without lines in the WHY tone: the AgX path to white over 1.3 EV, the detail delta at the rim of a clipped light (owner, 2026-10-21, OPPO X8U photo of the PC on f9489748: a pink fan ring with a white core, a hard edge on its outer side and a crimson line along its inner side; «сделай ещё лучше»): DONE, not device-tested in the app.
- The linear merge is clean at the rings (the LED burst replayed on the OPPO with the final P310 worker); both lines come from the
  WHY tone (host chain SCR p310/led_host.py, phone sharpening; harness SCR p311/ref: render.py, score.py = dips / cliffs / colour
  bands at six ring and bar locations, regress.py = seven scenes, changes outside the light edges, speck.py = roughness along the
  rings; a synthetic merge with lines, holes, rims and LED rows).
- Outer side: my own P310 gate of the AgX path to white, smoothstep(0.8, 0.995 x the AgX white): 0.3 EV, inside one pixel of a ring's
  falloff (~0.3 EV per px), so the other channels (lifted to 15 % of the brightest one) fell 3.5 EV in a pixel after a plateau (blue
  ring R 180 -> 96 in 2 px; pink: the white core breaking off into the saturated glow). Now 0.8 .. 2.0 x the white: pixels below 0.8 x
  unchanged, from 2 x up the former core; nothing else in the tone moves (check_colour_output: the baseline with the same edit).
- Inner side (and with that fix the outer side too): the bounded detail delta of combine.glsl dug a lobe 2-6 px wide beside a
  clipped light - its reference (the B-spline of the whyLow box means of min(m Y, 1)) holds the light's spill, the cube root of
  that linear mix lifts it far more than the base (the fusion mixes in the display domain), plus WhyLumaSharpen's undershoot at
  that edge. Rule (lightShare / lightRimDelta): the light share of the whyLow taps (max channel 2 .. 4 x the reference's bound, or
  the geometric mean of max channel and luminance 1.4 .. 2.4 x), its mass / first / second moment in a disc of 4 whyLow px, side =
  |M|^4 / (H M'SM) (1 = the light on one side: a rim, 0 = around the pixel: a dark line or hole in front of a light), the reference
  of the far side (the footprint taps behind the pixel, away from the light), and at a rim the negative delta against that far
  side, never deeper than the plain delta; blended by side 0.3 .. 0.7 and the disc's light mass 0 .. 2. Every input smooth in the
  position; no light in the footprint = bit for bit as before.
- Rejected on the way (measured): a per-pixel rim test on the sharpened pixel with a 'valley' 2-3 px further out (dotted dark
  lines along the rings: its decision followed the noise); a local-slope compression of the delta (design C: LED scores as good,
  but dark wires 1-3 px within 4 px of a blown window lost 50-75 % of their contrast and lights at 4-6 x white got dashed rims);
  the 16-tap footprint share as the gate (dashed rims at lights of ~2 x white and LED rows: review, replaced by the disc mass).
- Measured (host, phone sharpening; mean LED score over six locations, lower = better, the reference app's own JPEG 25): blue
  burst 55.7 -> 28.6, the pink channel swap 47.1 -> 27.5, the burst without the ultrashort frames 45.6 -> 25.3; the complaint ring's
  inner dip 41 -> ~1 codes; no rise of the roughness along the rings; synthetic dark lines 3/4/6 px and holes r3/r5 in front of a 4 x
  light unchanged, below-white cells bit-identical; o12 / x7u_1x / d1655 / d1853 outside the light edges <= 0.003 % of the pixels
  (d1655 bit-identical), the changes there trenches removed at lamps and blown windows. Open: colour band at a non-white saturated
  core (now visible instead of the dark line: the core-colour / path-to-white question), lights below ~2 x white keep part of the
  lobe, dark objects ~8-10 px wide in front of a light keep their lobe rails.
- Checks: check_colour_output --shader / --gl (the a3e94db baseline with the P310 + P311 edits, everything else bit-exact),

### P312 - the camera's start without a frozen viewfinder: the developed-RAW viewfinder's programs from driver binaries (owner, 2026-10-21, a video of three starts on the vivo X200 Ultra: «вот такие лаги ловлю при запуске»): DONE, not device-tested.
- Cause (the video against the log): the viewfinder stood still 0.4 s at every start (2.1 - 2.5 s cold) right after its first
  frames - the gap between the last ISP frame drawn and «the photo's WHY tone on». At the first RAW frame the viewfinder's GL thread
  compiled from source rawdevelop (650 lines) and the ten programs of the photo's WHY tone (combine 815 lines); no ISP frame could
  be drawn meanwhile (the camera kept 30 fps: STAB_TRACE maxGap 66 ms). The post pipeline's program binaries (P30 / P69) never
  covered the viewfinder.
- GLProg: viewfinder keys ("V\n" + attributes + vertex + U+0001 + fragment) in the same driver-binary cache (process + disk;
  cachedViewfinderProgram / linkViewfinderProgram / viewfinderProgram; the idle warm-up recompiles them after a driver update; not
  counted in the shot's "programs:" line; stale GL errors drained before glProgramBinary). LiveRawRenderer / LiveArkTone: their
  programs through it, prepare() before the first draw (pending first, then the binary; a refused or missing binary goes to the
  background once, else compiled in place); MainRenderer's own four programs too. ViewfinderPrograms: the keys without a binary
  compiled on a background thread in a context of its own (display priority). MainRenderer: the ISP frame stays until the programs
  are linked (no load while the background links: a driver's compiler lock), then straight to the WHY tone; a RAW-only session
  (ISZ / FULLRES) shows the plain RAW look as soon as rawdevelop is there; the WHY set asked again when it becomes wanted; 8 s
  deadline, then as before; the GL state put back after the set-up.
- Expected: a start with binaries links them in a few ms (the first RAW frame keeps ~40-120 ms: the 24 MB upload, the WHY targets,
  the first AE readback); the first start after an install compiles in the background while the ISP viewfinder runs.
- Checks: GLProgramDiskCacheTest (keys round trip, kept for the warm-up, not counted), two code reviews (fixed: the pending/cache
  race, per-frame key building, stats leak, stale errors, no deadline, RAW-only sessions). Open: the phone (VF_DRAW at a cold start).

### P313 - vivo 2x ISZ in daylight: the highlights' detail back (the ultrashort frames fill only what the N frames clipped), no false flicker correction (owner, 2026-10-21, vivo X200 Ultra 2x ISZ, burst scam_burst-20261021-101423.bin: «все фото в области светов очень мыльное и с кучей артефактов» + «почему-то обработка фото с isz занимает кучу времени»): DONE in the worker, not device-tested in the app.

  квад брали 3 ультракоротких кадра»): the native pick put them into N slots (28 N + 1 + 1 of 30 on the ISZ burst: a second one
