### P314 - the RAW viewfinder as light as WhyCam's: one pass of the photo's tone at the frame's colour grid, the AE on the CPU, a frame dropped when the viewfinder is busy, the GPU at normal priority (owner, 2026-10-21: «Исправь живой видоискатель, в WhyCam он тоже есть, но при этом обработку он никак не замедляет» + «Посмотри как работает живой видоискатель в Why камере, нам нужно сделать схожим образом»): DONE, not device-tested.
- Cause (P313's slow 2x ISZ shot): the P301 WHY RAW viewfinder drew ~20 passes a frame at the viewport (the guided-filter fusion,
  its pyramid), copied (24 MB) and uploaded the whole frame, read the picture back for the AE every 4th frame, in a HIGH-priority
  context (P90): the worker's LOW context got ~1/10 of the GPU (46-51 rows/s while it ran, >= 410 rows/s without it).
- WhyCam v174 (jadx + the engine's disassembly; notes SCR arkvf/NOTES.md): ONE full-screen pass on the packed RAW (per pixel:
  WB, lens shading, CCM, the CPU's exposure, a GLOBAL exposure-fusion curve on the pixel's own luma - no neighbourhood -, the
  look, tone map, LUT); the producer (the camera thread) drops a frame while the render thread is busy (no copy), the AE from
  <= 64 x 64 RAW samples on the CPU, no glReadPixels, no fences, no EGL priority.
- Ours now (same shape, our photo's tone): (1) GLPreview: vf_gpu_priority default 0 = MEDIUM (1 = P90's HIGH); (2) main_fs: the
  9-tap peaking average only with peaking on; (3) rawdevelop_fs: CFA mask / shift instead of % (SPIR-V OpSMod 6 -> 0);
  (4) LiveRawFrame: three buffers (acquire no longer copies), drop-when-busy (takesFrame: a frame the GL thread has not taken
  within 100 ms is replaced; CaptureController neither reads nor copies a skipped one), Quad / Tetra frames under 30 MP published
  as their cell means (drawn with cfa_mode 0: lossless against the mosaic up to 1/2 DN; the >= 30 MP bins of P108 / P179 / P181 /
  P194 unchanged); the bins on threads of their own (ParallelWork.Own: in the shared pool a shot's CPU pass held the camera thread
  for its whole length on every frame - review, desktop: 4 -> 381 ms behind a 400 ms pass); (5) the WHY tone drawn at the visible
  crop's colour grid (LiveRawRenderer.toneSize, 1/16 steps of the viewport, sized from the crop fitted to the screen - the crop of
  the previous target made 2-cycles in 139 of ~84k cases: review): 2x ISZ 810 x 1080 instead of 1440 x 1920, Tetra 450 x 600,
  1x Bayer and FULLRES the viewport; the filter / peaking pass scales it to the screen; (6) combine.glsl POINT_FUSED: the photo's
  fusion as a per-pixel curve (FusedCurve: gf fusedAt + the P291 envelope, 353 entries, unit 8), LiveArkTone vf_why 1 (default;
  2 = the guided-filter chain, now at the tone size with its box radius scaled; 0 = off), the AE by LiveArkMeter (128 x 96 cells
  of 2 x 2 colour quads of the RAW frame -> WhyAe.smartHdr, ~1 ms on the GL thread) instead of the readback. A 2x ISZ frame:
  ~20 passes, 24 MB copy + upload, a readback, HIGH -> 3 passes at 810 x 1080, a 6 MB upload, no readback, MEDIUM. Fallbacks as
  before (WHY failure -> the plain RAW look -> the ISP viewfinder).
- Host checks: LiveArkMeter vs the photo's per-quad statistics within 1 % (ae, p50, p98, p995, effS / effH) on clean frames (the
  old factor-8 readback smeared small lights: p995 0.69 vs the photo's 0.375); POINT_FUSED vs the exact per-pixel fusedAt +

### P317 - film simulation and the GPU statistics on Mali (every MTK phone) (owner, 2026-10-21, vivo X300 Pro V2502A, Mali-G1-Ultra, build 31108: «вот такое словил на X300 Pro с включенной симуляцией пленки» - a white photo; then «Исправь работу на всех мтк»): DONE, not device-tested.
- White photo: a fragment shader's ints default to mediump (ESSL 3.10 4.7.4) - 16 bit on Mali. The film noise hash (film/noise.glsl
  ...) divided a 16-bit-wrapped int by 65536 in fp16: +inf, the grain added infinity, the photo white. Adreno's mediump int is 32 bit
  (no change there). GLInterface.readProgram now inserts `precision highp int` into every program without its own #version (after
  its #extension lines, with a #line fix); the film shaders declare it too; film/grain_sf.glsl guards NaN / Inf.
- WHY AE «histogram weight 0 / 0 ... CPU statistics» on every Mali shot: GLInterface.getLayouts keyed a one-line SSBO block
  ("buffer aeHistY { uint histY[]; };", why/aestats, ultrahdr/gainmax, halfrgba) by "}", setBufferCompute bound nothing, and the
  shader saw what sat at its binding - GLBuffer's own glBindBufferBase(SSBO, name, name), right on Adreno (names 1..n) by luck,
  nothing on Mali. The parser takes the word before '{'; GLBuffer no longer binds at its name (every user binds through
  setBufferCompute); setBufferCompute / setTextureCompute throw (logged) for an unknown block instead of a stack trace to logcat;
  memoryBarrierShared() with every barrier() in aestats / gainmax / histogram (ESSL 3.10 8.14).
- ScamHdrDenoise: the usampler EffMap always has a unit of its own (a 1x1 placeholder when there is no map; unit 0 held the
  sampler2D input: GL_INVALID_OPERATION at the draw on Mali).
- Checks: GLInterfaceLayoutsTest (new, CI list: every asset shader's layouts), tools/check_shader_fp16.py (new, CI: no mediump
  operation with a constant outside the fp16 range), every asset shader through glslc as readProgram builds it (68 OK), the film
  shaders bit-exact on the host with highp (film_bitexact), FilmEffectsTest, check_colour_output --gl.
- Open: a Mali phone (X300 Pro / X200 Pro / Pixel 7): the film photo, «WHY AE GPU: stats=gpu» in the log.

### P318 - Quad (2x2) and Tetra (4x4) for every colour filter arrangement (owner, 2026-10-21: «у нас 2x2 4x4 оптимизированы под все цветовые фильтры? Займись оптимизацией/исправлением без агентов, самостоятельно»): DONE (the lead, no agents); the merge and the DNG writer checked on the OPPO X7U, the app not device-tested.
- Question: the native mosaic merge (scam-hybrid.h: canonical coordinates with cfaShift, kHybNatAccess, kHybMergeMosaicFast, the
  P313 NAT_US_PASS fill, the row correction, hybridUsGlobalShift / hybridUltrashortLocal, the Bento / clip flags, the remosaic and
  the merged mosaic DNG) and the app's mosaic paths (LiveRawFrame cell means + rawdevelop cfa_mode 0, LiveArkMeter, MosaicNeutral,
  MosaicBlockDetector, the remosaic) for RGGB, GRBG, GBRG and BGGR phases of the colour blocks.
- Method: the same burst in the four phases (cropped by one colour block on the left / top, CFA index XOR 1 / 2), merged by the
  current worker on the OPPO; each output against the RGGB one shifted by the block - only the borders may differ.
- Tools (SCR p318): nchcrop.cpp (a v10..v12 burst cropped by dx / dy colour blocks, the header's CFA index flipped per block
  parity, an optional block for the synthetic bursts), cmp_cfa.py (per channel median ratio, share of pixels > 2 % apart, the
  part of the difference periodic in 2b px - a CFA mistake leaves a pattern locked to the blocks - and the highlights' chroma /
  level where the reference is >= 0.9). Controls: a shift by 2b (the same phase) shows what the crop alone changes (the
  reference frame's tiles, the alignment, the Bento masks move with the border).
- Merge: every phase as its same-phase control. syn_b2 (Quad): x / y / xy shifts 13.7 / 26.3 / 26.1 % > 2 % against the controls
  13.7 / 26.3 %; syn_b4 (Tetra): 9.5 / 18.3 / 19.0 % against 9.5 / 18.2 %; isz2 (real 2x ISZ Quad, X7U): 1.8 / 1.5 / 2.6 %
  against 2.0 %; v10_2 (real Tetra, BGGR): 0.003 / 0.002 / 0.003 % against 2.7 %. Channel ratios 0.9998..1.0001 in all, no
  block-locked pattern (lattice rms 1e-6..2.5e-4 of a difference rms 3e-5..1.4e-2, at the controls' level), no NaN, the
  highlights' chroma p99 ~0.01 in every phase. The app's mosaic paths take the CFA index per block (MosaicNeutral, the
  LiveRawFrame cell means, the remosaic) and every crop keeps whole colour periods (RawCrop and Wide169 start on multiples of
  8 = 2 x Tetra), so the phase never changes inside the app.
- Found: the DNG writer. (1) dngCreator.cpp setCFAPattern expanded the 2x2 order to 4x4 inside its 4-byte array
  (DngMetadata.cfa_pattern[4]): 12 bytes over cfa_repeat_pattern_dim and the has_* flags after it. With the colour set before the
  CFA (DngCreator.setParameters) a BGGR file lost ForwardMatrix1 and AsShotNeutral and a GBRG file every colour matrix and its
  illuminant (checked against the HEAD writer on the phone: 9 failures in 8 cases, RGGB / GRBG kept them by luck) - most likely P215
  (X200 Ultra tele / X100 Ultra DNGs without AsShotNeutral and ForwardMatrix, the tele and the ISZ modules are BGGR), not a
  non-finite value; a matrix set after the CFA moved the CFA instead. (2) The merged mosaic DNG of P267 (no remosaic: the shot
  is the DNG in the Quad / Tetra layout) and a mosaic stream's reference frame declared a 2x2 Bayer pattern: every raw converter
  (and our DNG preview: the pink thumbnail) developed a Quad / Tetra mosaic as Bayer; the GainMap put each channel's gain on its
  neighbours' sites.
- Fix: cfa_pattern keeps the 2x2 order; DngCreator.setMosaicBlock (JNI; from Parameters.dngMosaicBlock in setParameters, before
  the GainMap) gives the stored mosaic's block: CFARepeatPatternDim 2b x 2b with the order per block (4x4 Quad, 8x8 Tetra: the
  DNG SDK takes up to 8x8; Scam Remosaic's declaredRed reads the block order from either), BlackLevelRepeatDim 2b x 2b when the
  four levels differ (2x2 as before when equal), one GainMap per channel and block site with pitch 2b (16 / 64 maps). ScamProcessor
  sets it around its two DNGs: the merged DNG takes ScamHybridBurst.lastDngMosaic (1 with our remosaic: that DNG is Bayer), the
  reference frame lastStreamBlock (the stream's measured / stored block, whole colour periods only), then 1 again. The writer
  also frees its four gain-map copies (leaked before).
- Also fixed: the CI's unit-test line had GLInterfaceLayoutsTest glued to the next --tests (P317's edit: one argument, the
  next class taken for a Gradle task).
- Checks: tools/check_dng_mosaic_cfa.cpp (new, CI: g++ -fsanitize=address,undefined; NDK clang on the X7U: 51 cases - the four
  orders x blocks 1 / 2 / 4 x equal / unequal black x colour before / after the CFA: CFARepeatPatternDim, CFAPattern, BlackLevel,
  ColorMatrix1, ForwardMatrix1, AsShotNeutral, CalibrationIlluminant1, every GainMap on a site of its own colour, every site once;
  blocks 0 / 3 / 8 give Bayer), CropUpscaleTest (new case: the block reaches the writer before the GainMap, merged / reference
  blocks, the reset), DngMetadataTest, DngPreviewTest (any repeat pattern), DngColourTest.
- Open: a phone DNG of each kind (merged mosaic, reference frame, plain Bayer) in Lightroom and Scam Remosaic; whether the
  owner's X200 Ultra / X100 Ultra DNGs carry AsShotNeutral / ForwardMatrix1 again (P215).

  (4096x2304 / 4096x2632, 14-bit sensor fusion) and 9 / 11 (DCG4, 10-bit IMAGE + IMAGE_SHORT pair), none delivered a RAW
  (DEVICE-FRONTIER-20261016.md). SCAMERA's DCG frames come from the «DCG 14 бит» switch (X300 Ultra 17 / 11 / 20, 14-bit under 1023,
  clip 8694; Xiaomi 15 Ultra mode 24) and the Pixel 10 Pro main (owner: DCG in every format). 186 pipeline places classified against
  the 7 assumptions: 68 broke.

  session's levels resolve 14 bit: a HAL that ran its plain mode under the request stays plain), latched at the press (ImageSaver.
  dcgShot -> DefaultSaver -> ScamProcessor -> Parameters.dcgShot); Dcg14Mode.requested(c) (the request) for the session's level

- Linearity (RawLinearity, ScamProcessor.dcgLinearity, before the white balance and the merge): votes per colour (greens pooled);
  a knee = R, G and B stepping alike at one code; one colour without the step decides «no knee there»; LINEAR only with no knee and
  >= 85 % of the samples at decided codes (an untested code is no proof); found -> every frame expanded through the inverse PWL in
  place, levels follow; not proven / not checkable / not linearisable -> the frames of another exposure are left out.

Займись этим», the X200 Ultra bursts scam_burst-20261023-122855/122922 + log, then the X300 Ultra log of 12:00-12:11): DONE in code, not device-tested.

  above it LCG x16 (codes in steps of 16), fused linearly (histogram trend ratio 1.00 across the transition, no knee). Temporal
  variance ~12 DN^2 at the black, ~4270 at ~1900 DN, ~23800 at ~3800 DN: two zones. Reported ISO x16 (floor 1144 against 72), and
  the HAL SENSOR_NOISE_PROFILE is keyed by that ISO: 14-19x the measured slope, 55-256x the offset. The shot was not taken as DCG

### P335 - Why 1.92 studied, its ideas improved and added: soft rejection motion prior, noise-aware false-colour damping, grain, daylight colour denoise (owner, 2026-10-25: «не уверен что ядро 6.1 у нас работает, детализация хуже чем у Why камеры», «днём слишком сильный хрома шумодав, да и люма тоже», D:/scam_burst-20261025-124513.bin + D:/LUT.zip (crops, logs, WhyCam JPEG), «по поводу зерна шумодава же, у нас должно быть что-то между Why и нашим», arkcamv192.apk, «посмотри как работают у Why реджекты и подумай как их можно улучшить у нас, так же проверь как у него работают антизиппер и попробуй его улучшить и добавить нам», «вместо того чтобы в точности переносить что-либо с Why, сначала постарайся это улучшить», «когда полностью всё закончишь заливай на гит»): DONE in code, not device-tested (the phone was disconnected).
- Why 1.92 (com.whycam, libopenhdr_engine.so, no libgcastartup any more): its own GLSL Sabre. The kernel's SNR is Google's key
  0.18 / sqrt(O + 0.18 S) of the base frame and its curves are ours (f2 {1,4,14,30} -> {0.01,0.002,0.001,0.001}, f3 {1,3,12,30} ->
  {0.02,0.015,0.009,0.006}, cov_* defaults = the key-30 values 8.8 / 1.0 / 0.001 / 4.0 / 1.33 / 166.7): the 6.1 kernel is the same.
  Defaults: multiscale denoise off, Sabre denoise factor 0.4 with luma revert 0.85 (motion 0.5), grain 0.15 only where < 5 frames
  merged, no sharpening (USM / bilateral radius 0), 15 frames, no long frames. Rejection = Google's with a binary motion prior
  (flow variation / affine residual: half the noise forgiven, boost); anti-zipper = on the motion fallback a 3x3 directional green +
  chroma damping by the Gr / Gb step, and a 5x5 chroma-difference filter on the highlight mask.
- The owner's ISO 12800 pair: our fine / mid luma noise 0.65 / 0.59 x Why's, chroma 0.6 x: 23 merged frames (3 long at A = 4)
  against Why's 15, not a stronger luma denoise (the tiers revert 0.9 / 0.88 there).
- Worker: rejPrior 1 (the Z channel bilinear between the tiles, the prior smoothstep 0.5..1.5 x motionThreshold, half the noise
  forgiven inside it, the boost by the share), baseDemosaicAlias 1 (Bayer base demosaic: colour difference damped by the Gr / Gb
  step of the 5x5 core above 2 sigma of the phase means, less along a clear edge). Both off by worker default (replays unchanged),
  sent by the app. Kept off (keys only): plainChromaHand (the hand-held share of the plain chroma median: 0.35 doubled the
  synthetic colour error) and shastaSharpLo / Hi (bracketed weight by sharpness: no detail change, the long frames add SNR).
- App: ScamDenoise puts back dn_luma_grain 0.5 of the finest-scale luma noise it removed (scamdn/lgrain: high band of
  Y_in - Y_den, added to Y in the last chroma pass: the colour denoise sees no extra grain), and the colour denoise eases off
  above SNR 20 to dn_chroma_day 0.5 at SNR 80 (ScamDenoiseTables.dayChroma). scam_dev keys hybrid_rej_prior, hybrid_base_demosaic_alias,

### P342 - the rejection map (owner, 2026-10-26: lab screenshots of our «Реджект» map next to WhyCam's «после · отсечение», «вот так выглядит реджект у нас и у Why камеры», «займись картой реджектов»): DONE in code, replayed on the OPPO (worker with the owner's tuning, CRE off), not shot on a phone; not pushed («на гит не лей»).
- Cause: kHybReject tested one cell (the donor's bilinear sample against the base cell): a single noise draw. With the noise
  model exact (simulation) the mean weight is 0.94 and 13 % of the cells fall under 0.85; DilateMask sums 25 cells of those tails
  into a rejection of the area. Owner's 18:40 night burst: static sky 0.78 of each frame (raw 0.92, 20 % of the cells < 0.85),
  deck 0.81, dark sea 0.97. Merged noise changed little (-1 %: a uniform weight hardly changes the variance) - the map was wrong,
  the image only slightly.
- Fix (worker rejPool, app sends 1; rejPool 0 bit-identical to before, md5 checked): the distance from the mean over the 3 x 3
  cells of the squared difference (the donor bilinear at each neighbour from the 4 x 4 cells, the base cell from the guide), the
  noise forgiven after the mean; a single cell still rejected by itself above the pooled distance + rejPoolT 0.7 (< 0.7 % of
  noise cells). The difference of the 3 x 3 means (Google's) was tried first: it cancels moving water's ripples (accepted 0.42 ->
  0.52, the waves went soft) - rejected.
- Replay: night sky 0.78 -> 0.95, deck 0.81 -> 0.96, merge factors 0.86 -> 0.96; day 17:57 wall 0.94 -> 0.98, moving sea 0.42 ->
  0.44 (ripples as before). Time unchanged. Synthetic moving-object bursts (replay_synth_burst): moving / border error within
  +-1 %, colour hf -9 % (day).
- Tests: HybridSettingsTest (rejPool 1 sent), DevKeys (hybrid_rej_pool).

### P345 - gallery / viewer bugs on the X200 Ultra (owner, 2026-10-26: screen recording Screenrecording_20261026_163809.mp4 (10 s), build 5f32a380 CI, «на видео ты ещё видишь баг с галереей»):DONE in code (not yet tried on a phone).
- 0.0-1.5 s: gallery «Галерея» (Все 4524 / Camera 4522 / Raw 2) -> back to the camera: the viewfinder is black ~1.5 s (1.2 s frame) before
  the picture comes back (2.9 s).
- 3.0-5.2 s: the thumbnail opens the viewer (Сегодня 16:36, 35 мм, 13 Мп, JPEG) -> Удалить -> our sheet «Удалить снимок? Файл удалится с
  телефона...» -> Удалить -> then the SYSTEM dialog «Разрешить приложению SCAMERA удалить это фото?» (MediaStore delete request): a double
  confirmation; the system dialog's preview is grey at first (5.9 s), and behind it the viewer has already closed to the camera.
- 6.6-9.5 s: after «Разрешить» the camera viewfinder stays BLACK ~3 s before the picture returns (9.9 s).
- After the delete the bottom-left thumbnail still shows the deleted photo (the dark room shot) at 9.9 s: it is not refreshed to the
  previous photo.
- Fix: one confirmation only (when MediaStore.createDeleteRequest is needed, skip our own sheet or use the system one alone; app-owned
  files can be deleted without the system request); keep the viewer open on the next photo after the delete; refresh the thumbnail to the
  newest remaining photo (or clear it) when its file is gone; find why the camera session restarts black for 1.5-3 s after the gallery /
  the system dialog (onPause/onResume of the camera fragment closing the session? keep it, or show the last frame instead of black) -
  needs a log of the same sequence (SCAMERA-debug.log) to see the session timeline.
- Cause of the closing viewer / lost result / stale thumbnail / 3 s black: GalleryFileOperations.deleteImageFiles starts the system
  delete request with ActivityCompat.startIntentSenderForResult; P299's onUserLeaveHint rule (close the gallery when the user leaves it)
  knew only startActivityForResult as the gallery's own launch, so the system dialog finished the gallery under it (the camera came to
  the front behind the dialog, the result went nowhere). Fix: GalleryActivity.startIntentSenderForResult sets childLaunch too.
- One confirmation: GalleryFileOperations.needsSystemDeleteRequest (Android 11+, any file whose OWNER_PACKAGE_NAME is not this app): then
  the system dialog alone (no «Удалить снимок?» sheet); the app's own photos: the sheet, then ContentResolver.delete without the system
  dialog. Viewer and library fragments both.
- Black viewfinder on the way back: CameraFragment.freezeViewfinder (onPause: PixelCopy of the viewfinder at half size, waits <= 80 ms)
  and showFrozenViewfinder (onResume: an ImageView vfFreeze over the viewfinder until MainRenderer.shownTimestamp moves, or 4 s).
- Evidence: research/handoff/evidence/P345-x200u-gallery-delete-frames.jpg (every changed frame, 0.5 s step) and
  P345-x200u-gallery-delete-key-frames.jpg (1.2 / 2.9 / 5.2 / 5.9 / 6.6 / 7.0 / 7.5 / 9.9 s).

### P344 - rejection maps as clean as WhyCam's, motion still cut (owner, 2026-10-26: «Постарайся максимально насколько можешь улучшить реджект карты»; «Для режима "движения" сделай упор на максимальный захват движения»): DONE (harness + OPPO replays), not shot in the app.

  edited text alone changed Adreno's rounding): rejPool 2 / 3 (each 3 x 3 cell over its own tolerance; 3: the donor texture
  around its own bilinear sample), rejVarExact (the exact bilinear noise factor), rejMatchBlur (the base blurred as the donor's
  sample), rejPerChannel, rejRelFloor (model-error floor), rejMeanDiff / rejMeanTex / rejMeanFloor (3 x 3 means for smooth motion,
  a gain floor so flicker / AE steps are not motion), rejKneeLo / Hi (dead zone + fall to 0), rejBinLo / Hi, rejClipSym (inert on
  real bursts, keep off), rejNoiseCdm (its forgiveness rescale fixed after review). Shared-memory guide tile: reject +190 ms.
- App (PreferenceKeys, hybrid_rej_set 1): rejPool 3, rejVarExact, rejMatchBlur, rejPerChannel, rejRelFloor 0.004, rejMeanDiff 0.2,
  rejMeanFloor 0.015, rejPoolT 1.2, knee 0.05 / 0.8, dilateFloor 0.35 over the untouched slider default. The tuner's knee 0.1 / 0.6
  cut late hand-held frames on t100546's smooth wall into patches (review): 0.05 / 0.8 halves that (last 4 donors <0.1: r1 8.8 %,
  0.05/0.8 16 %, 0.1/0.6 20.7 %; whole frame cutoff 0.754 / 0.818 / 0.796); no knee at all lost the motion (night water caught

  water 0.60 -> 0.68, ghosts 2.8 -> 2.4 %, static day map 0.976).
- Harness (p342eval, 13 scenes) of the photo set vs rejPool 1: static day robust 0.89 -> 0.99 (cells <0.85 12.8 -> 1.4 %), lamp ghosts
  12 -> 4 %, night water ghosts 16.6 -> 11 %; known trade-off: moving thin wires caught 0.69 -> 0.57 (rejPool 1 also cut static
  wires), water_day ghost 2.5 -> 3.0 %. Real bursts (7): static flat 0.85 - 0.96 -> 0.94 - 0.99; sea / hand still black; isz2 window
  mesh with parallax and a door-bolt specular get more frames (review, small).
- Lab: raw / robust per donor min-pooled over the block (a point sample hid a rejected wire); 'cutoff' («Отсечение», WhyCam's

  speckle, and the long frames' by-design clip zeros drew a static window black); 'accepted' back to the mean weight.

### P351 - the gallery's photo editor, Lightroom-mobile basics (owner, 2026-10-26: «нам нужен редактор изображения в галерее с базовыми функциями как в мобильном приложении лайтрума»; «можешь взять за основу для функционала» LightCraft): BUILT, host-tested, not run on a phone.
- Entry: the viewer's «Изменить» opens `gallery/editor/PhotoEditorFragment` (gallery_nav_graph, no new activity, P299 untouched); a
  long press on «Изменить» or the editor's «Открыть в другом приложении» is the old ACTION_EDIT chooser (ExternalEdit, this gallery
  excluded). GalleryActivity also answers ACTION_EDIT image/* (start destination = the editor, RESULT_OK + the copy's URI).
- Tabs: Кадр (Свободный / Оригинал / 1:1 / 4:5 / 3:4 / 4:3 / 16:9 / 9:16, corner / edge handles, drag, pinch, rotate 90, flip,
  Выпрямить +-45 with automatic inset), Стили (8 looks + Сила), Свет (Экспозиция +-4 EV, Контраст, Света, Тени, Белые, Чёрные +
  Кривая: parametric regions with splits and point curves RGB / R / G / B), Цвет (Температура, Оттенок, Сочность, Насыщенность;
  Смешение 8 bands x Тон / Насыщенность / Яркость; Цветокоррекция shadows / midtones / highlights / global + blending / balance;
  Ч/Б with an 8-band mix), Эффекты (Текстура, Чёткость, Дымка, Виньетка + середина, Зерно + размер), Детали (Резкость + радиус,
  Шумоподавление яркости / цвета). Double tap resets a slider; undo / redo (EditHistory, 100 steps); «Сбросить всё», copy / paste of
  settings (crop excluded) in the menu; long press on the picture = «Оригинал»; live RGB histogram (a 160 px readback of the crop,
  at most every 120 ms); back with unsaved edits asks.
- State: `EditState` (sliders by Param, 4 point curves, quarter turns, flip, straighten, crop rect in the turned frame's 0..1,
  ratio) as JSON (defaults left out) in the saved instance state; EditorViewModel keeps the decode, the history and the export
  across rotation.
- GPU (OpenGL ES 3, own context: GLSurfaceView for the preview, EGL pbuffer for the export; shaders in assets/shaders/editor):
  demosaic (RAW, Malvar-He-Cutler) -> nr (5x5 bilateral luma + luma-guided chroma) -> develop (linear light: WB, camera / P3 matrix,
  exposure; log2 Y) -> gauss2 (sharpening + texture blurs) -> main (local tone from guided-filter bases of a 512 px proxy: clarity at
  1 %, shadows / highlights / dehaze at 4 % of the side; tone table; OkLCh colour stage; point curves) -> finish (crop / turn / flip /
  straighten, vignette after the crop, seeded grain on a lattice fixed in crop coordinates). Radii are fractions of the long side
  ("px at 4000"), so the export looks like the preview; crop drags only re-run finish. CPU reference of develop / main in
  EditMath (tests).
- Sources (EditSource): JPEG via BitmapFactory / BitmapRegionDecoder + EXIF orientation; HEIC / WebP / PNG / GIF / AVIF via
  ImageDecoder (preview in linear extended sRGB F16, export in the file's colour space, Display P3 through its matrix; whether the
  platform already turned it is measured against the gallery's Glide thumbnail); DNG via DngRaw (raw data, linearisation, black
  pattern + deltas, white, GainMap, ActiveArea / DefaultCrop, Bayer any phase, Quad -> half-size Bayer, LinearRaw), other RAWs via
  LibRaw (P352); Glide as the fallback. RAW = scene-referred: WB as CCT / Duv from AsShotNeutral through ColorMatrix /
  ForwardMatrix / CameraCalibration interpolated by 1/CCT (DngColor; Температура shows K and «Как снято»), clipped channels to
  neutral, a filmic shoulder with Белые as its white point, BaselineExposure + an automatic lift.
- Export (EditExporter): «Сохранить копию» = new `<name>_edit.jpg` next to the original (MediaStore RELATIVE_PATH, IS_PENDING; DCIM /
  Pictures only, else Pictures/SCAMERA; Android 8 / 9: a file + scan), jpegli q95 4:4:4, EXIF copied (dates, camera, exposure,
  lens, GPS, description) with orientation 1 and the new size; the viewer then opens on the copy. Tiles of 1024 output px, each with
  its source region + EditMath.overlapPx (NR + Gaussian + demosaic reach); one ARGB_8888 output of at most 64 MP (less when free
  memory is short) - 50 MP at full size, 200 MP scaled to the limit with a message; JPEG tiles by BitmapRegionDecoder (a
  power-of-two sample only past 4x the limit), other formats decoded once within the limit, RAW decoded again at full size (2x2
  binned past 64 M samples). Ultra HDR gain maps / HDR renditions are not carried over (SDR sRGB copy); the original is never written.
- LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0, used under MIT, commit bb08a697a41b2561a54f1b740245119503b24758): ported - the OkLCh colour stage of
  crates/pipeline/src/colorops.rs (vibrance with skin protection, saturation, 8-band mixer weights / scales, B&W mix, 3-way
  grading weights) and the parametric curve of curve.rs; written here - everything else (local tone, NR, sharpening, dehaze,
  vignette, grain, geometry, tone table, point curves, RAW colour). Notices: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, assets/licenses/LightCraft-MIT.txt.
- Files: gallery/editor/* (EditState, EditHistory, CropMath, EditMath, EditGl, EditRenderer, EditSource, EditExporter, EditorView,
  CropOverlayView, CurveView, EditSlider, EditHistogramView, EditPanels, EditPresets, EditorViewModel, ExternalEdit,
  PhotoEditorFragment), gallery/dng/DngRaw + DngColor (+ DngPreview parses the raw tags), assets/shaders/editor/*, icons
  ui_ic_crop / undo / redo / rotate / detail / effects / styles (tools/make_concept_icons.py), GalleryViewModel.showNewFile,
  ImageViewerFragment (entry, long press, select the copy), GalleryActivity (ACTION_EDIT), manifest.
- Checks: tests EditStateTest 8, CropMathTest 11, EditMathTest 12, DngRawTest 10, RawFormatsTest 4 (+ DngPreviewTest 5 and the
  gallery tests still green); glslc 12 / 12; check_ui_language, check_settings_model PASS; compileDebugJavaWithJavac, assembleDebug.
- Not on a phone yet (needs the owner's CI APK): GL on Adreno / Mali (RGBA16F / RGBA32F targets, R16UI upload), 60 fps while
  dragging, the ImageDecoder orientation probe, HEIC 10-bit / P3 colours vs the viewer, export of 50 / 200 MP (time, memory),
  MediaStore insert into another app's DCIM folder, ACTION_EDIT from another app, RAW colour vs Lightroom on SCAMERA / other DNGs.
- Later: masks, healing / retouch, lens corrections, a 1:1 zoom in the Детали tab, graphical colour wheels, HDR (gain map) export.

### P362 - RawTherapee «Inpaint opposed» for highlights without ultrashort frames (owner, 2026-10-27: «верни для пересветов там, где коротких кадров нет: одиночные кадры, «Движение», сцены, где Bento отказывается»; «считай на гпу»): DONE (host + OPPO), committed locally, not pushed.
- Before: the PhotonCamera port of opposed inpainting went with HighlightRecovery in P129 (a dead field rawClipLevel stayed);
  SHDR recovered every highlight with ScamRgb's per-channel recovery.
- Source: RawTherapee rtengine/hilite_recon.cc, highlight_recovery_opposed (GPL-3 like SCAMERA; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES). RT's
  chrominance sum compares with its tmp buffer, which holds the pixel's own value for an unclipped channel: always 0. Ported
  as darktable does it (the opposed reference at every counted pixel).
- GPU: hlrecovery/opposed (compute, 16 x 16 groups, a 3-pixel halo tile in shared memory, ~9.7 kB): white-balanced values,
  clip 0.987 of the channel's white-balanced clip, masks dilated by RT's pattern (|dx|, |dy| <= 3 without the corners),
  reference = the other two channels' 3x3 means in cube-root space, chrominance per channel from the pixels between clipdark
  (0.03 / 0.125 / 0.03) and the clip; group sums + packed counts to an SSBO, added on the CPU (ScamRgb.opposedMeans); tiles
  without a clipped channel skip it. scamhdr/scamrgb oppU: a clipped channel = max(value, reference + chrominance) on pixels
  without ultrashort content (clip flags bits 4 / 5 clear; without flags only when no ultrashort level), nothing else of the
  SCAM recovery there; plus the never-magenta rule (a clipped G at least min(R, B)): without it the blown lamp cores went
  lavender (G 1.78 vs R / B 1.86).
- Runs only when the clip flags hold such pixels (ScamRgb.opposedPixels on the side thread) or with no ultrashort level at
  all; a lab fragment takes the whole frame's chrominance (LabFrame.oppChroma). scam_dev.txt "hybrid_highlight_opposed 0" =
  the SCAM recovery there as before (DevKeys, post group).
- Checks: tools/check_highlight_opposed.py (in CI): GPU chrominance = numpy reference to 1e-7, reconstruction = reference
  (2e-3), Bento pixels and oppU 0 bit-identical, never lavender, warm lamp keeps R > B; synthetic lamp core error vs truth 0.51
  (SCAM 0.55, none 0.64). check_highlight_neutral / recovery / one_channel_off / signed_rgb PASS, glslc, fp16 check,
  ScamRgbOpposedTest. OPPO (31170 - 31172): the compute pass runs on Adreno 750 (125 -> 56 ms before the skip); on the lamp
  scene every clip had ultrashort content (opposedPixels 0): skipped. Real-data picture: lamp2324 merged with bento 0, its
  highlights through the shaders (deliverables/p362/opposed_lamp_no_ultrashort.png): neutral, like SCAM.
- Not shot on a phone without ultrashort frames (single frame / «Движение» need the UI).

### P364 - processing as fast as the reference app, without losing quality (owner, 2026-10-27: «закончи с ускорением обработки ... цель максимально приблизиться к Why камере по скорости обработки ... у нас меньше кадров ... должны быть даже быстрее»; «не потеряв в качестве»; «попробуй ускорить сделав своё выравнивание как второй вариант, но главное чтобы оно не уступало по качеству»; no push, decide alone; then «когда всё закончишь заливай на гит»): DONE (round closed, pushed).
- Replays had the GL program cache off (rp.sh never made its directory: cache 0/0, 1.9 s compiling); the app hits 13/13. Fixed in
  the session's rp.sh; all numbers below are with the cache. OPPO lamp2324, app tuning + P358 set, 26 frames: worker 4.35 s.
- Critical path (SCAM_LOG_MS): ultrashort row / tile tests 77 -> 422 ms (tile test ~0.3 s a frame, its grid field), CRE 422 -> 671,
  ultrashort registration until 929 (its base made by the first frame, the others waited), Shasta / Bento checks until 1220,
  GPU merge 1220 -> 3500 (blend ~0.44 s of it), plain chroma median ~0.23 s, output 0.1 s.
- Part 1 (md5-identical on lamp2324 73c811b0, b175757 90236115, x7u_1x 4f293aa9, isz2 6bd33bf4, led1934 ac3b0bed):
  - hybridUsRegister: the base's side made ahead from the alignment start (usRegBase under its lock; SCAM_US_BASE_LATE = before),
    blurs without a clamp inside the row and the vertical pass by rows (same sums, same order), sample lists per blur level,
    bilinear value + central differences from one set of weights (difference images: 12 reads instead of 20).
  - kHybUsBlend: stage 0 keeps per 16 x 16 output px tile the strip's largest clip mark (tile table behind the carry rows in slot
    10, stamped by the strip); stage 1 returns «no ultrashort colour» at once where no tile its disc reaches holds a mark and the cell
    weight is 0 - what the disc would have found (SCAM_BLEND_TILES_OFF = every disc read). Merge 2.23 -> 1.96 s.
  - Worker 4.35 -> 3.50 s (-0.85 s).
- Part 2: the forced Shasta frames' motion checks side by side (md5 as before; the GPU starts ~0.17 s earlier). F6 «auto» takes
  the GPU field on an Adreno (/dev/kgsl-3d0; SCAM_LA_AUTO_CPU = before): merge factors equal on all five bursts (lamp 0.7973,
  b175757 0.7241, x7u_1x 0.9353, isz2 0.8969, led1934 0.6191), PSNR 115 dB against the CPU field, 0.06 - 0.3 s faster on 4 of
  5 replays, 0.2 - 0.4 GB less memory, and the ~3.5 s of CPU time the streamed CPU field took in a shot left to the rest.
- Tried, no gain (reverted): the ultrashort frames in the first CRE group (md5 the same, registration CPU-bound beside CRE).
- Alignment: the existing SCAMERA tile alignment (SCAM_NO_CRE: global translation + F6) is worse than CRE (lamp merge factor
  0.7854 vs 0.7973) and not faster; CRE takes ~0.25 s of a replay, 0.6 - 0.7 s in a shot. CRE runs on the OPPO (bundled
  libvivo_nice_cre.so + stubs; «STOCK MOTION» lines in the app's log); where it cannot load the worker falls back to that tile
  alignment.
- Part 3: the plain path's ultrashort row / tile check (~0.35 s before the alignment) runs beside the merge (HybridInput::usPending):
  the merge goes on with the frames as captured, joins the check as soon as it is done (polled before each CRE group) or after
  the alignment; a check that changes the frames (row correction, refusal: led1934) throws HybridUsRestart and the checked input
  merges as before (its lines then; SCAM_US_CHECK_FIRST = before). md5 as before on all five bursts (led1934 through the restart);
  CRE starts at ~0.12 s instead of ~0.4 s; lamp -0.07..-0.14 s, led1934 equal within the noise.
- Part 4 (md5 as before on all five bursts: lamp2324 bf3fe915, b175757 6b9d2c91, x7u_1x beee6e3d, isz2 a7aac142, led1934 060e0e3b):
  - kHybReject (Adreno, pooled tests on): the donor's 4 x 4 cells read once, the 3 x 3 taken from them (16 reads a cell, not 25):
    reject 790 -> ~530 ms on lamp2324. A shared donor tile per group (16 x 16 cells) was slower (800 ms): not kept.
  - kHybCells: the fine tensor read straight from shared memory (the 64 floats copied per cell spilled): cells ~325 -> ~260 ms.
  - Post denoise (ScamDenoise laps under post_sync 1, «scam-denoise laps ms»): chromadn/noiseest holds three rows of its window
    (26 -> 5.5 ms, same bits on the OPPO), scamdn/stats medians by a pruned sorting network (61 -> 51 ms, same bits), the CPU
    sorts of estimateNoise / ScamDenoiseTables.reduce by selection (ShotSpeedBitExactTest: same bits as the sorts).
  - Two md5 of one worker on lamp2324 (bf3fe915 / aa6ad969, also 73c811b0 / 99fdf91f before P364): the plain chroma median runs on
    the GPU or, when free memory is short, on the CPU («cpu (size)»); not a race. chromaGpu 0 always gives aa6ad969.
  - Shots (31177, thermal none): total 5.1 - 5.4 s (31172: 6.42 s), merge 3.81 - 3.87 s (4.86), post 0.63 - 0.79 s, denoise
    0.21 - 0.31 s. The reference app: ~2.7 s.
- Part 5: the chroma median on the merged rows while the GPU merges (MosaicChromaOverlap without an oscillation map, fed after the
  RAW CA bands; the native mosaic path's overlap also where the GPU median ran): lamp2324 -0.33 s, isz2 -0.28 s. The CPU median's
  floats (as when memory sent it to the CPU before): CPU refs lamp2324 aa6ad969, b175757 b92ac70b, x7u_1x 6a66b0eb, isz2 61090d2e,
  led1934 1bbdbb29 (two md5 per burst before P364 = this GPU / CPU choice, not a race).
- Part 6 (md5 = the CPU refs): Mochi on the early context right after the corner tracker; the ultrashort blend weight 510 -> 350 ms
  (blurs without clamps, element loops on all cores), then in bands of 64 cell rows with a 16-row halo on one thread (the strips
  wait only for their rows); the bentoRamp recursion before the checks, usNeedClip scanned once. ~-0.2 s.
- Part 7 / 8: the worker's and the post pipeline's GPU contexts at medium priority (P57's low one: the shot's merge ~0.45 s slower
  than a replay). Shot merge 3.67-3.99 -> 3.46-3.54 s; viewfinder during the merge ~20 -> ~12 fps (largest gap ~0.25 s).
  SCAM_GPU_LOW_PRIORITY=1 / gpu_low_priority 1: low.
- Tried, not kept: the ultrashort frames' registration side made ahead (CRE slowed by as much: the CPU is saturated during the
  alignment), a shared donor tile in kHybReject (slower), dilate terms in shared memory and the base noise terms of rejPool 2 in
  shared memory (other md5, no gain), stats sub-block texels in registers (slower).
- Shots 31179 (OPPO, thermal moderate): total 4.80 - 5.12 s (31172: 6.42 s), merge 3.46 - 3.54 s, post 0.67 - 0.81 s.
- Where the rest goes (shot 31178): capture 0.38-0.40 s; worker start and checks 0.18 s; CRE + ultrashort registration + Shasta /
  Bento 0.9 s (CPU-bound, all cores busy); GPU merge ~2.0 s (merge kernel 0.55 s - not to be edited -, rejection 0.5, cells 0.26,
  blend 0.23, dilate 0.15, guide / chroma 0.14); post 0.65 s (denoise 0.25-0.3, WHY stats + early sharpen 0.14, ScamRgb 0.13-0.18,
  combine 0.08, fusion 0.06). The reference app: ~2.7 s. The gap is the per-pixel merge on 26 frames and the CPU front end; closing
  it without a quality change needs the merge kernel itself (P364 rule: untouched) or a GPU registration / Shasta.
- Status: parts 1-8 pushed with P362 / P363 (5538ae90); the round went on (owner, 2026-10-27: «пойми почему у Why гораздо быстрее
  чем у нас ... сделай так чтобы у нас была скорость такая же, либо быстрее», «для всех делай на ГПУ»).
- Why the reference app is faster (its 2.01 shaders and strings): everything on the GPU in one process - a homography per frame
  from 24 x 24 corners, single-level KLT and RANSAC on compute shaders, a per-frame accumulating merge in fragment shaders on
  textures (3 x 3 Bayer sites through the texture cache), a simpler rejection, the kernel covariance in a texture, zero-copy post.
  Ours had a CPU front end (corner tracker + ultrashort registration + Shasta / Bento checks ~1.1-1.4 s) before the GPU.
- Part 9 (gpuAlign 1, default; 2 = the corner tracker plus the GPU estimate and its distance as a report): the global alignment on
  the GPU (scam-la-gpu.h LaGpu homSubmit / homCollect): Shi-Tomasi corners on the base's L0 gray, a SAD search on L3 (+-12 px)
  with a GPU argmin, KLT L1 -> L0, adaptive RANSAC + least squares on the CPU (2 RAW px), two frames in flight; accepted with
  >= 60 inliers and >= 20 % of the tracks, else the corner tracker's fallbacks. F6 residual median 0.06-0.11 px (corner tracker
  0.13-0.33), merge factors equal or higher (led1934 0.619 -> 0.658), crops equal or better.
- Part 10: ultrashort frames first, then bracketed, then normal ones (their F6 field right after the homography, on its gray
  levels); the ultrashort registration skipped after a good homography (>= 100 inliers, rms <= 1.2 px; gpuAlignUsRegister 1
  keeps it); the Shasta motion checks and Bento masks start as soon as their frames are aligned; the GPU F6 field and alignment on
  every GPU (laGpu auto). A GPU failure falls back to the corner tracker for the whole burst (md5 = the old CPU-chroma refs).
- Part 11: the alignment's EGL context and programs made on the worker's warm-up thread while it waits for the burst.
  md5 refs at this point (app tuning + rejSkipUs 1, noiseRoles 1, shastaNoiseWeight 0.005): lamp2324 045ac410, b175757
  bf0595f8, x7u_1x 25f80add, isz2 43a730c1, led1934 b506f059. Shots 31185 (thermal none): total 4.71-4.85 s, merge 3.38-3.46 s.
- Part 12 (seven analyses wrote 26 bit-identical / rounding-level patches; each measured on the OPPO, alternating with HEAD):
  kept - the ultrashort blend's stages 1-3 on GPU-built 16 x 16 tile lists with one program per stage (blend 235 -> 93 ms), the
  cells pass taking a cell's colour from its tile's own quad + no dispatch for donors nothing reads + only the rows the reject and
  merge read, the dilate's accepted weight summed per work group. md5 the same on the five bursts, worker C++ checks 8/8; lamp2324
  replay merge 1896 -> 1730 ms, total 2678 -> 2512 ms (4 alternating runs). Not kept: reject restrict qualifiers / tile indices /
  laCell from the reject / zero exits (slower, or another md5), homography SAD by gathers, fused L0 start + LK, KLT gathers, field
  outputs without copies (alignment 514 -> 514-598 ms: no gain), strip transfers through unsynchronized maps (no gain).
- Viewfinder share (vfcost.sh, the same replay with the camera closed / our viewfinder open / the reference app's open): 2.51 /
  2.77 / 2.83 s - our RAW viewfinder already costs a parallel merge less than the reference one (P365 makes its stream and per-frame
  work like it anyway).

### P374 - a camera-wide bug audit and its fixes (owner, 2026-10-27: «запусти аудит/агентов по исправлению всех ошибок, багов и неисправностей в камере»; «решай и делай всё сам»): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone

  was fixed on its own branch, reviewed independently and polished; every fix has a test that fails with the fix undone.

  restart); LaGpuWorker answers its promise on a throw (a lost merge); homCollect's slot order (a frame got another's
  homography / was refused); usRegSkipped instead of a racy string read (TSan); the GPU memory guard counts 18.75 B/px with
  the GPU homography (measured 18.51); frames a failed GPU worker left take the global translation instead of the identity;
  the GPU alignment's thread names its crash stage (a crash there no longer turns the GPU merge off for the session). New
  checks: check_hybrid_us_pending (ASan + TSan), check_la_gpu_errors (-DSCAM_LA_GPU_FAULTS), check_hybrid_gpu_align (TSan,
  a GPU field fault mid-merge). Replay md5 of the 7 control bursts unchanged.
- Gallery / editor (15 + 2): the editor kept on rotation and on Home, the viewer keeps its photo on rotation, VIEW / PICK
  intents open the photo asked for, no double copy on export, leaks of the editor's DNG copies, back from the root library
  after a recreation leaves instead of relaunching, VIEW of video/* no longer claimed (no player), IMAGE_CAPTURE /
  STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA_SECURE entries checked.
- Capture / viewfinder (14 + 2): ETTR on the plain ZSL session (not only with the RAW viewfinder), reset per session and
  camera, held under the Motion mode's ceiling, the 4x-base-ISO ceiling judged on the un-boosted ISO (no oscillation); a
  queued shot keeps its press's rotation, characteristics, camera id and zoom crop (Parameters.camera(), cameraIdAtPress,
  ImageSaver.zoomResidual; FULLRES shots develop with their own session's characteristics, logged under SCAM_CAPTURE); the
  camera reopens after onDisconnected (split screen, a 3 s guard); the frozen viewfinder ends on the first RAW draw and
  ages by elapsedRealtime; latchIsp without an EGL context; the old SurfaceTexture released; the RAW viewfinder's halving
  buffers freed; the horizon stops polling when the window is hidden.
- Processing (5 + 2): GLTexture slots by slot (GLTextureSlots), the gain map's context no longer leaks Run()'s, a failed
  post pipeline above 16 MP / with HDR is closed, a low-memory kill or a crash in a named non-GPU stage is not a GPU-init
  death, a failed optional DNG leaves no partial file (the photo is still saved, a snackbar says so), the reference RAW is
  freed when a shot fails after the merge, a pass's output is taken before its samplers are bound (FilmHalation,
  ScamLocalContrast, ScamHdrDenoise).
- Settings / lab / app (5 + 8 + 3): antibanding «Авто» survives the second start (one-time migrations rerun after a
  reset); page reset covers the film / LUT / filter / style rows, disabled rows and the developer page; resets use the

### P369 - our algorithms out of the film simulation's way (owner, 2026-10-27: «Убедись что при включении симуляций плёнки наши алгоритмы не будут мешать симуляциям и в итоге у нас получался "Look" такой какой должен быть с ними»; «решай и делай всё сам»): DONE in code (host), not shot on a phone
- Audit (31 verified findings, the lead's plan A1-A11; owner decisions B1-B14 taken by the lead): the film took our display output
  through a fixed inverse (FilmSim.scene: display white = +5.5 EV, not three stops), so it got +0.3 .. +1.5 EV too much in the mid
  and upper tones and on top our fusion, AgX, macro, vibrance (vibrance_hl), film toe, HL landing, sun bloom, gamma, TONE_OP,
  contrast_boost / ccm_sat; our detail boost, clarity, digital luma grain and «Текстура» stacked on the film's own; the gain map
  undid its highlights; zoom / ISZ / lab fragments sized its grain for the uncropped field; the settings were read live per stage.
- A1: one film snapshot per shot (PostPipeline.takeFilm, before canDeferTeardown and Run; the lab's sides take it in Run under their
  overlay): FilmHalation.from / FilmGrain.from / WhyCombine / the gain map read it, never FilmSim.current() again.
- A2 (the core): why/combine FILM_SIM 1 - the film is fed scene light: the colour source at the luminance of the delta's base
  (whyLow's B-spline on the 2x grid), the full-size detail as the luminance ratio the delta stands for (its P311 / P315 / P349 guards
  kept, before the compression scaling), x ae x deficit x 0.184 / 0.15 (B1: the meter before the overflow cut; the AE grey at the
  film's mid grey), through FilmChain.scene (FilmSim.lutScene: 41^3 per-channel log grid, -10 .. +10 stops around 0.184; the B&W model
  at its own 0.18; the user .cube on the film's print; its own cache) - the print replaces our output (strength 1: outright; below
  it mix(ours, film, s)); under P3_OUT the sRGB print goes to P3 primaries (sRGB transfer). Also the RAW viewfinder (LiveWhyTone:
  FILM_SIM in the point / local / fused passes, the table in the P319 reuse key); the ISP viewfinder, the own-look RAW viewfinder,
  the settings' preview and the tray keep the display chain (B6). FILM_SIM unset: the shader token for token (check_film_sim 1).
  With the film alone (100 %) WhyCombine skips our highlight mask and sun bloom. Film data unreadable: PostPipeline.takeFilm builds
  the table and drops the film from the snapshot (logged), so the whole shot takes the path without a film (our look, the .cube,
  the gain map).
- A3 detail boost x (1 - s); A4 the guided filter's local contrast and the sharpening grain x (1 - s) (USM / bilateral / RL kept);
  A5 the digital luma grain x (1 - s) when the film adds grain; A6 «Текстура» off with a film; B10: any film. A7: the zoom's crop
  read once before the pipeline, Parameters.filmFrameScale (ISZ 4:3 share / zoom crop, set before the lab's snapshot and kept in
  it, so a lab render sizes the effects as the photo had them) and the lab
  fragment's whole-shot size -> FilmHalation.filmLongPx (the effects keep their size in the photo). A8: no gain map with a film
  (SDR file, "HDR off: film simulation"; post_ab follows the same gate). A9: the RAW viewfinder sets vibHlU (P301 parity; changes the
  viewfinder without a film too, not photos), and the P319 tone-reuse key holds the table, so a reused tone redraws once when a
  chosen LUT loads or its strength changes (without a film too). A10: FilmChain.lut builds a chain from its key (FilmSim.Settings.forLut), never from the settings now. A11: the
  preview shows the B&W stocks' grain and softness (FilmEffects.classic, FilmSim.SELWYN / GRAIN_SCALE / grainThrough shared with
  FilmGrain); its note says «примерно».
- Host (moderngl + the reference model, Portra 400 / Endura): grey ramp -8 .. +5 EV = the model at the nodes (0.00 / 255), the AE
  target prints 117.5 / 255 (the model's mid grey; Vision3 250D 117.4, Velvia 118.0 G, Gold 200 117.6), 10 colour patches max 1.21 /
  255; detail at f 2 (-1.9 / 0 / +1.5 EV bands): texture RMS 1.93 / 3.04 / 2.08 L* against the model's 1.96 / 3.08 / 2.04, mean
  within 0.16 L*; 2x grid 3.66 against 3.71 (a colour-grid base 5.08); above white +3 / +3.5 EV 0.21 / 0.08 against 0.38 / 0.20 (B12,
  left); P3 = sRGB for in-gamut colours; the table vs the engine max 2.03 / 255, mean 0.27 / 255. A7 (numpy model): the grain's
  autocorrelation half width at a 2x zoom crop + Lanczos-2 upscale +4.2 % against 1x (+101 % sized for the uncropped field).
- Checks: check_film_sim.py 7/7 (CI GPU step), check_shader_fp16 81 PASS, check_colour_output --shader --strict / --gl,
  check_film_lut, check_vf_fused, check_colour_look, check_tone_ops, check_why_sharpen, check_luma_grain, check_settings_model,
  check_ui_language PASS; :app:testDebugUnitTest 1889 tests, 0 failures (new FilmChainTest, FilmGatesTest,
  WhyCombineUniformParityTest in the CI list).
- Risks (the owner sees them): film photos print what the model prints - the AE grey at 117 / 255, upper mids up to ~11 L* darker
  than before, no HDR flattening (B3), our «Цвет» rows bypassed (B4); s < 1 with a user .cube: the .cube on the film share only;
  outside-sRGB colours clipped in the film share under P3; the ISP viewfinder differs more from the photo (B6).
- Review (three independent reviews: no-film identity - 512 define sets token-identical to d343cf9e -, film fidelity, routes) and
  fixes:
  - edges (blocker): the delta's ratio is measured on the bounded reference (min(m Y, 1), with the P311 / P349 rim guards) while the

    (exact below the bound, the full-size merge's at and above it): edges and bars <= 0.3 L*, above-white texture 0.41 / 0.21 against
    the model's 0.38 / 0.20 (B12 resolved); check_film_sim part 7 (dark edge / 2 px bar against 1.5 / 3 / 8 x the bound, sharpU 0 / 1,
    fullInput 0 / 1, f 2 and f 4: 0.9 % max; the old tap fails it 178 times); a non-finite whyLow tap takes the colour's own.
  - grid (major): -10 .. +6 stops kept a saturated light's colour above +6 that the model bleaches (Portra up to 89 / 255 off, p99 50);
    now -10 .. +10 at 41 points (half a stop a node as before): Portra / Vision3 all colours max 2.4 / 2.5 / 255, above +6 0.8 / 1.3;
    FilmSimTest.saturatedLightAboveMidGreyMatchesTheEngine. Build 0.37 -> 0.63 s (host), table 0.41 MB.
  - B1: WhyAe.filmAe - the film's exposure (ae x deficit) within the noise clamp and the x9 cap our ae obeys.
  - the RAW viewfinder eases the film's exposure as its own ae (a cut that came and went pumped the film by up to +0.7 EV);
    FilmChain caches the film's own table apart from the .cube (a LUT-strength step only composes); queued viewfinder loads of
    settings already left return at once.
- A12: SettingsAvailability - with a film at 100 % the rows it replaces are greyed with «С плёночной симуляцией на силе 100 % не
  действует …» (below 100 % they act on our share and stay open): macro contrast, AgX (incl. «Насыщенность») / ACES / Uchimura /
  own curve, gamma, film toe, contrast_boost, hl_soft / hl_white, ccm_sat, vibrance, the fusion rows (smart / weights /
  centre / smoothness / coarse), the guided filter's local contrast and grain, every «Цвет» row but warmth, tint, the kept scene
  light and the calibration (the colour matrix: they act on the film); «HDR-фото» and «Текстура» say they are off with any film.
  PhotoStyle: a stock is «Плёнка» (before the B&W filter, whose look the print replaces); «Обычный» / «Ч/б» take the stock off and
  remember it; «Плёнка» brings back the last stock with the LUT it had (or the last LUT alone, as before). ColourSettingsTest,
  PhotoStyleTest.
- Not done (decided not now): B7's «Ч/б» = the last B&W stock, B8 (scan USM), B9, B14; A4's host MTF check (camera blur + scatter +
  sharpening at gfLc 0); A11 (b). The RAW viewfinder runs WhyAe without the Bento hold, so in bright Bento scenes a film photo can
  print up to log2(1 / aeC) brighter than the viewfinder showed (as ours). Phone: film shots (Portra / Vision3, daylight, interior,
  sunset, night, lamps and LEDs at night) against the settings' preview and the RAW viewfinder.

### P371 - processing another ~2 s faster without a quality change (owner, 2026-10-27: «Очень внимательно изучи нашу камеру и пойми как мы можем ускорить обработку ещё на 2 секунды, при этом чтобы это не влияло на качество»): DONE in code (branch speed-2s; host md5 + tests), not phone-tried
- Where the time went (owner's X8U log of 31132, the first shot after an install, ultrashort restart, diagnostics on: 6.98 s;
  the OPPO X7U in steady state, P365: 4.16 - 4.32 s): failed ultrashort homographies registered inline on the alignment thread
  (354 + 276 ms) while the ultrashort check beside them took 1.38 s and then restarted the merge; Mochi of the 3 L frames before

  first shot after an install (836 ms); diagnostics on the processing thread (begin 182 ms, 02-after-ivst ~90 ms); the app waiting
  for the worker's exit (89 - 105 ms) and then a pread of the result (36 - 54 ms on the host); the worker spawned only after the
  frames' preparation (~50 ms + its GPU set-up); the output planes' fresh pages on one core at the merge entry (100 - 135 ms on
  the host) and the whole RGB's half fill after the merge (44 ms of output write at 12 MP on the X8U).

    frames restarts the merge before any registration ran), else on a thread of its own; kept / dropped and handed to F6 exactly

  - diagnostics off the processing thread: begin()'s Bayer preview on a helper during the merge, buffer()'s conversion on the

    result it takes), cancelled when the merge unwinds (SCAM_MOCHI_GPU_LATE; SCAM_MOCHI_LATE: none ahead). 0.12 - 0.24 s.
  - the result read at «SCAM CAPTURE OK», the worker reaped off the path (WorkerCompletion; the burst kept before the line)
    (ok_read 0). 60 - 100 ms.
  - the worker spawned at the shutter for the shot's arena, its go byte after the header: OFF by default after the review

  - the output planes sized on a helper while the GPU starts (up to 16 MP, not native; SCAM_OUT_SYNC). 40 - 80 ms.
  - the RGB halves streamed into the app's memfd during the merge: the plain sink's finished rows (hybridFinalRowsHook, a commit

    1 - 2 ms).

    for a phone A/B). 0 as shipped (0 - 150 ms at nice 0, unmeasured).
  - the result read in place: the memfd adopted as an arena, the RGB and the clip flags its views (Allocator.arenaAdopt), the
    read trailers' pages given back (arenaPunch) (zero_copy_read 0). 15 - 38 ms (host pread 36 - 54 ms, mapping 3 - 6).
  - small: the RGB log stats folded into the half fill (SCAM_RGB_STATS_PASS, 10 - 16 ms), the F6 context freed on its thread

### P370 - the colour correction matrix: study, fixes and improvements (owner, 2026-10-27: «займись в целом изучения работы с color correction matrix, займись исправлением и улучшением его работы»; «решай и делай всё сам»): DONE in code (host), not shot on a phone
- Kept as intended (not a defect): the ISP route's diagonal sensorToProPhoto = diag(1 / n) with CCT.matrix = the HAL transform's rows
  normalised; P368's clip guard (scamrgb / chanprep ceilingShare / ceilingGuard) works on white-balanced camera RGB upstream of every
  matrix, so a route only has to map white to white (B5).
- B1: README.txt of a diagnostic capture and the log name the colour chain: the uploaded intermediateToSRGB, cameraToLinearSRGB,
  Parameters.colourSource (enum, set on every branch) and why, sceneCct with its source and Duv, the colour frame's ts / ISO /
  AWBFrameControlCCT / transform / det, the newest N frame's neutral and transform, the camera's DNG colour tags as rationals and the
  placeholder flag; DngCreator logs the ForwardMatrix1 it writes. tools/check_ccm_chain.py: the shipped why/low.glsl on the owner's
  X8U block means, p90 0.0017 / 0.0012 ln (without the matrix 0.06 / 0.12).
- A5: ReCalcColor never loses a shot on missing / singular tags (no illuminant 1: D65; one calibration: the first CM / CC / FM; a
  zero FM: the other; the estimate and the chain in try/catch: unknown light, the shape-tested transform or the white balance alone,
  IDENTITY_FALLBACK); the legacy FM1 == FM2 / «Захват» branch refuses only a transform with a row summing to about 0 (|sum| < 0.25:
  inf after the row normalisation; review: the colour-matrix shape test refused HAL transforms with a folded-in gain it took
  before); normalize() keeps a row summing to ~0; the neutral read with green 1; Converter takes the DNG SDK's kelvin for a code it
  lacks; DcpProfile reads code 1 (daylight) as 5500 K (was 6504 K: a DCP labelled 1 renders with the 5500 K calibration now).
- A1: the scene light and the FM / CC weight from the DNG SDK's white estimate (DngColor.forCamera: each ColorMatrix normalised as one,
  xy iteration, CCT / Duv, the SDK's illuminant kelvins). |Duv| > 0.025: the scene light is unknown (0); the calibration keeps the
  estimate's weight (review: the daylight one switched the chain at the guard; the DNG SDK has no guard). A white the matrices cannot
  place (singular step, XYZ sum <= 0) is "no light", not a silent D50 read as 5000 K. Both colour matrices placeholders (the Pixel 7:
  CM2 = XYZ -> sRGB, CM1 x XYZ(A) = 1, 1, 1; the spec estimate gives |Duv| 0.033 - 0.038 at real neutrals): the former estimate, said
  in its source. PHY110 camera 2: 2856 / 3200 / 4000 / 5000 / 6504 K read 2861 / 3202 / 3999 / 5009 / 6505 K (row-normalised before:
  5068 / 5508 / 6455 / 6503); X200U tungsten 2855 K. The X8U: its matrices as the old log printed them (row-normalised, the artefact
  A1 removes) give Duv 0.054, no light; what the phone's raw matrices give is not known (their row scales: the B1 "DNG colour tags"
  line, C1) - the DNG estimate if they pass the guard, else the AWB label (B7), else D50. ISP-route matrices bit for bit (61fbd24d's
  golden arrays); scam_dev dng_white_spec 0 = before. The daylight weight (daylightWeight2) only where the estimate fails.
- A3: placeholder (sRGB -> XYZ) forward matrices (X8U cameras 2 / 4, Pixel 7) known on every shot: a shot ending on them takes the
  shape-tested result transform, the plain table, the frame's OPPO matrix, the colour matrices alone (DNG_CM_ONLY), else the
  placeholder with a warning; the DNG camera profile drops placeholder FMs beside real CMs.
- A6: «Источник цвета» is disabled (with its reason) only where the choice never acts - the X7U's tuned matrix, placeholder forward
  matrices; on vivo / any phone whose preview transform is an ISP matrix it stays enabled (review: the choice acts on mosaic shots
  with the app's own white balance and on «Захват»; a saved 0 / 2 could not be changed back) and its summary says the 12 MP photos
  take the ISP matrix. Its default stays 1 (settings_rows_frozen.tsv: the same value, the renamed resource). A7: SceneIlluminant gets
  the physical camera.
- A4: Camera2ApiAutoFix.ApplyRes no longer writes the viewfinder's neutral / transform into CaptureController.mCaptureResult (a
  single-frame or no-N shot rendered with the viewfinder's colour; a queued shot's metadata could be rewritten); its missing dynamic
  black level is the shot's characteristics' pattern (ScamProcessor's), not the camera open at processing (review).
- A2 / B4 / B6 (viewfinder only): every RAW viewfinder stream takes the photo's matrix rules (processing/color/PhotoMatrix: rows
  normalised, the X7U tuned matrix, the frame's com.oplus.custom.ccm, the plain table on mosaic streams); its «Цвет» look takes the
  frame's scene light and the tuned AgX saturation 1.1; a mosaic stream whose ISP runs no 3A (X200U ISZ lease, frozen R 2.434 /
  B 1.569) shows the photo's own neutral (ViewfinderMosaicWb, scam_dev vf_mosaic_wb, default 1; HAL gains logged every 5 s). Review:

### P377 - ETTR as light, not gain; the tray's open / close without the parent's fades (owner, 2026-10-28: a video «Исправь анимацию открытия и закрытия подменю … Оно мигает при открытии и закрытии»; «ETTR вообще не работает, разницы никакой нет что в ручных, что в авто»; log c03f8767, X200 Ultra build f118c571): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- Tray: camera_container (and textureHolder) has animateLayoutChanges: its LayoutTransition faded the tray in on VISIBLE (an empty
  plate flashed before TrayMotion's own rise) and out on GONE after TrayMotion's exit (the content went, the empty plate sank, the
  whole tray came back and faded again). TrayMotion.setShown switches the tray's visibility with the parent's four transition types
  off for that one change (on again at once: the rest of the screen keeps its fades); the exit is one fade of the tray (sink,
  shrink, fade) instead of per-child fades followed by the tray's. LutTrayTest.openingAndClosingSkipTheParentsLayoutTransition
  (a LayoutTransition recording showChild / hideChild; fails on the old code with [appear:tray, disappear:tray]).
- ETTR, the owner's log (13:29:43-51, ETTR on, one shot): the AE at 8.333 ms ISO 1883 throughout, the plan N=8.333ms*ISO1883, no
  "ETTR boost" line, only "ETTR held: off" at the end. Causes: (1) the boost was an exposure compensation only - the vivo HAL's AE
  keeps 1/120 s indoors and answers it with gain (no light; the 4x-base-ISO rule meant to stop that read the declared base 1144 of
  the X200 Ultra, so it did not); (2) the tail metered was the 99.9th percentile of the brightest channel: a lamp in the frame
  clipped it and every meter put the boost at 0 (P356's own OPPO note: «indoor lamp scene p99.9 0.997-1.000 -> boost 0 as
  intended»; for this scene not provable - (4)); (3) a hand-set ISO held it entirely; (4) nothing logged the meter's reading.
- DONE: capture/Ettr + CaptureController.ettrMeter + ParamController. The automatic exposure: the AE's own shutter (a settled AE
  frame without a boost, Ettr.learnRef) x 2^boost - at most one ring frame (1e9 / the viewfinder AE range's top: 33.3 ms at [20, 30])
  and the HAL's motion-safe exposure (HalMotion), whole mains half periods where the AE's shutter is one (8333326 ns -> 16.67 / 25 /
  33.3 ms, 10 ms -> 20 / 30 ms), boosts under 0.3 EV not taken - as shutter priority (ParamController.setEttrShutter: the camera's
  priority AE, the Qualcomm vendor priority, else the P82 viewfinder loop, each with its miss fallback), the compensation +boost so
  the AE keeps the ISO; the loop learns its target at the AE's exposure and brightens by the boost after (evStops + ettrEv). A
  clipped tail starts over from the AE (a new reference). With the ISO set by hand: the compensation, which the panel's free shutter
  takes, within one ring frame judged without the boost (Ettr.shutterHeadroomEv; the capture-ettr-oscillation test re-done on it).
  Held (Ettr.hold): the switch, the own native AE, a vivo SDK session, «Движение» (mode or ceiling), a hand-set shutter, the forced
  stabilisation; a hold the owner can change said once on the screen (Lang.t). The tail: the brightest 0.5 % of the quads with the
  ultrashort frames planned (bento != 0), else 0.1 %. Every 2 s while it runs a "ETTR meter:" line (tail, shutter, ISO, AE shutter,
  ceiling, wanted / in force). A new session, the camera closing and the console hiding drop the ETTR shutter (clearEttr / the panel's
  reset; the meter starts over). The stamp: the shot's plan carries " | ETTR +1.0" / " | ETTR ✗ code" (HybridPlan.withNote, the hybrid
  and 50 MP plans), MergeStamp's third line (codes man / mm / nae / sdk / stab / room / clip / hi / band / wait).
- Review round (an independent read of the diff): (1) the viewfinder loop brings the boost late (learn, then 2/3 steps 0.2 s apart):
  metered against the boost asked for, a frame not yet brightened asked for more, overshoot, clip, 0 - pumping; now the auto path
  judges a frame by its own exposure (Ettr.actualEv: shutter x ISO against the AE reference's), the ISO-by-hand path meters only
  once the free shutter held still for ETTR_STILL_FRAMES (12); (2) a tap / the 3A reset / unlockFocus wrote AE on over the loop's
  AE-off request (the compensation alone, as gain): ParamController.ettrLoopOverridden -> the meter starts over; (3) the reference
  goes with a boost dropped to 0 (and with the ISO kept: a scene darker or brighter moves the shutter); (4) a target learned again
  under the boost (the RAW / ISP meter switch) learns with it (loopFresh), not twice; the compensation is set before a longer
  shutter, after a shorter one. Not done: the 50 MP PSL plan's no-plan branch carries no ETTR note (a vivo SDK session holds ETTR).
- Second review round (a workflow: four reviewers, each finding put to a skeptic; 12 found, 7 held): (a) the viewfinder loop at the
  AE's lowest ISO (its start cannot lower the ISO by the boost) or started from frames the compensation had brightened learned the
  boosted brightness as the AE's and added the boost again - clipped, then pumping: ParamController.setEttrShutter takes the AE's
  exposure (Ettr.refProduct) and a new / relearning ETTR loop learns its target with the boost it already holds counted; (b) judged
  by its own exposure, the AE's answer to a darker scene (its ISO) went into the boost and the compensation both (+2, clipped) or a
  brighter one stuck a stop under the target: the frame's own exposure (actualEv) is gone, only settled frames are metered
  (ettrSettled: the AE converged, or the exposure still 12 frames - the loop, the ISO set by hand) and judged against the boost in
  force; (c) a ceiling that came down under the boost (the HAL's motion-safe exposure, the range) is enforced under the minimal step
  too. Tests: the lowest-ISO loop (no second boost), frames on their way with a moving ISO not metered, a darker scene keeps +1, a
  lower ceiling enforced, the range's 60 fps ceiling (16.67 ms: the test no longer passes with a hard-coded 33.3 ms), a moving free
  shutter not metered with the ISO set by hand.
- Tests: EttrTest (the owner's 8.33 ms scene -> 16.67 ms +1 EV, half periods, the ring-frame cap, the shutter headroom without the
  boost and its no-pumping run, the 0.5 % tail past a lamp, the holds), EttrSessionTest (the plain session's shutter priority and the
  AE again when off / closed, one ring frame, the owner's scene and a lamp switched on, the loop brightening by the boost, ISO by hand
  through the compensation, a hand-set shutter held), MergeStampTest.ettrLine.
- Needs a phone: does the X200 Ultra honour the Qualcomm shutter priority (log "priority shutter: the Qualcomm vendor priority
  (ETTR)" without "gives ... the next way") or does the loop hold it; the ring frames at 16.7 - 33 ms indoors (hand shake per frame,
  the merge's sharpness); the viewfinder's brightness with the boost (ISP: display gain; RAW: its own meter); the photo's noise with
  ETTR on / off in the same scene.

  reference app's photo beside ours of the same view, a sun shot of ours, SCAMERA-debug_2.txt (build f118c571, OPPO PKJ110 = Find X8
  Ultra, camera 0) and a Google Drive link to the burst (drive file 1REmnCewg22LxN2rMsxQsswa-S3JrXBUs, shared by the owner after a
  sign-in wall): NCH v12, 1.66 GB, 4096 x 3072 RGGB, white 1023 / black 64, 26 frames - 20 N at ISO 100 (ring, -633 .. 0 ms), 3
  long x2 at ISO 200, 3 ultrashort x0.175 at ISO 100. Host replay (llvmpipe, app tuning): «HYBRID BENTO: applied (success)», md5
  635a02c2 - the input for this item's lab / host A/B (the WHY tone and its sky term on it, before / after).
- Side by side (reference first): its clouds neutral grey-white with modelled darker bases, the blue gaps a medium blue, the sky
  as a whole darker than ours; the buildings, trees and ground clearly brighter (shadows lifted, lower global contrast), colours
  neutral. Ours: clouds cream / lavender-pink (the top left lavender, the right warm), flat and bright, a softened glow over them,
  the blue paler; the ground much darker. I.e. our tone spends the range on the sky's brightness and leaves the shadows low; the
  reference keeps the sky down (cloud modelling) and lifts the shadows.
- The sun shot (debug_2, 11:56:55): «hybrid plan: N=0.113ms*ISO100 clip=0.0061 ... us skipped (sensor floor)» - the N frames at
  the sensor's shortest exposure, no ultrashort frames possible (stamp «ES ✗ floor | L ✓3»); WHY: p50 0.0098, p98 1.35, p995 4.0,
  ae 1.985, deficit 2.52. The sun's disc and its halo clipped in every frame: a pink / orange ring around the sun (the clipped
  halo's colour inpainted from its warm rim and the lens flare). Part of this item: a clipped region with no ultrashort data at
  all (the floor, a refused Bento) keeps a neutral core and a neutral ramp out of it (P376's eased core, wider), not a hue.

  sky (64 px block std of Y 0.011 - 0.013: little cloud modelling); the bright clouds warm (sRGB R-G +0.04 / +0.05, B-G -0.04 / -0.05:
  a cream / lavender cast at the top left), the blue gaps pale (0.65 / 0.72 / 0.80). The ground dark under it (the WHY tone holds
  the sky up and leaves the shadows low).
- Approach (to verify against the reference photo first): a sky term in the WHY tone - a soft sky mask (bright, low texture, upper
  frame, connected to the top edge; no faces, no lamps) that lowers the sky's tone (more of the highlight range for the clouds),
  local contrast in the clouds (the pyramid fusion's highlight band), clouds held neutral (the warm / lavender cast: the white
  balance and the matrix on near-clipped cloud whites, see the opposed-highlight path of P368 / P376), the blue gaps' saturation;

  then come from the N frames alone).

При этом чтобы никто из них не пострадал и результат не ухудшился»): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone

  kHybCells (P364 own-quad fill) vs kHybCellsPlain, the blend's per-stage programs (P364), the blend's GPU-built tile lists (P364),
  the shared-memory reject / dilate (P76 SHARED_TILES); the F6 field is on the GPU everywhere since P364 (auto); the app side's
  RGBA32F upload (P48) is a format choice. Logs: X300 Pro (Mali-G1-Ultra, e8100faa, 15 shots) every merge program compiled and ran,
  «HYBRID LOCAL ALIGN: GPU», «stats=gpu» - the same stages as the X200 Ultra's Adreno 830; the chroma median's CPU / GPU split is
  the shot's (still vs hand-held, P364), not the vendor's. The only Mali CPU path was P376's: the G925 compiler's crash -> the GPU
  merge off -> «cpu-single».
- DONE: kHybCells, the blend's stage programs (named blend0 - blend4 now) and its tile lists on every GPU (tuning cellsPlain 1 /
  blendStages 0 / blendLists 0: the same-result builds). The shared-memory reject / dilate stay Adreno-only: P77's Mali-G57 timings
  with them: dilate +20 %, reject slower - the plain ones are Mali's faster GPU code (no CPU, same result to float rounding, P76).
  A driver death on a same-result variant (ScamHybridBurst.SAME_RESULT_STEPS: «own-quad cells», «blend stage programs», «blend tile
  lists»; the worker marks «GPU merge (blend lists)» around their dispatches) leaves that variant out for good on this build of the
  phone and the app (prefs scam_gpu_learned: Build.FINGERPRINT + versionCode; a system or app update tries again), and the prewarm
  worker learns it before any shot (ScamNeuralClient.prewarmRun: a signal exit -> learnFromPrewarm; its tuning carries what was

  the blend's 5 stage programs and lists ran) md5-identical against HEAD (the old Mali path: cellsPlain, one blend program, every
  pixel), the fallback tuning likewise; and the owner's real 26-frame sky burst of P378 (OPPO Find X8 Ultra 4096 x 3072, 20 N + 3
  long + 3 ultrashort, «HYBRID BENTO: applied», blend0 - blend4 compiled) 635a02c2 on both. ScamHybridBurstCrashTest (blend stages / lists steps), ScamHybridLearnedTest (kept for the

### P380 - the film simulation against Unspektrawesome's SPEKTRA (owner, 2026-10-28: «Займись симуляцией плёнки, она у нас не работает как должна. вот тебе парный пример, снято на нашу камеру и на unspektrawesome на одинаковых настройках симуляции пленки»; https://github.com/EkinStrop/Unspektrawesome-Releases/releases; after P378 and the window burst; delivered with P378): DONE in code (host), not shot on a phone
- The pair (a cabin: ceiling light top left, a map and a muster list on a beige wall, a black chair): ours (0973434c) crisp and
  contrasty, the lamp a hard clipped patch, saturated digital colour; theirs (0a5c263a) a film look - a wide halation / bloom around
  the lamp and the bright paper, softer micro-contrast (diffusion), a creamier, more muted palette, gentler highlight roll-off.

  through our print and re-rendered on their recipe (read from their JPEG: Portra 160, Endura Premier, IMAX 70, Pro-Mist 2.0,
  halation and softness 0, DIR couplers 0) through our own FilmSpectral comes within ΔE76 2.8 / RMS 7.7 of theirs (with their -1.8 EV

  recipe (our only diffusion is the lens filter, off by default and sized for 36 mm; DiffusionModel is already spektrafilm's

  a «Цветоразделение (DIR)» slider 0 - 100 % (review) with the default 100 % (today's colours; their app's recipe had 0 %); 65 mm and IMAX 70;
  the format's grain blur; the full recipe in the photo's EXIF description; licence notices for the spektrafilm parts (GPL-3.0);
  nothing from the Unspektrawesome app. Not film: their vignette (their lens shading) and their brighter capture exposure.

  quad - so the loss test missed it and the black became the darkest green block's mean, 24.06 DN («data floor (24.0625)»). Red and
  blue lost ~24 DN (71 % of the merged red negative), x2.41 white balance and the CST made the mid tones teal. The CFA phase, the
  neutral (within 2 - 3.5 %) and the CST are right. The native chroma median ran on the over-subtracted data (the shadows' speckle).

  a lost pedestal without deep shade still gives 7 - 40 DN, the samples' floor under-subtracts a partly lost pedestal (magenta), a
  non-zero strip would read as a loss.

  clears it; the samples' floor only when <= 3 DN (x white / 1023) and >= 3 blocks hold 1/16 of their samples there; whole edge

  19.9, kept + a 1..4 strip 64 / 64 / 64, drift to 60: 64 everywhere. Replay of the owner's shot: worst grey patch 29.8 % -> 2.4 - 3.8 %.

### P415 - colour clumps in the deep shadows with long frames (owner, 2026-10-30, OPPO Find X8 Ultra, SCA_20261030_102648: «Вот такие
артефакты есть на некоторых телефонах из-за шаста кадров ... И есть они только с shasta кадрами»): DONE in code (host replays), not
tried on a phone
- Cause: the noise check's single factor is measured on flat blocks above 0.002 of white (x0.54 on this burst); the flat blocks
  at or below it (median 0.0011) measured 2 x that model, the read term ~6.7 x low. The reject took the long frames' noise
  difference there for motion and refused them in random 1 - 2 cell spots: N-frame noise in clumps inside the long frames'
  cleaner surround (shadow tile-noise spread 0.40 against 0.13 without L).
- Fix: hybridMeasureNoise also gives the deep shadows' point (median level and noise / model of the flat blocks <= 0.002, >= 50
  of them); hybridDarkReadK turns it into the read factor that meets it on the pair's header model (never below the single factor,
  at most 16 x); noiseU (the reject and guide noise) adds that read term below darkReadLo 0.002, fading out at darkReadHi 0.004.
  The merge kernel and the motion map keep the single factor. Worker key noiseDarkRead (default 0), the app sends 1; scam_dev
  "hybrid_dark_read 0" = before. Check: tools/check_hybrid_dark_noise.cpp.
- Replays with the app's full tuning: the owner's burst shadow noise 9.2e-5 -> 6.4e-5, its spread 0.40 -> 0.30, the clumps gone in
  the radiator crops; vivo m014303 (moving hand in the dark, x3.0) and m234300 (x6.6): nothing above 0.004 changes, the hand's
  teal patch (an object in the N frames at 0.0045) keeps its shape.
- Measured and not taken: the read factor for the whole merge or the whole reject (no level limit) - the same clumps gone, but a
  hard-edged hand ghost from the long frames on m014303; the app's denoise model with the read factor (this shot's SNR 130 picks
  the day tier: colour strength 0.25 on levels 0 - 1, nothing coarser - no effect on 8 - 16 px clumps); dilateFloor 0.6 / dilateOffset
  1 (a third / a tenth of the effect); a 4 x 4 block-group motion test (missed the ghost, 40 % false blocks on the LED burst).
