### P422 - motion capture and sharpness priority (owner, 2026-10-30: «Делаем это всё», «Приоритет максимальной резкости»): DONE in code and basic capture on OPPO PHY110
- Motion is N-only in every HybridPlan constructor, including manual / FULLRES fallback. Old Bento / Shasta settings and
  developer overrides cannot enable brackets in this mode. Photo keeps its own settings.
- Capture v2 anchors the newest eligible ring frame minus two, keeps that base through processing, and limits older donors
  to 64 RAW pixels of measured displacement (16-250 ms). No new frames are requested for a usable ZSL ring. An empty ring
  still uses the existing N-only post-shutter fallback; this fallback cannot provide a pre-shutter anchor.
- Subpixel flow is checked even at zero integer displacement. A reliable focus / face tile can represent a small moving
  subject. Thumbnails cover the full CFA period for Bayer / Quad / Tetra. Measurement freshness uses source-frame time,
  accounts for sensor-relative lag, and never subtracts an absolute sensor timestamp from the host clock.
- Motion exposure takes priority over mains flicker and the ISO ceiling (noise / underexposure allowed). Row-band amplitude
  remains measured after flicker has latched. This does not guarantee band-free LED/display photos.
- Sharpness rejection now applies to 8/4/2-frame bursts, protects the base, and uses a threshold of at least 0.85 of the
  base/positive-median score. Rejected areas retain more luma detail in resolve and pyramid denoise; chroma filtering stays.
  Single-base / short merges use absolute coverage when available. No changes to kHybMergeMain1 or sensor modes.
- The Motion policy is frozen at the press and carried through ImageSaver / DefaultSaver into a thread-local processing
  scope, released in finally. Switching Motion off while a shot processes cannot change that shot or the camera thread.
- Hidden rollback keys: motion_capture_v2 and motion_sharp_priority, both default on. They are listed in the developer UI.
  A file-based A/B override was not observed taking effect on this phone, so no device A/B quality claim is made.
- Host: 164 targeted Java tests pass; settings model and motion / ms-denoise / protected-merge GPU checks pass. Full CI-selected
  suite: 2266 tests, four EditorViewModelTest failures reproduced unchanged on main 5582cfbd on Windows. Tests were not disabled.
- Device: local QA APK 31193, SHA-256 d88621f2220e582b7a4af849f958da83fe8b3e2156553bdc010508a06f03bce1. PHY110,
  serial fb27034c, camera 2: actual base 988701 ns at ISO 6400, N-2 anchor, futureRequests=0, bracketed=0, ultrashort=0,
  successful JPEG SCA_20261030_193426.jpg. Fast display motion retained one frame; a prior capture retained two.
  Switch-off during processing also saved SCA_20261030_194722.jpg with Motion denoise retained.
  No claim of 8/4/2 queue behavior or Quad / Tetra quality validation on this phone. QA 31193 is not a CI delivery APK.
  Delivery: 55c63db1 fast-forwarded main; Actions 41096456424 passed and published APK 31194. Downloaded final APK SHA-256
  047b24607bc288d14cdf5ab8b694125d61308578736332b454f9b1fe27afb3df, verified against CI SHA256SUMS and signing certificate.

### P523 - Quad / Tetra: moving subjects' thin bright details pink: DONE
- Found on P522's X8U Quad bursts (people walking, 140429 / 140447): pink shoelaces, stripes, dots where Ark is neutral; the same with one frame. Cause: P282's base demosaic (rejected donors) damps an aliasing colour difference toward R - G = B - G = 0, i.e. R = G = B of the sensor, which is magenta once white-balanced (sensor neutral R/G ~ 0.48, B/G ~ 0.65). The repo's synthetic mosaic scene is neutral in sensor RGB, so P282's tests never saw it.
- Fix: baseDemosaicNeutral 1 (default): the damping goes toward the camera neutral (natDemN): wbR / wbB (the app now sends the shot's white point, ScamHybridBurst.neutralTuning), else the base frame's grey world over its colour blocks (hybridMosaicNeutral). 0 = byte-identical to before; Bayer bursts unchanged.
- Synthetic Quad / Tetra with the sensor neutral (scene x 0.48 / 1 / 0.65, 1 and 4 frames, eval per region): neutral bars false colour 0.41 -> 0.07 (Quad), 0.064 -> 0.018 (Tetra); neutral zone plate 0.097 -> 0.023; edges / background unchanged; aliased colour bars 0.37 -> 0.41 (damped toward neutral). X8U crop (moving people): magenta on bright details 0.020 -> 0.004 (baseDemosaic 0: -0.001), P282's detail kept.
- Tried and dropped: scaling the cells' colour difference by the pixel's luma (ratio), ratio green equivalents, a ratio clamp, damping toward the merge's own colour - little gain, edges / background worse.

### P524 / P525 - Quad ISZ (no remosaic): the grid and beaded edges on moving subjects, the headlight: DONE
- Owner 2026-11-07: «На quad модуле у нас так же сетка более видна ... У квад снимков важно убрать "сетку", при этом не потеряв в детализации ... На фаре не должно быть артефактов, также "полосы"/"сетки"». X8U Quad = ISZ crops without remosaic (Ark sensor type 1: lens_6_10, lens_1792318315072; no short frames).
- Measured: in flat static areas the coherent lattice is tiny (<0.3 % of the level, Ark's JPEG <0.2 %); the grid is P282's base demosaic on moving subjects: its luma follows the 2x2 green blocks, slanted edges come out beaded (a moving car's headlight outline dotted, zigzag bumper edges), and its noise is a maze the app's denoise left as it was (the effective map said 4..20 frames there).
- P525: (1) baseDemosaicCover 1: the demosaic sets its pixels' coverage toward 1 (eff = mix(cover, 1, share)) - the Resolve denoise reads the truth there; (2) mosaicAlongEdge 1: hybridAlongEdge, a CPU pass after the native merge, smooths along the edge (structure tensor, +-1/+-2 px on the tangent) by the demosaic's share (1 - smoothstep(1, 4, coverage)) x coherence; across the edge nothing, oriented texture kept. Even bands then odd ones (deterministic on any threads). Cost: 16 - 86 ms on the X8U crops / full frames, 184 ms worst case (whole 12 MP one-frame burst, 4 host cores).
- Synthetic Quad, 1 frame, sensor neutral: edges 41.8 -> 43.1 dB (merge alone 43.5), zone plate / bars kept (22.4 / 20.8 dB vs the merge's 20.1 / 19.2). Tetra edges stay below the merge alone (32.2 vs 35.7 dB, not beads - open; no Tetra bursts from Ark).
- Tried: a wider demosaic cone (worse everywhere but flat), greens-only luma (beads stay), a detail threshold (flat cleaner, bars' false colour back), coverage-based weights without the demosaic's own share (the coverage is not its F).
- P524 headlight (142255, clipped LED, no shorts): through the app's own highlight recovery (tools/ark_compare.py --app-highlights) the core is white like Ark's; the pink rim and the dotted outline were P523 / P525 (fixed). The glow beyond the clip is the LED's own warm-magenta in RAW; the tone stage desaturates it.
- tools/ark_burst_to_nch.py: Ark's short frames are ~0.49 of the base (measured per burst), its record's 'ratio' 8 is the highlight factor; clip flags (header flag 4) as the app. ark_compare --app-highlights: hlrecovery/chanprep -> reduce -> scamrgb -> clipband with the worker's flags, Bento's k, the session's shading (colour in scamrgb, its mean as the vignetting).

### P534 - the native merge's clip flags on a mostly clipped colour (Tetra / Quad LEDs): DONE
- Owner 2026-11-07 (Ark's Tetra car, its daytime running lights: «Тут у нас фиолетовый свет»). The host render of the comparison had no highlight recovery (white balance on clipped sites: pink); through the app's own (ark_compare --app-highlights) the LED core came out yellow with a pink rim, Ark's white.
- Cause: the native merge flagged a colour clipped (bits 0..2) only where every sample under its kernel clipped. On a Tetra / Quad LED a few unclipped samples at its colour blocks' edges always remain: G = 1.0 (P268: at least the clipped mean) but unflagged, so the app's recovery took it as real and R, B stood above it after the white balance.
- Fix: mosaicClipShare 0.5 - flagged also where the clipped samples hold at least that share of the colour's kernel weight (both native programs, natClipShareU; 1 = as before). Tetra car: the core white; flags R/G/B 295 / 52 / 295 -> ~2200 each. Quad 142255 headlights whiter, nearer Ark's. 0.2 / 0.05 change nothing more; the faint pinkish rim left is the recovery's colour from the red paint around the lamp.

### P544 - the Tetra merge itself: no checker on moving subjects: DONE (2026-11-08)
- Owner 2026-11-08: «Почини склейку Tetra, чтобы шахматки не было совсем». Ablations on Tetra burst 2 (the worker, notch off): the base frame alone has no checker (mosaicFrames 1); the base demosaic (baseDemosaic 0), the dezipper (mosaicDezip 0) are not it; the checker is in R, G and B alike and not tied to the blocks' parity (its phase moves with the car); the base widening up to 60 frames takes it off but costs 12 % of Tetra burst 1's fine detail (roof tiles -13 %).
- The cause: in the native kernel (natFrame) a frame's say in a colour is the sum of its kernel weights there - ~1 inside its own 4x4 block of that colour, ~100x less a block away. Where the donors sit shifted against the base on a moving subject the frames' blocks interleave and their shares of a colour alternate block by block, a 4 px checker wherever their contents differ.
- The fix: natFrame also sums every frame with its weight per colour saturated, (1 + k) den / (den + k), k = mosaicTetraFrameSat 0.01, and the kernel takes that sum where the donors were rejected (their mean robustness here, mosaicTetraFrameSatHi 0.98 .. Lo 0.8 -> 0 .. 1; Tetra only). Saturating every frame everywhere took the checker too but 5.5 % of the fine detail (the sites' distances are the merge's sub-pixel detail); gating it per frame by its own robustness left half the checker; by the local-alignment offset nothing (the 128 px field misses a small far car).
- Tetra burst 2 (linear merge): the checker's share of the fine detail 0.051 -> 0.007 (a car far down the road), 0.036 -> 0.006 (cars by a sign); fine detail 0.998 (Tetra 2), 0.999 (Tetra 1), roof tiles 1.006. With the P543 notch, through the app chain: fine detail 0.985 (Tetra 2), 0.991 (Tetra 1) of before; Tetra burst 3 (24 frames: see below) - blocks with a visible checker 721 -> 186, its share there 0.066 -> 0.025, a car door / asphalt / wall smooth as Ark's, the wheel spokes as sharp.
- Tetra burst 3 at 30 frames on llvmpipe: the normalised blocks (slot 18) over the 128 MB storage block even at 8 cells (4080 px wide, 30 frames, the rows' margins) - the native merge fell back to the split. Fixed by P545.

### P608 - nubia 50 / 64 MP: the full sensor mode asked and proven, the tele's 64 MP (owner's log of 31252, 2026-11-10, camera 2 at «50 Мп (ремозаик)»: a black viewfinder with two squeezed copies of the scene, one bluish and one yellowish, at one edge; again: «Ты так же не дал возможность включить 64мп на телевике»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Diagnosis (log in_nubia4, lines 177-247): the maximum-resolution session (P605 route «verified before») ran the sensor's binned mode - its results report com.qti.sensorbps.mode_index 1 right after «camera 2: full resolution 8192x6144» (table row 0 8192x6144@20, row 1 4096x3072@30); the HAL wrote the 4096x3072 frame at its own pitch (8192 B) into the 8192x6144 buffer (pitch 16384 B): rows 0..1535 hold the picture (left half the even, right half the odd rows - the RG / GB tints), the rest zeros (LiveWhyTone p10 = p50 = 0). MosaicStream called it a confident plain Bayer. So P605's «HAL remosaic» verdict and the eight «hwremosaic» fails of the P598 probe (in_nubia2 / in_nubia3: every maximum-resolution session reported mode 1) came from binned frames. NubiaFullRes' own doc said it: the HAL fills the full-size buffer from the binned mode unless asked for the full one (owner, P575: «Фулрез на Нубии работает при переключении на сенсормод фулреза»).
- Report 2026-11-09 17:13: org.codeaurora.qcamera3.sensor_meta_data.current_mode (int32) is a vendor tag but in no camera's availableSessionKeys (62 keys: android.*, com.zte.camera.sessionParameters.*, org.codeaurora.qcamera3.sessionParameters.*); listed and possibly able to push the full mode: sessionParameters.EnableInsensorZoom and EnableSnapshotOnlyInsensorZoom (int32).
- Asked: NubiaFullRes.learnMaxRes learns the table's row of the maximum-resolution size (maxResRow: camera 2 row 0 8192x6144, camera 3 row 0 9248x6944, camera 0 row 0); every maximum-resolution session (the route and the probe's settings) puts SensorModePick.QCOM_KEY = that row on every request and builds session parameters with it (NubiaRemosaicProbe.apply / wantsSession; the camera service drops the unlisted key from the session, the requests carry it). The normal session and every other phone are unchanged (no pick, no key; the sensor mode is only asked inside the nubia maximum-resolution FULLRES session).
- The route's ways (NubiaRemosaicProbe.ATTEMPTS, one a session, only those whose session keys the camera lists): «fullmode» (the mode key alone), «fullmode_isz» (+ EnableInsensorZoom 1 on the session), «fullmode_isz_snap» (+ EnableSnapshotOnlyInsensorZoom 1). A failed way (any reason, or three sessions without a verdict) is noted under module_nubia_fullres_fail_<cam>_fullmode_fail and the next runs in the next session with a short notice («50 Мп: способ 1 из 3 — …, пробую следующий»); all failed: the size off on this firmware with one notice and its reasons in the dimmed size's explanation. A camera error in a shot turns the route off at once (as P605).
- Proven: NubiaFullRes.ModeWatch of a maximum-resolution session (watchMaxRes) expects the full row; another mode in its PATIENCE (15) results fails the session with the new code «binned» («HAL остаётся в режиме биннинга: кадр 12,6 Мп в буфере 50 Мп»; the tele «16,1 Мп в буфере 64 Мп») through retryWithoutFullRes (CaptureController's result handler, the same session only). The frame check NubiaFullRes.partialFrame (8 rows from 9/16 of the height down and 4 top rows, every 7th sample, before MosaicStream measures the frame): the lower rows all one value below the black level while the top varies = a smaller frame in the buffer -> «binned», or «crop» once the full row was reported (an in-sensor-zoom crop is no full field). MosaicStream's verdict waits while the results report another mode (NubiaRemosaicProbe.defer; applied once the row is reported, takePending). «frames» needs both; a shot only promotes «frames» to «shot» (a shot of an unproven session proves nothing). A real full-mode Bayer is the remosaic route (block 1, «(ремозаик)»), a Quad the sensor's own mosaic (block 2).
- Stored verdicts forgotten: NubiaFullRes.ROW_TRIALS 1 -> 2 (the trials' stamp): «verified before» of camera 2 and the probe's fails were all binned frames; the stamp drops a camera's whole nubia memory at once and each way is tried once again. Each way is a MosaicStream stream of its own (|probe-fullmode…; the stored block 1 of |probe-remosaic is not reused).
- Tele (camera 3, OV64B40): the stock HAL advertises 4624x3472 (array and RAW), SensorModeTable row 0 9248x6944@15, maximum-resolution RAW_SENSOR 9248x6944 (report lines 7061, 7485). By the code its offer passes (no row of the advertised array, the maximum-resolution RAW >= 1.5x the array: the route), but the size was «50 Мп» everywhere (CameraSheets' «Подробный · 50 Мп», PhotoSize.label, every notice) and its sessions would have been the same binned frame in the full buffer; no log of camera 3 to tell whether the owner also met a failed trial. Now: «Подробный · 64 Мп», «64 Мп (ремозаик)», the notices name «64 Мп» (NubiaFullRes.sizeText from the maximum-resolution size), row 0 asked and proven as on camera 2.
- VF_RAW «stages» of a 50 / 200 MP bin named the binned copy («4096x3072 stride 8192 … -> copied»): LiveRawFrame.publishFrame cleared pendingSource at the top of the nested publish; now after it returns (finally), so it names the camera's frame and the bin.
- Open (phone): whether the HAL honours current_mode on the requests (CamX usually picks the sensor mode at stream-on from the session; the key is not a listed session key) or one of the in-sensor zoom keys; if none, the log shows each way failing «binned» and the size goes off with one honest notice - no binned frame is shot as 50 / 64 MP. Tests: NubiaFullResTest 17, NubiaRemosaicProbeTest 20, LiveRawFrameTest 28, FullResTrialsTest 11 pass.

### P606 - lens settings in the shade, live only on their lens (owner, 2026-11-10, the long press of «Настройки линзы» › «Защита ярких цветов»: «дай возможность добавлять настройки из линзы в шторку, в шторке можно менять их только на линзе для которой ты добавил, при переключении на другую эта настройка в шторке должна становиться серой и её нельзя будет регулировать»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Why the lens rows had no «В шторку»: the shade catalog (ShadeCatalog) walks the settings tree but skips invisible pages, and the lens page (lens_screen) is hidden as a row; the module's generated sensor rows (pref_sensorconfig_<slot>_*) are never in that tree and their prefix is not pinnable.
- Pin: «lens:<profile>:<key>» in ui_shade_tiles (ShadeTiles.lensToken / lensOf / keyOf) - the module profile of the lens page that pinned it (a slot, or its FULLRES profile «back1@full200»; a sensor row pins for its module slot, shared by its FULLRES profiles) and the key that page writes. The lens's name is kept in ui_shade_lens_name_<profile> (ui_: not a module-profile key, travels in the config's main part). SettingsMigration.removeObsolete judges a lens pin by its key.
- Catalog: ensureTree also walks the lens page into lens templates (ShadeCatalog.lensPinnable: value rows - sliders, switches, lists; no actions, free text, camera keys' list, module rows); a module's sensor rows are generated into that tree on demand (SensorConfigPreferenceGenerator.addModuleCategory) for the pin's slot. entry(token) gives the lens entry: Entry.key = the token, Entry.pref = the stored key, Entry.lens = the profile; title / short title «<row> · <lens>» (FullResProfiles.label, «3×», «2,4× · 200 Мп»). Every value read / write / default / icon / availability of ShadeCatalog goes by Entry.pref (= key for the other tiles).
- Scope check (ShadeCatalog.lensActive / lensUnavailable): live while the pin's profile is FullResProfiles.profileFor(ModuleRegistry.active()) (a sensor row: any profile of its slot) and, for a module-profile key, the modules' own settings are on; else the tile is greyed (the shade's existing dimmed style) with «Доступно на линзе 3×», «Линзы «3×» больше нет» (the slot or its FULLRES size gone: the stored name) or module_row_per_lens_off. write() and SettingsBarLayout.apply refuse then (no write, no camera restart); a tap only shows the reason; the open slider card closes. Off its lens the tile shows the lens's own value (ModuleProfiles.snapshot of the profile). The shade follows a lens switch through its settings listener (module_active).
- Edits on the lens write the main settings as the lens page does (they hold the camera's profile; ModuleProfiles saves it); a session key (SessionKeys, e.g. «Частота кадров RAW») restarts the camera as other session tiles do (Entry.sessionTime).
- UI: the long press of a lens page row (and of its sub-pages: RAW crop, colour calibration) offers «В шторку» / «В шторке» (SettingHelp.show(c, p, lens), SettingsFragment.lensProfile); the tile shows the row's name and «3× · <value>» (the name line may shrink and cut, the lens stays readable); unpin from the sheet or the edit mode's «×».
- Tests: ShadeLensPinTest (scope recorded, live / greyed and unchanged, the lens's own value off it, the scoped key written, sensor row for its slot + session restart flag, shared settings grey profile rows, unpin, restart, deleted lens with its name, obsolete cleanup), ShadeLensPinUiTest (the sheet's pin; tiles live, greyed, back; renders), ModuleProfilesPageTest (lensProfile of the lens page and its sub-page, null on the photo page); both new in the CI list. Not on a phone: the look at real lens names, the restart after a session-key tile, the shade's refresh on a zoom-driven lens switch.

### P594 - Tetra on the new burst: findings and improvements (owner, 2026-11-10: «Посмотри как с текущей обработкой снимает Tetra, постарайся улучшить»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Burst burst_ArkCam_20261109_135446_129_lens_1794126026256 (4080 x 3072, 15 frames, ISO 50, 1.86 ms, ArkCam's JPEG in the zip; a promenade, buildings, rails, two people walking). The frames drift 11 px along x and only 1.3 px along y. «Быстрый» and «Качество» give the same merge bit for bit: with fastMergeTetra 0 both run the native SCAM merge (P489).
- The current Tetra at 100 % (through the app chain, against Ark's JPEG): detail well above Ark's (mid 1.65x its JPEG; Ark is softer). Chroma noise far below Ark's, with no colour moire; Ark leaves yellow / blue fringes on the rails and on a waistband. The two walking people are as sharp as Ark's, with no ghosts or teeth. The clipped lamp has no checker (P548 pass: 18754 px). The weakest point was 8 px beads along every horizontal / vertical edge: a thin rail printed as a chain, with a 4 px lattice beside it. In the merge they were 4x Ark's (0.128 against 0.032, rms of the 1/8 and 3/8 lines), in R, G and B alike, and on static areas too. Cause: a 4x4 block row holds two colours. Along a horizontal edge each colour's same-row sites alternate every 4 px with sites across the edge, and frames that share their vertical block phase cannot fill them. Along-scale 2, edge scale 0.3 / 0.4, kernel scale 0.7, along-edge K 25, saturated sums everywhere and the S5 chroma fill each moved them by 33 % at most, and most of these cost detail.
- Fix (mosaicTetraLumaGuide 1, Tetra programs only, `#if NAT_B==4`; 0 = the merge before this change, bit for bit): the native merge takes the luma in green units from every colour's sums, weighted by their kernel support, so the colour sampled on the edge's own side leads. The colour ratios come from every frame's wide window: R / Gr and B / Gb (same rows) over separable 8 (x) 4 px trapezoids, which respond to no harmonic of the 8 px colour period. There is one weight per 2x2 cell, and the cull stays for the sharp sums. out = mix(own, L rho, share). mosaicTetraLumaGuideRB (1) sets red / blue's say in the luma.
- Numbers (the merge's display gamma; beads / 1/8-lattice / chroma lattice in rms codes, mid detail |g1 - g2.5|, flat noise), before -> after. New burst crops: buildings 0.128 -> 0.035 / 0.040 -> 0.010 / 0.019 -> 0.009, mid 1.092 -> 1.074, flat 0.012 -> 0.011 (Ark 0.032 / 0.014); rails and people 0.185 -> 0.084 / 0.059 -> 0.023 / 0.021 -> 0.009, mid 1.171 -> 1.154, flat 0.241 -> 0.180; sign / balconies 0.128 -> 0.030, mid 1.057 -> 1.041; roofs 0.137 -> 0.050, mid 1.318 -> 1.296, flat 0.251 -> 0.178. Older Tetra crops: Tetra 1 palace 0.059 -> 0.018 / 0.017 -> 0.005, mid 0.869 -> 0.823, flat 0.004 -> 0.006; its second crop 0.070 -> 0.017, mid 0.959 -> 0.916; Tetra 3 bus 0.145 -> 0.089 / 0.046 -> 0.031 / 0.036 -> 0.018, mid 0.828 -> 0.818, flat 0.113 -> 0.094; Tetra 2 car 0.148 -> 0.132, mid 0.795 -> 0.787, flat 0.059 -> 0.040. Colour of flat patches the same to 0.1 %. Full frame through the app chain: beads -57 % (buildings), -37 % (rails, people), -36 % (ground), chroma lattice -55 .. -60 %. Against Ark's JPEG in textured blocks: mid 1.646 -> 1.601, fine 2.10 -> 1.66 (the lattice and noise), flat noise 2.44 -> 2.40 of Ark's. By eye, the rails are continuous lines and the balcony edges clean; textures, colour and the moving people are unchanged.
- Did not win: colour ratios from the base frame alone (chroma noise x5, flat luma noise x3). A radial wide window (R 6: as good on the beads, more false colour; R 4: beads x2.3, the window is under one colour period). A plain 8 px box (flat noise x2..3: the window steps). Red / blue say 0.5 / 0.25 (half the bead removal for +1 / +2 % mid). Noise-optimal weights (support x rho: beads +40 %). Smoothing the effective map's lattice for the app's denoise: no change.

The app chain prints a faint 8 px pattern in the flat sky (0.1 codes) that the merge does not have.

(b) why/combine under EDGE_HOLD (photo, the full-size merge; off with hybrid_why_edge_hold 0): at such an edge (the sharpened luma's 5 x 5 over 1 .. 2 stops) the gain's lift stops at the window's brightest / darkest, the sharpened delta itself kept. (c) why/combine DITHER_TPDF (WhyCombine sets it for the photo): triangular +-1 LSB, two uncorrelated interleaved-gradient patterns per channel; 0 = the shader before token for token (check_vf_fused's stored streams unchanged).

### P601 - the static face beside a walking man on the fast route (owner, 2026-11-10, Ark burst 140309, Quad lens 6, 30 frames: «лицо женщины в автобусе за парнем видно только на качестве»): DONE in code, host
- Cause (window 1664 x 1152 at (896, 896) of 140309, per-donor dumps of both routes: SCAM_FM_REJ_DUMP, the native stage-dump): the face behind the bus glass is static in donors 1 - 4 and 18 - 29 (the man covers it in 5 - 17); «Качество» takes 15 of them (robust >= 0.5: 1 - 4, 19 - 29; weight sum 14.0 over the face box), «Быстрый» 1 (sum 2.7; effective frames on the face 4.1 against 9.6). Two stages: (1) alignment - the L0 tile LK follows whatever dominates its window, so next to the moving man (and a passing car) the face's tiles and the bilinear field between them carried a flow 0.5 .. 8.5 HALF px off (residual over the face 3 .. 12 against 0.9 .. 1.4 for the best constant shift); the raw rejection on the face fell to 0.45 - 0.75 in donors 25 - 29 where the native raw stays 0.93 - 0.96. (2) the rejection chain (sh089 filter, sh009 dilate, sh006 cyclops) integrates every small rejection over ~9 HALF px: a few speckles or noise-level rejections (mean 0.04) zero a donor (face raw 0.90 -> final 0.12 in donor 22). Not it: the motion prior (off: face 4.0), a floor / divisor on the chain's sums (face 10 - 13 frames, but the synthetic below: ghosts 33 - 53 against 12 - 18).
- Fast route (scam-fast-merge.h hybridFastMerge, scam-fast-shaders.h, scam-fast-gpu.h; HybridTuning fastFlowPick 2): kFastFlowBg - per L0 tile the median of the 5 x 5 tiles at stride 4 (the surroundings' flow); kFastFlowPick - every donor's flow on a grid of 4 x 4 HALF blocks whose nodes include the tile field's own (a block that keeps the field reads back as the field): where the block's 8 x 8 window misfits (the rejection's own distance - difference beyond the noise over max(texture, noise), the donor guide by sh118's cubic B-spline - above 0.25), the 4 x 4 tile flows within 2 HALF px of the surroundings' flow and that flow are tried (each once) and the best taken when it halves the misfit; the rejection and the merge read the grid through flow_scale_offset with their programs unchanged; kFastCyclopsRescue (sh006 + a rescue) - the donor's weight raised back where its block fits within the noise alone at that flow (2 .. 4), the flow is the surroundings' (0.75 .. 1.5 px) and sh009's mass is low (0.15 .. 0.35). fastFlowPick 1 = the pick alone, 0 = before (byte for byte, checked on the window and the synthetic). Row strips read the block grid (KFlow geometry); a GPU that cannot build the three programs merges without them (a note).
- Result, window: face effective frames 4.1 -> 8.0 (pick alone 5.9; «Качество» 9.6), donors with weight >= 0.5 on the face 1 -> 1, 2, 3, 21, 22, 23 (weight sum 2.7 -> 6.4); the static facade 14.9 -> 18.6. Crops through the app chain (out_quad/140309_bus_v3.png, 6 columns): the face's eyes / nose / mouth back, between «Быстрый» before and «Качество»; the man's head, hand and coat edge as before (no ghost seen). Left: donors 24 - 29 (their right flow is 7 - 8 px from every tile and the surroundings' median there) and the fallback's softness (P596's side).
- Synthetic truth (tools/quad_synth_burst.py with a dark textured coat moving 3 px / frame left beside a ribbed facade, a 3 px / frame object, a 0.85 px / frame one; display luma rms x 1000 / frames): the picked flows within 0.05 HALF px of the true ones; coat 5.45 / 15.16 rim -> 5.45 / 14.38, bright object 4.89 / 14.01 -> 5.00 / 14.30, slow object 7.50 / 13.08 -> 7.60 / 13.82, static 7.98 -> 7.90 (29.3 -> 29.8 frames); the facade 6 - 32 px right of the coat 14.0 / 12.2 / 17.6 -> 14.0 / 16.7 / 27.5 (more of its static frames merged with partial weights: the Quad merge's zipper, not the coat; «Качество» 15.2 / 10.9 / 10.0).
- Cost (llvmpipe, the window, 29 donors, profile 2, a loaded host): the pick stage 9 -> ~540 ms (blocks' own fit + the surroundings' median) .. ~1040 ms with the tried candidates, of a 8.7 - 10 s merge; GPU memory: a 4 x 4 HALF block grid per slot (pgx x pgy RGBA32F, 1 / 16 of a HALF RGBA32F) and two small textures; strips: one grid per frame (0.25 B per RAW px per frame in hybridFastStripBytes).
- Keys: scam_dev "hybrid_fast_flow_pick" (2 on, 1 the pick alone, 0 before; DevKeys, PreferenceKeys); checks: tools/check_hybrid_native_neutral.cpp (default 2, the key), tools/check_fast_index_free.cpp (the three programs build). Not seen on a phone: Adreno / Mali timings of the pick and the face on a real «Быстрый» shot.
- Round 2 (coordinator: the synthetic facade 12 - 32 px right of the moving coat 12.2 / 17.6 -> 16.7 / 27.5 after round 1): measured against the true flow of the synthetic, the cause is the pick and the rescue taking donors whose flow is 0.5 .. 1.4 HALF px off: next to the coat every tile flow (and the field) is dragged by a fraction of a pixel, which the B-spline guides cannot see on fine periodic texture; the surroundings' median is 0.02 .. 0.04 px from the truth there. Gates on the pick's / rescue's noise fit, the distance to the surroundings' flow, a guard ring or a texture-fit term only traded the face for the facade (facade <= before: face <= 5.7 frames). Fix: the pick starts from the surroundings' flow wherever it fits within 10 % of the field's misfit (u_bgpref 0.1; a mover's own block keeps the field - the surroundings' flow misfits there). Synthetic, display luma rms x 1000 before -> round 1 -> round 2: facade 6 - 12 / 12 - 20 / 20 - 32 / 32 - 48 px 14.0 / 12.2 / 17.6 / 8.5 -> 14.0 / 16.7 / 27.5 / 8.7 -> 11.3 / 11.6 / 10.3 / 6.0 («Качество» 15.2 / 10.9 / 10.0 / 6.7); coat rim 15.2 -> 14.1, bright object rim 14.0 -> 13.8, slow object rim 13.1 -> 14.0 (+7 %; «Качество» 67.9), static 7.98 -> 7.88; checker (2 x 2 Hadamard) energy of the error in the facade band 2.2 -> 3.6 -> 2.7 x1e-6, period 4 2.3 -> 3.3 -> 2.4 («Качество» 2.8 / 3.0). 140309 face 4.1 -> 7.4 frames (round 1 8.0), donors >= 0.5 on the face 1 -> 1, 2, 3, 21, 22, 23. App-chain checker / period-4 energy, after / before: 140309 moving x1.06 / x1.04, ring 16 px x1.03 / x1.05, static x0.97 / x1.00; 142001 window a moving x1.07 / x1.04, ring x0.94 / x0.96; window b moving (2 % of it) x1.17 / x1.11, ring x1.01 / x1.01 - Ark's own energy there 2 .. 4x ours, the crops (out_quad/142001_people_v4.png) show more detail, no zipper. 140335 / 142159 windows not run (bursts no longer on disk). (as the timer: one tap, a toast «Вспышка: авто» / «Вспышка: вкл.» / «Вспышка: выкл.» / «Фонарик: вкл.»); a lens without FLASH_INFO_AVAILABLE (the front: its torch is P507's screen light) and the video: off <-> torch (a stored Auto / On shows off there and is kept for the back lens). - Press (takePicture, ZSL photo / night / Sport): On, or Auto with the latest preview result's CONTROL_AE_STATE FLASH_REQUIRED -> a flash shot: the ring is held (frames and results of the press), AE_PRECAPTURE_TRIGGER_START once on the preview, the wait (STATE_FLASH_PRECAPTURE, FlashMode.Precapture: PRECAPTURE until it ends; no PRECAPTURE 4 results past the trigger; no AE state; 1 s) -> captureStillPicture takes one fresh RAW (HybridPlan.flash: AE ON_ALWAYS_FLASH / ON_AUTO_FLASH, CONTROL_CAPTURE_INTENT_STILL_CAPTURE, trigger IDLE, FLASH_MODE OFF; the route's vendor / session keys as every series request) and merges it as the 1-frame Hybrid shot (the PSL / empty-ring path: its own exposure and white balance as the base metadata, no Bento / Shasta, no ETTR note, no AE restore frame, mosaic WB at the press not used). The frame's FLASH_STATE FIRED: the held ring is released; anything else: the frame is left out and the normal shot of the press follows from the held ring (flashFallbackShot, the press's cutoff). Auto without FLASH_REQUIRED, off, torch: the normal shot.

### P582 - the interface at the concept's scale and font (owner, 2026-11-09: «Убедись что масштаб самого смартфона и то какой у него в системе шрифт не влияет на наше приложение и у всех интерфейс выглядит ± как на концептах»; again: «Убедись что всё точно совпадает нашим концептам»): DONE in code, host (Robolectric); not seen on the phone
- Scale: ui/style/UiFixedScale. Every activity (BaseActivity: Camera, Settings, Gallery(+Launcher alias); Splash, LensDiscovery, Scam, VideoPlayer) and ScameraApp wrap their base context in attachBaseContext: densityDpi = floor(short side of the real display panel in px * 160 / 390) (DisplayManager / the activity's display, getRealMetrics, so the short side is 390 .. 391 dp in portrait and landscape whatever «Размер экрана»), fontScale = 1 («Размер шрифта» never changes our text), fontWeightAdjustment = 0 («Жирный шрифт»), and screenWidthDp / screenHeightDp / smallestScreenWidthDp restated at the new density (so values-sw* always pick the sw360 bucket and code reading them agrees). Pixels are untouched: the preview sizes (CaptureController: Display.getRealSize), TextureView / SurfaceView and the GL viewfinder read px. A large screen (system sw >= 600dp) keeps its density; only the font scale is fixed there. AppCompat 1.7's attachBaseContext2 carries the wrapped configuration (checked in Robolectric); dialogs, sheets and popups use the activity context, so they follow. Utilities.dpToPx used Resources.getSystem() (unused, now the app context).
- UiScale (camera chrome k): REFERENCE_DP 392 -> 390, the concept's width, so k = 1 on every phone (the window is always 390dp); k still differs only in split-screen / sw600+. UiTokens' FONT_SCALE_CAP no longer acts (font scale 1). Tests that pinned 392 updated to the new reference.
- Font: Roboto Flex moved to circularbarlib/res/font (the app still reaches @font/roboto_flex*, and the manual controls in circularbarlib can now use it: UiFonts; the app's Fonts delegates). Open Sans removed. Theme.Scamera.BaseApp (so Splash / Settings / every activity): android:fontFamily and fontFamily @font/roboto_flex, the Material 3 type scale (textAppearanceDisplay* .. Label*, Emphasized too) as TextAppearance.Scamera.* in Roboto Flex (Material's medium steps at 500: titles M/S, labels), viewInflaterClass ui/style/ConceptViewInflater: a layout or style that still names a system family (android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" in 15 layouts) gets Roboto Flex at that weight. Dialog themes (AlertDialogTheme, the framework fallback) and their title / body / button styles: Roboto Flex (500 for sans-serif-medium), the top bar's label / pill styles 600 (the concept's .lbl weight). ### P580 - CCM audit (owner, 2026-11-09: «Перепроверь что наша камера в целом работает с CCM/CCT верно и не ошибается нигде, мне важно знать что с цветом всё нормально и правильно работает»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Scope: the matrix path camera RGB -> XYZ D50 -> ProPhoto -> linear sRGB / Display P3 (the white estimate and the white balance: the parallel CCT audit). Checked with numbers (tools: a numpy replay of ReCalcColor's DNG_FM route on the PHY110 camera 2 matrices, CM1 D65 / CM2 A).
- Tags: Converter.convertColorspaceTransform / PhotoMatrix.rows / Parameters.rowMajor read ColorSpaceTransform.getElement(column, row) into row-major; the viewfinder's transform column-major (CaptureController ccm[col*3+row]). Illuminant codes = EXIF LightSource; DngColor's kelvin table = the DNG SDK's (A / tungsten 2850, D65 / C / cloudy 6500, D50 5000, D55 / daylight 5500, D75 7500, fluorescents at their range middles).
- Interpolation: mired, clamped to the two illuminants, the weight of calibration 2 whichever order (21 / 17 or the Pixel's 17 / 21); ColorMatrix and CameraCalibration interpolated separately and multiplied (spec); xy iterated from the neutral (DNG SDK NeutralToXY), CCT / Duv the nearest Krystek locus point. Replay: lights 2856 / 3200 / 4000 / 5000 / 6504 K read as 2862 / 3204 / 3999 / 5003 / 6505 K, weight of the A calibration 0.992 / 0.803 / 0.488 / 0.234 / 0 (linear-in-K would give 0.685 at 4000 K).
- Forward route: FM1 / FM2 row-normalised to D50 then lerped, D = max(ref) / ref with ref = CC^-1 n (the SDK's camera white of max 1: a neutral with green 1 maps to Y = max(ref), no hue change), the white balance applied once (shaders: sensorToProPhoto . (ScamRgb . neutral)). Neutral -> sRGB (1.00009, 1.00001, 0.99956) at every light (the 4-decimal D50 constant; 5e-4). Constants: XYZ(D50) -> ProPhoto x ProPhoto -> XYZ = I within 1e-6; Converter.sXYZtoSRGB = Bradford-adapted XYZ D50 -> sRGB within 5e-4 of the derivation; DngColour's / DngColor's equal; OutputColour sRGB -> P3 / BT.2020 derived from the primaries, combine.glsl's GLSL mat3 column order right; IccProfiles colorants Bradford D65 -> D50.
- Uploads: GLProg.setVar(9 floats) transposes (row-major Java, transpose true); LiveRawRenderer / LiveWhyTone upload column-major with false; LiveRawRenderer.lookTransform and LiveWhyMeter multiply column-major correctly; shaders all M * v. ISP / plain-table / OPPO / preset routes: rows to sum 1 (PhotoMatrix.normaliseRows), sensorToProPhoto = diag(1 / n): white exact. DCP: forward rows to D50 x diag(1 / n), colour-matrix route Bradford to D50 (white exact), its preview matrix divides the columns by the gains. cct_sat (row sums k + (1 - k) = 1), primaries calibration (M diag(M^-1 1)), Dynamic CCT (row sums kept) keep white; R / G / B gains scale rows as stated. ScamLab retemplate: s2p' diag(n_new) = s2p diag(n_old). DNG (P243 DngColour): FM = render matrix x diag(n), Y 1; CM1 x XYZ(scene) = n; one illuminant, no CameraCalibration.
- Fixed: a bad HAL's second calibration. (1) An all-zero (or non-finite: a rational over 0) ColorMatrix2 / CameraCalibration2 was taken as a matrix: the white estimate failed, the daylight weight then picked the zero calibration on a camera whose second illuminant is D65 (17 / 21), CC2 = 0 could not be inverted and the shot fell to IDENTITY_FALLBACK (camera RGB as sRGB). (2) An illuminant code 0 (unknown) was interpolated as 6500 K. Now (Parameters.ReCalcColor, PhotoMatrix.dngWhite for the viewfinder's light): a zero / non-finite matrix is none (PhotoMatrix.usableMatrix; a NaN forward matrix too), an unknown illuminant or an unusable ColorMatrix2 is a single-illuminant profile - the first calibration alone, as the DNG SDK renders it, the DNG's CalibrationIlluminant2 = 1's. Reported calibrations are unchanged (the FM1 == FM2 legacy test reads the tags as reported). ParametersBadHalCalibrationTest: equals the no-*2-keys photo at 2856 / 4000 / 6504 K (before: IDENTITY_FALLBACK; illuminant 0: sensorToProPhoto[0] 1.771 for 1.724), white within 1e-3, a real dual calibration still interpolates.
- Open (not changed): (a) the DNG's ForwardMatrix is CCT.matrix x sensorToProPhoto, without the shot's cct_sat 1.1 (P407 default), «Цвет» white matrix, R / G / B gains and Dynamic CCT - Lightroom / RawTherapee open the DNG ~10 % less saturated than the JPEG (P243 calls those the look; for the owner). (b) On the DNG_FM route (SCAM off, isp_ccm 0, the app's own neutral without an ISP matrix) the RAW viewfinder shows the result's ISP transform, the photo the forward matrices. (c) film/reference_mix.glsl's sRGB -> P3 constants differ from OutputColour's by 1.3e-4 (white rows 1.00012 / 0.99998 / 0.99978; < 0.1 of an 8-bit level). (d) The DNG_FM route maps the neutral to Y = max(R/G, 1, B/G), the ISP routes to Y = 1: an exposure step of that factor only when R/G or B/G > 1, no cast. (e) The former estimate (dng_white_spec 0, and both colour matrices placeholders as on the Pixel 7) lerps CC x CM products of row-normalised CMs with McCamy - kept, it is the fallback the plan chose.
### P581 - CCT / white balance audit (owner, 2026-11-09: «Перепроверь что наша камера в целом работает с CCM/CCT верно и не ошибается нигде, мне важно знать что с цветом всё нормально и правильно работает»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Scope: where the shot's white point comes from, how it becomes a CCT / neutral and where it is applied (the colour matrices themselves: the parallel matrix audit).
- Checked with numbers (gallery.dng.KelvinRoundTripTest): DngColor's locus (Krystek uv, golden-section nearest point = the isotherm foot, Duv > 0 above / green) CCT / Duv -> xy -> CCT / Duv over 2000 .. 12000 K, Duv -0.025 .. 0.025: 1.7e-4 relative CCT (2 K at 12000 K), Duv 3e-9. Through the camera matrices (PHY110, X200 Ultra camera 3, X8U camera 4; SDK-normalised CMs, the xy iteration): 1.5 K, Duv 2e-9. McCamy (SceneIlluminant, Converter's legacy) and Kang / Kim (ColourLook, DngColour, MosaicNeutral's prior) constants and the CIE A / B / C / D-series xy checked against the published values.
- Fixed: ManualWhiteBalance (the hand-set kelvin's gains, also AwbKelvin's chip) interpolated the HAL's raw ColorMatrix rationals without the DNG SDK's normalisation, with its own illuminant kelvin (A 2856, B 4874, C 6774 ...) and Kang's xy fit, while the photo reads the neutral back with DngColor (the SDK's way, Krystek's locus): a hand-set 5000 K on the X200 Ultra (CM2 x D50 1.13 against CM1 0.99) was 5048 K in the photo (sceneCct, the gallery's RAW «Температура») and a grey card at that light R / G 1.0077; Kang's fit alone left 10 K and 0.56 % (2500 K) on every camera. Now each CM is normalised as DngColor.sdkNormalised, the SDK's illuminant kelvin, the light on Krystek's locus (ManualWhiteBalance.planckXyz; xyz() stays Kang's for the mosaic prior): hand-set 2000 .. 10000 K reads back within 3 K, Duv < 5e-5, the grey card within 0.1 % (PHY110, X200 Ultra; X8U from 2300 K).

- hybridReconstructMosaicNative retries a failed native merge natively: 1 = the GPU in its safest form (hybridNativeSafeLevel: no binding 24, one normalised-blocks buffer), every frame; 2 = half the frames (at least 4), no series floor; 3 = 4 frames. Only a native merge that fails all of them (no GPU at all) goes to the split, logged as the last resort; strict 2x throws then.

- Owner's log (Adreno 750, build 31239): `MOSAIC NATIVE: failed (HYBRID GPU shader: ERROR: 0:312: 'NNorm2' : binding exceeds limit` - P545's second normalised-block buffer sits at SSBO binding 24, the Adreno 750 has 24 bindings (0 - 23; the 830 has 36, llvmpipe 80), so every Quad / Tetra shot fell back to the split path (blur, chroma blotches).

- X8U ISZ green (same message, SCA_20261108_181648, mode 7 RAW10): the lens shading map is the crop's (corner 1.65 against Ark's ISZ 1.80 and the 1x map's 5.2), not the cause. Whites come out R/G 0.94 - 0.97 and B/G 0.75 - 0.85, B/G falling to 0.4 in the shadows (the per-channel toe on a yellow cast). The four white estimates disagree (P121 0.491 / 0.524 on the 1x locus, v2 statistic 0.495 / 0.465, teacher 0.456 / 0.515, the HAL's misread 0.462 / 0.540); Ark's pair 142021 (1x) / 142152 (ISZ) has the ISZ R gain 3 % above the 1x one. ### P551 - smoother, quicker UI (main-thread work and per-frame churn): DONE in code, not seen on a phone (2026-11-08)
- Owner 2026-11-08: «займись оптимизацией нашей камеры для более быстрой и плавной работы». A read-only audit of the Java side (main-thread stalls, per-frame garbage, synchronous GPU readbacks); the safe ones fixed, compiled (:app:compileDebugJavaWithJavac):
- Motion sensors (gyroscope at 500 us / fastest during a burst, rotation vector, gravity) were delivered on the main looper (registered from an AsyncTask without a Handler): 0.6 - 1 kHz of events next to every UI animation. Now on their own thread (control/SensorThread, display priority); the rotation vector's three matrices reused; the gravity values copied (read from the main thread); Gyro's histories cleared before its listeners start.
- ProcessingRing: its outline path and PathMeasure rebuilt only when the size or stroke changes (every vsync while a shot was processed).
- LiveSceneMeter: the 64x64 tile read back one frame after it is drawn (no pipeline stall behind a merge on the GPU); its state arrays reused.
- LiveWhyTone: the fusion's gf / ab program ids looked up once per gamma type (a key string and define arrays per frame).
- CameraFragment: the preview-result HUD runnable posted at most every 50 ms (an AF state change always), not per frame; the viewfinder freeze (P345) PixelCopy no longer waited for on the main thread in onPause (up to 80 ms) - one HandlerThread for it, the bitmap reused until shown.
- ModuleProfiles (per-module settings): restore() apply() instead of commit() (a synchronous write of the whole prefs file on the main thread at a lens switch); a local setting's change rewrites the active profile 400 ms after the changes stop, not per slider tick (any profile read or other save flushes it first).
- Gallery viewer: EXIF / LibRaw / header reads of a swiped page on an EXIF thread, the model set and the labels bound on the main thread for the newest page; the histogram computed on one shared worker (a new thread and GL context per page before), no 10 ms polling loop on the main thread, on a copy of Glide's bitmap. ShadeStyle.sheetAlpha reads its one key (getAll copied every setting per call).
- Left (camera lifecycle, needs a phone to verify): closeCamera / restartCamera on the main thread at a lens or mode switch (100 - 400 ms), the gallery's whole-library MediaStore query on the main thread (six callers use its result at once), the 300 ms sleep before a FULLRES merge, the processing executor shared with camera open, the synchronous LiveWhyTone AE readback.

### P610 - 50 / 200 MP: faster and leaner, the same output (owner, 2026-11-10: «займись оптимизацией съемки в 50мп и 200мп, постарайся ускорить обработку и уменьшить потребление памяти»): DONE in code, host (bit-exact); not seen on the phone
- Where the time went (OnePlus 16, 9c70ca93, in_op16_3): 50 MP tele Quad fast merge - the merge stage 2.2 s, then outside the stages the GPU chroma median in 10 bands 4.5 s (1.3 s in the 11-09 log), the Quad lattice 0.6-0.8 s (its 7 programs compiled 100-160 ms on a context made anew after the median's was torn down), the output fill 0.4-0.8 s: the "missing 5 s". 200 MP Tetra: merge 15.2 s (GPU), output 1.0 s, the client's read of 1338 MB into a copy 0.58 s, the reference RAW out of the arena 0.4 s on one core, the post 11.6 s (2.8 s of it the first shot's program compiles: 43 written, a new build), the ISZ 4:3 crop (12288 x 16320 -> 12240 x 16320, the 800 MB photo) 1.15 s with both bitmaps held, the mosaic WB statistic 285 ms before the worker.
- ChromaMedianGpu (scam-chroma-gpu.h): a slot's storage is kept while it is big enough (ensure; every pass writes what it reads, taps clamped inside size) - each band took ~275 MB of new storage; processRows: a band uploaded from where its rows are (the kept rows above it, then the frame) and its own rows read back into the frame (mosaicChromaMedianBands: two 68 MB copies a band less); releaseBuffers once a frame is done. The fast route keeps the median's context for the lattice (chromaKeepNext) and builds the lattice programs in the merge-time prewarm (chromaPrewarm(.., lattice)); quadLattice uploads its strips without the staging copy.

The result's adoption of a 1338 MB memfd 100 ms against an 811 ms read into a copy (host); 382 MB copy 255-317 -> 217-265 ms (host, loaded).

(cropped in place, N ms)», «HEX CLIENT OUTPUT» and ref_copy lower, the gap before the worker ~150 ms shorter.

### P612 - «Качество» dead on MTK after 31253 (owner, 2026-11-11, vivo V2405A, mt6991, Mali-G925: «"Качество" сломано на мтк»; SCAMERA_Log_2026-11-11 + _1, build 31253 57a6f7d4): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Every SHDR «Качество» shot: «HYBRID GPU shader: 3:676: S0001: Type mismatch in arithmetic operation between 'int' and 'float'» at blend0, the local-align merge, the homography-only retry and the conservative retry all stopped; «Быстрый» merged (merge=2658 ms).
- Cause: P607's US_CLIP_VOTE added «for(int c=0;c<3;c++)» inside usAtP(..., float c, ...). The Mali-G925 compiler (r5x driver on mt6991) leaks the loop's int c over the parameter: line 676 of the blend body is «float eM=...c*(1.0-bestV)...» - int * float, the program refused. GLSL scoping says the loop index ends with the loop; glslang, glslc and llvmpipe accept it, so the host lanes and the agent's renders passed.
- Fix: the vote loops' index is vc (all four, usAt as well), same arithmetic. New tools/check_glsl_loop_shadow.py (shaders lane): no for-loop index in any GLSL function of the app (cpp raw strings and assets/shaders) may reuse a parameter's name; it flags the 31253 code and passes the fix. Loop indices over a same-named local in an inner scope (8 such, natDemosaic, canet_p, lensfilter_live, regionStage, gainStage) compile on this Mali today and are left.
- The same log's previous crash buffer has two SIGSEGVs inside the Mali compiler (cmpbe_v2_compile_multiple_shaders under glCompileShader) in the worker's --gpu-prewarm at 04:32, no stage mark in the log. The prewarm compiles the same merge programs, so it is most likely the same source; a prewarm failure costs only the compile at the shot. To check on the next log: no prewarm tombstone, «HYBRID PREWARM: ... programs ready».

### P613 - «Качество» with hard vertical stripes after a GPU fault (owner, 2026-11-11, vivo V2405A, mt6991, Mali-G925, build 31253 57a6f7d4; SCAMERA_Log_2026-11-11 last shot + its SCAM-*.zip): safety net DONE in code, host; the fault itself not explained
- The shot (29 frames, 27 merged, frames 19/20/23 refused by the alignment) merged on the GPU; during the merge the worker's Mali driver printed five «GROUP_ERROR_FATAL» with status 0x..0003c2 (AS_FAULTSTATUS: translation fault level 2, access WRITE) at VA 0x5ff8800d40 .. 0x5ff8801180 - all five within 4.5 KB past the same 2 MB boundary, ~0.25 s apart (one strip's time). SCAM CAPTURE OK, the photo saved.
- What the stripes are (exact): 02-after-ivst of the zip, rows 1540 - 2812 (preview 385 - 703) equal the rows 512 above them bit for bit (the ends differ by < 2e-4: the CPU chroma median's halo). The merge's strips are 128 cells = 256 rows (stripCells, grid 1), 12 strips; strips 6 - 10 = rows 1536 - 2815 = the five faults. Their GPU work was lost; readStrip read the strip's bank (stripIndex & 1, P30), whose output buffer still held strip k - 2's RGB, and streamed it (rowsDone). Strip 11 (184 rows) and 0 - 5 are right. The P500 zero check did not fire: the rows were stale, not zero.
- Why the GPU faulted: not established. The same VA chunk for all five faults (strips of both banks) argues against a small overrun of a banked buffer (two buffers, two places); left: a non-banked buffer overrun (slots 1, 2, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14, 16, 22, 23, the mark list - their shader indices are bounded as read) or a driver region that could not be backed under memory pressure (the worker's peak RSS 3401 MB, the viewfinder fell to 7.5 fps right then; a first touch of an unbacked 2 MB chunk faults at level 2). First GPU merge of 31253 on this phone (the other shots failed at blend0, P612).
- Safety net (HybridTuning stripGuard 1, scam_dev hybrid_strip_guard 0 = off): before a strip's passes the green of every 64th output pixel of each row and of its last pixel is set to the NaN 0x7FA5C0DE (an unsynchronised write map of the bank's buffer, idle behind the last fence); after the readback a row still holding one was not written: after a glFinish and one more read the merge fails («HYBRID GPU STRIP GUARD: strip k ... not written ... MemAvailable N MB»). With F6 hybridReconstruct merges once more without it, else the worker fails and the app's conservative retry / cpu-single run. The context's reset status (GL_EXT/KHR_robustness) is checked too; the context is not made robust, so it is expected to say nothing.
- Host: tools/check_hybrid_strip_guard.cpp (host-native-a, SCAM_STRIP_FAULTS drops a strip's passes): the guard bit for bit off/on on a clean merge (RGB, map, flags); without the guard a dropped strip 2 repeats rows 0 - 255 (the phone's stripes), with it the merge throws; the last strip as well; with F6 the retry without F6 equals the clean no-F6 merge.

### P617 - the gallery opens slowly «sometimes», leaks of a long session (owner, 2026-11-11: «у меня теперь иногда очень долго открывается галерея. Займись оптимизацией приложения и исправлением багов, проблем, утечек памяти и так далее»; SCAMERA_Log_2026-11-11, build 31254 5b8d8d04, vivo V2454A, ~9000 photos): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- The log: line 2448 «GalleryOcr: index: 9179 photos to read» right after a shot and the camera's new ZSL ring, then the next session at 08:07:43. Not a crash: that session's ExitReasons says pid 23138 ended 07:48:37, USER_REQUESTED, «[FORCE STOP] ... due to single-cleaner» (swiped away in vivo's recents, importance 400, pss 339 MB / rss 486 MB) - about a minute after the gallery opened. No gallery timing was logged anywhere (no line between the ring and the index).
- Causes found in the code (no phone timing yet, hence the new log lines): (1) GalleryActivity.onCreate read MediaStore on the main thread before the first frame: the images query (9179 rows, each put into its folder by a linear search of the folders), a 41-pattern «LIKE '%.ext'» over the whole Files table for other RAWs, the videos - every open, again on every refresh; right after a shot MediaProvider is busy with the new file (the camera's scan broadcast), so the time varies. (2) The text index (P504) started with the library at once: Tesseract4Android's OpenMP build (all 8 cores, nice 10 against Glide's 9) plus a 2048 px decode per photo while the grid decoded its thumbnails and the shot could still be merged; the first read copied all 12 models (26 MB) from the APK; every buildAlbums / onStart stopped and restarted it; OcrIndex.start (main thread, class lock) waited for the worker's whole database read under the same lock. (3) OcrEngine.stop cut a recognition short and the index stored its partial / empty text for the photo for good; a stop of an engine recycled meanwhile threw IllegalStateException (TessBaseAPI.stop checks mRecycled).
- Fix, gallery: GalleryViewModel.loadAsync (thread «GalleryMedia») reads MediaStore and builds the lists off the main thread, sets them on it; the normal open (camera thumbnail, launcher) and the library's refreshes use it (the external VIEW / EDIT routes, «Сохранить копию» and the editor stay synchronous); a newer read wins over an older load. The LiveData of the lists have no value before the first read (an empty list sent the viewer opened from the camera to the grid). GalleryFileOperations: one lock for the folder lists (copies out), rows into folders through a map, the last scan reused while MediaStore's key (every external volume's version + generation, Android 11+) is unchanged - a folders change, the folders sheet, a second open without new photos read nothing.
- Fix, text index: OcrPace - starts 6 s after the open, waits 2.5 s after the grid last scrolled or got a new list, while ProcessingKeepAlive.busy (a shot captured / queued / merged) and from thermal MODERATE; rests as long as each photo took (at most half busy), 5 s more after 20; a running index takes a new list instead of restarting; a read cut short is not stored; an engine error skips the photo for this process, 5 in a row end the visit; the database read without the class lock; only the models asked for are copied; OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=4 set before Tesseract's first use (LLVM OpenMP reads it at its first parallel region - not verified on the phone); the engine (its models' native memory) is released when the index ends and when the text sheet closes. The progress was already kept per photo in gallery_ocr.db; 9179 was the first visit.
- Leaks (each a holder and a trigger): Histogram made a «HistogramThread» and an EGL context (GLHistogram(256) -> new GLContext) in its constructor and never ended them - the viewer's overlay at each viewer view, each «Сведения» sheet and ExifDialogViewModel's worker: one thread + one EGL context per viewer opened for the rest of the process. Now the thread and context come at the first computation (only ExifDialogViewModel's worker computes), release() closes them on their thread (GLHistogram closes a context it made), ExifDialogViewModel.onCleared releases it. ProcessingKeepAlive.busy (static) held CaptureController's lambda, i.e. the controller, its activity and views, after the camera activity was destroyed with the process alive (cached): now ProcessingKeepAlive.weakly (the instance flags through a WeakReference, the static ones always).
- Timing in the log (tags GalleryOpen / GalleryMedia / GalleryOcr): «open: camera|launcher», «media listed +T ms: N items, read R ms off the main thread», «grid first frame +T ms», «first thumbnail / first 12 thumbnails ready +T ms (memory, disk cache, decoded)», «viewer first photo ready +T ms», «albums built in T ms» (>= 20 ms), «scan: images N rows T ms, other RAW ..., videos ..., total» or «MediaStore unchanged since the last scan, N folders reused»; the index: «N photos to read (after T ms of waiting)», every 20 photos «ms a photo, left», at its end «read in s, waiting / resting, nothing left|stopped», «engine released».
- Host: OcrPaceTest, OcrIndexTest (pending, a second start keeps the running index, stop), OcrEngineTest.onlyTheModelsAskedForAreCopied, GalleryScanTest (folders by name, newest first; reuse only for the same known key), GalleryOpenTraceTest, HistogramTest (no thread for a drawing histogram, quiet after release), ProcessingKeepAliveWeakTest (the supplier does not keep its owner), GalleryViewModelTest (no value before the first read, the loader sets the lists before its callback, a newer read wins).
- To see on the phone: the GalleryOpen lines (expected: the window at once; the viewer's first photo and the grid's first frame within a few hundred ms of «media listed»; «media listed» at the scan's time, the scan line tells which query costs - the other-RAW LIKE is the suspect); a second open without new photos «reused»; GalleryOcr «photos to read» 6 s after the open, not at it; no new HistogramThread per viewer open (adb shell ps -T <pid> | grep -c HistogramThread stays 1 at most).
- Not changed: the camera's ACTION_MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE broadcast after each save (photo output path) - it makes MediaProvider rescan right when the gallery is opened from the thumbnail.

### P618 - the DNG's and the photo's metadata: PhotonCamera's leftovers out, SCAMERA's facts in (owner, 2026-11-11: «Перепроверь exif данные которые записываются в dng, у нас там всё ещё остались старые хвосты от Photon Camera, исправь и обнови под нашу нынешнюю камеру»): DONE in code, host (native writer + exiftool, Robolectric); not seen on a phone DNG
- Inventory (DngCreator.setParameters -> dngCreator.cpp -> tiny_dng_writer.h; one DNG writer for the merged burst DNG and the reference RAW of every route: SHDR, Quad / Tetra mosaic DNG, FULLRES, 50 / 200 MP; the SCAM-*.zip diagnostics hold no DNG; android.hardware.camera2.DngCreator is not used). Every tag sat in IFD 0, there was no Exif IFD.
- PhotonCamera leftovers found: ImageDescription was PhotonCamera's "parameters:" list (hasGainMap, FrameCount of FrameNumberSelector which nothing sets, «Noise Merging=1.00» of a setting fixed at 1, «Align», «Color» = colorMethod, FocalL, «Version=0.98(30966)»); UniqueCameraModel "MODEL-BRAND-MANUFACTURER" ("V2454A-vivo-vivo"); ExifVersion "0220" in IFD 0; ExposureTime / FNumber / ISO / FocalLength in IFD 0 (exiftool -validate: 5 "Wrong IFD" warnings; Android's ExifInterface reads none of them there); the 4.75 mm / f/1.8 placeholders of FillDynamicParameters could be written as the lens; the dead saveSyntheticMosaicRaw (set ImageDescription and UniqueCameraModel a second time: duplicate IFD entries). On the photo: Copyright "SCAMERA" (the photographer's field), no Software, ApertureValue = the f-number (APEX is 2 log2 N), FocalLength truncated (the float 9.12 written 9.11), no DateTimeOriginal (the gallery's «Дата съёмки» reads it), the description the same list.
- Wrong otherwise: DateTime of the DNG = when the file was written (the photo's: when processing began - a queued shot minutes later), no SubSecTime / OffsetTime; ISO cast to a short (ISO 102400 -> 36864); no lens tags, no 35 mm focal length; the tiny_dng_writer constant RESUNIT_CENTIMETER = 2 (the inch: the value 2 written, 72 dpi, stays).
- Now (ShotExif, both files from the same facts): the shot's time = the instant its files are named (ImageSaver.detachForQueue / DefaultSaver, ImagePath.newBaseName(ms)), DateTime + DateTimeOriginal / Digitized + SubSecTime* + OffsetTime* (EXIF 2.31); an Exif IFD (34665) in the DNG (DNGImage::SetTag / WriteExifIFD: laid out before the strip, word-aligned, sorted): ExifVersion 0231, ExposureTime (1/n), FNumber, PhotographicSensitivity (65535 above it) + SensitivityType 3 + ISOSpeed (LONG), ApertureValue (APEX), FocalLength, FocalLengthIn35mmFilm, LensSpecification, LensMake, LensModel ("vivo X200 Ultra back camera 9.12mm f/1.69"); IFD 0: LensInfo, DefaultCropOrigin / Size = the photo's 4:3 crop of an ISZ / native-mosaic frame (IszAspectCrop.box); UniqueCameraModel "vivo V2454A camera 5" (Make, Build.MODEL, the physical camera: each a sensor with its own matrices); ImageDescription "SCAMERA / Frames / Camera / Colour [/ Film] / RAW=merged burst|one frame / Route=SHDR"; Software stays "SCAMERA <versionName> (<versionCode>) <sha8>" (P214c, now in the photo too); IFD 0 sorted with each tag once (a tag set twice keeps its last value).
- FocalLengthIn35mmFilm only where the field of view is known: focal x 43.27 mm / the sensor's diagonal (SENSOR_INFO_PHYSICAL_SIZE) x the field's zoom - the DNG 1 (a SabreCrop window: the frame's diagonal over the window's), the photo its digital zoom's crop (above 1.005); an ISZ / native-mosaic shot (iszAspect4x3) none - the sensor's in-sensor crop is not in its metadata. The lens: the shot's LENS_FOCAL_LENGTH / LENS_APERTURE (its result or request), else the camera's declared ones, else no tag (the placeholders stay for the processing that reads them: pixels unchanged).
- Unchanged on purpose (rendering): every colour / level / noise / shading tag (ColorMatrix, ForwardMatrix, CameraCalibration, AsShotNeutral, CalibrationIlluminant, Black / WhiteLevel, LinearizationTable, BaselineExposure, NoiseProfile, OpcodeList2 GainMap, CFA, ActiveArea), DNGVersion 1.3, Orientation (the front camera's DNG not mirrored, the photo is: as before), the image data (check_dng_metadata compares them byte for byte with a file without the new tags). Not written: GPS (the app records none), Artist / Copyright, CameraSerialNumber, ProfileName, ExposureProgram / Flash (not in Parameters).
- Host: tools/check_dng_metadata.cpp (host-native-c; also exiftool -validate on its file: OK, the old writer's file: 5 warnings), ShotExifTest, DngCreatorExifTagsTest; LensFilterAtPressTest / ShotLookAtPressTest / IszAspectCaptureTest stub ImagePath.newBaseName(long) too.
- To check on a phone DNG: exiftool -a -G1 -s on a merged DNG and a reference RAW: Exif IFD present, DateTimeOriginal / SubSec / OffsetTime equal to the file name's time and to the JPEG's, LensModel of the camera used (main / tele / UW), FocalLengthIn35mmFilm near the stock camera's label on a plain module and absent on ISZ, ISO / exposure of the reference frame, UniqueCameraModel per camera, Lightroom / ACR open it (exiftool -validate clean).
- P620 part (coordinator, for the gallery's thumbnails of t-thumb: «our files carry no embedded previews»), on top of P618: (1) every photo EXIF block (ExifBlock.app1Segment with the photo: the JPEG bitmap path, the streamed JPEG of P483, Ultra HDR, HEIC 8 / 10-bit, AVIF) gets a baseline JPEG thumbnail in IFD1 (PhotoThumbnail: 512 px on the long side, the photo's aspect, its pixels upright as the photo's, quality 85, else 70 / 55 / none so the APP1 stays <= 64 KB; Compression 6, JPEGInterchangeFormat / Length, X / YResolution, ResolutionUnit). Made from the rendered photo, never by decoding the file: the bitmap's rows (getPixels) or the streamed JPEG's final readback (PostPipeline.JpegPlan.wrap now also gets the RGBA pixels), the same 4 x 4 box samples on both, so the streamed file stays the bytes of the bitmap path (JpegStreamSaveTest). WebP (ExifInterface rewrite) gets none. (2) The DNG is written before the post pipeline (the reference RAW / merged mosaic leave memory first), so the photo does not exist then: once the photo is saved, DngPreview appends the developed photo, 1024 px, turned back to the sensor's orientation (the DNG's Orientation turns previews as the raw), as a SubIFD of IFD 0 (NewSubFileType 1, Compression 7, YCbCr 4:2:0, PreviewColorSpace sRGB / unknown for P3, PreviewApplicationName = Software): its JPEG, its IFD and a copy of IFD 0 with SubIFDs go to the end of the file and the header's IFD 0 offset moves last; no byte of the raw file moves, the raw stays IFD 0 (NewSubFileType 0); the media scanner is told again. Not for the mosaic DNG alone, RAW-only shots and the front camera (its photo mirrored, its DNG not). 1024 only (no 2048-4096: a second JPEG and more of the readback for the viewer's use, not asked for now). exiftool -validate on the native writer's DNG after the append: OK, PreviewImage 1024x768 extracted. (3) HEIC 'thmb' item: not done (androidx HeifWriter has no thumbnail item; the 10-bit writer would need a second HEVC encode); its EXIF has the IFD1 JPEG thumbnail.
- P620 cost, host JVM (Robolectric): a 12 MP readback -> 512 px 28 ms, -> 1024 px 45 ms; a 12 MP bitmap -> the EXIF thumbnail + APP1 89 ms (row reads through JNI); the DNG append 2 ms. On the phone: the log lines «EXIF thumbnail WxH qQ: N B, APP1 M B in T ms» and «DNG preview WxH N KB in T ms». PhotoThumbnailTest (sizes, ExifInterface hasThumbnail / getThumbnailRange / 512x384 decodable in the photo's orientation, the main image's bytes after the APP1 = the encoder's, the 64 KB limit, the readback's samples, the DNG preview: nothing moved, IFD 0 entries kept + SubIFDs, the preview IFD's tags, 1024x768 decodable, turned back, a second append refused).
### P619 - the camera's LUTs and film simulations in the gallery editor (owner, 2026-11-11: «Добавь возможность в нашем редакторе в галерее применять луты из камеры и симуляции плёнок»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- The editor's new tab «LUT» (after «Стили»; icon ui_ic_film): a segmented «LUT · Плёнка». LUT: the camera tray's list (ItemOrder.luts: «Нет», FilmLooks' five, every .cube of Download/SCAMERA/LUT in the user's order) as cards showing the photo through each LUT, «Сила». Film: «Без плёнки» and FilmSim.STOCKS as cards (the photo through the stock's first-phase table, 17 a side), then the tray's controls with the tray's ranges (LutTray.filmParams): Сила, Печать (not for a reversal stock), Формат, Зерно, Экспозиция, Контраст and Цветоразделение (DIR) (measured stocks), Экспозиция печати (not for slides). Card pictures: the editor's preview without the look read back at 160 px (EditorView.thumbnail), so they show the photo as edited.
- Where it applies (EditRenderer.renderLook, after the main pass, before finish's geometry / vignette / the editor's own grain): the main pass's display-encoded sRGB through the camera's DISPLAY table - a LUT alone is the camera's own table (FilmLut.load) mixed by its strength; a film is the camera's display route, the one its ISP viewfinder and the settings' preview take (FilmChain.loadLut: FilmSim.lut first, then the reference model's DISPLAY table from FilmPreviewLut), with the LUT on its print (FilmChain.compose(film, 1, user, s)). Lookup: editor/look.glsl = preview/main_fs.glsl's uLutOn block (texel centres, the .cube domain). The film's strength is the shader's mix (the camera bakes it: FilmChain.previewDisplay) - the same within 0.085 of an 8-bit code (FinishedLookTest, half-float tables). Not the photo's scene route (FilmChain.scene, why/combine FILM_SIM 1): a finished JPEG has no scene light; for a DNG the editor's develop has it, the exact route is not wired (the editor's tone would need to be the camera's).
- Film grain with a format: the camera's FilmGrain shaders as they are (film/noise + film/blur x2 + film/grain_sf with FilmSim.grainLut 17 for a measured stock; film/grain for our B&W model), sized on the whole photo's long side in the texture's pixels (the preview's 2048 px, the zoom region's level, the export's reader size), the noise / clumps hashed on the photo's pixel position: film/noise.glsl and film/grain.glsl gained `originU` (unset = 0 in the camera: bit-identical, check_editor_look). Halation, in-emulsion softness and the film's diffusion are not offered: they spread light above display white, which a finished picture does not have.
- Tables load off the main thread (EditLook.Loader, two phases as the viewfinder; FinishedLook keeps its own small caches so the camera's single-entry FilmChain / FilmLut.chosen caches are not evicted); the film's and a lone LUT's strength never rebuild a table (shader uniform). The copy (EditExporter) takes the table the preview ends at - the reference one when it is coming (waits up to 30 s, not when the engine is unavailable) - applies it on every 1024 px tile (overlap = max(editor's, grain blur reach); EditLookTest: the editor's own overlap always covers the grain for every stock / format at 1000..16384 px, so the zoom's regions are exact too), memory per tile as before (+2 RGBA8 and 2 RGBA16F tile textures with grain), output capped at 64 MP as before. EXIF: Software = DngMetadata.software() on every copy; ImageDescription gains "Edit look: LUT <name> <n> %; film <recipe>; on the finished colour".
- State: EditState.lut / film / filmPrint / filmFormat + Params LUT_AMOUNT, FILM_AMOUNT, FILM_GRAIN, FILM_EXPOSURE, FILM_CONTRAST, FILM_DIR, FILM_PRINT_EV (JSON "lk"; an unedited photo is still {"v":1}): undo / redo, «Сбросить всё», styles, copy / paste and the long-press «before» treat them as tone; the main pass's tone key leaves them out.
- Host: FinishedLookTest (a LUT alone = the camera's table and strength; film + LUT on the print at .55 within 0.085 codes of FilmChain.previewDisplay; first phase within 0.075 codes of FilmChain.lut; two phases, a cached reference alone, the export's final table), EditLookTest (film settings = the tray's controls, table keys, FilmGrain's numbers, tile overlap, JSON / undo / before, the copy's description), EditLookShotsTest (the tab's two sections built, cards = tray list / stocks, screenshots), tools/check_editor_look.py in host-shaders (look.glsl == main_fs.glsl's LUT stage bit for bit on RGBA8, within 0.63 codes of numpy trilinear; grain tiles == the whole picture beyond the blur reach; originU unset == the camera's shaders).
- To see on the phone: the tab, its card pictures, a .cube from Download/SCAMERA/LUT, a film's colour changing once more ~1 s after picking it (the reference table replacing the first phase), grain at 100 % zoom and in the saved copy (no seams at 1024 px tile edges), a 50 MP / 200 MP copy with a film and grain (time, memory), the copy's EXIF.
### P620 - gallery thumbnails: the cheapest large-enough source, never a full decode for a cell (owner, 2026-11-11: «В галерее ускорь загрузку превью фотографий, равов и всех других форматов. Особенно фото снятых в 50мп. Не обязательно прогружать полностью фото в полном при открытом списке»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- The old path, per format (P617's tree): the grid, the viewer's film strip (132 px), the albums' covers and the picker each made their own Glide request of the uri with centerCrop at their own size - four decodes of one 50 MP file, none shared. JPEG: Glide's Downsampler, inSampleSize 16 for a 360 px cell (libjpeg-turbo's DCT 1/8 + 1/2; host, Pillow / libjpeg-turbo, a 23.8 MB 8160x6144 q95 baseline: 199 ms, full decode 352 ms, progressive 804 ms); no use of an EXIF thumbnail. DNG: DngGlideDecoder copied the whole stream (100 MB at 50 MP, 400 MB at 200 MP) to a temporary file, then rendered every raw sample in Java (our DNGs have no preview IFD, P370), the packed 10-bit rows read bit by bit (host, synthetic 8160x6144: 16-bit 590 ms, 10-bit packed 980 ms a thumbnail; the viewer's 4096 px render 3.65 s). Other RAWs: the same temporary copy for LibRaw. HEIC / WebP / AVIF: Glide's sampled decode (a 50 MP HEIC: the whole HEVC grid). Video: Glide's frame. The disk cache (Glide's default 250 MB, ~30 KB a thumbnail) was shorter than a library of ~9000 photos plus the viewer's 4096 px pictures (2-5 MB each), so a scroll back decoded the 50 MP files again. No preload; the viewer's JPEG page stayed black until its base layer (a 50 MP JPEG: a few hundred ms).
- New model GalleryThumb (gallery/glide; ThumbLoader passes it through, ThumbDecoder decodes it, ScameraGlideModule registers both): uri + DATA path + name + the GalleryKeys key (length + mtime, P81) + cover/fit; the thumbnail is not cropped (its short side covers the cell, the cell's ImageView crops), so one entry per file and size serves the grid, the film strip, the picker's and the viewer's first picture, in the memory and the RESOURCE disk cache. The request (GalleryThumb.request) falls back to the old uri request through Glide's decoders when ThumbDecoder throws.
- ThumbDecoder, per kind (ThumbPlan.kindOf: first bytes, then the name): JPEG - the EXIF IFD1 thumbnail when it has the photo's aspect (2 %) and 80 % of the needed size (ThumbPlan.enough; host: a 512x384 one decodes in 1 ms), else BitmapFactory from the descriptor at the largest power-of-two sample that still covers the cell (ThumbPlan.sampleSize: 1/16 for 50 MP, 1/32 for 200 MP), the EXIF orientation applied, the result scaled to the cell when > 1.25x; DNG - the file mapped in place (no copy), an embedded JPEG preview when large enough, else DngPreview.read(..., thumbnail = true): an uncompressed raw reads only SPARSE_ROWS (2) CFA row pairs of each output block, every column (host: 16-bit 59 ms, 10-bit packed 103 ms, was 590 / 980; LJ92 raw still decoded whole); a DNG DngPreview cannot read goes to LibRaw; other RAWs - LibRaw on the DATA path when readable (a copy only when not); HEIF - ThumbnailUtils (Android 10+: the HEIF thumbnail item when the file has one), else a sampled ImageDecoder decode; AVIF - AvifGlideDecoder at the size; PNG / WebP / GIF / BMP / others - a sampled ImageDecoder decode; video - MediaStore's thumbnail (Android 10+, kept by MediaProvider), else MediaMetadataRetriever.getScaledFrameAtTime. MediaStore thumbnails are not used for photos: first time they are the same full decode in MediaProvider plus an encode and an IPC, at most ~512 px, invalidated only by its scan (our files are rewritten after the row exists, P81), and a DNG goes through the platform raw decoder (black on Pixel 7, P53).
- DngPreview, the same pixels faster (old vs new md5 equal on 16-bit and 10-bit 50 MP synthetic DNGs at 360 and 4096 px): rows read in bulk and accumulated with stepped block / CFA / black positions (addRow), packed rows through a bit accumulator, the median / 99 % luma by quickselect instead of a sort, srgb8 by exact steps (SRGB8_STEP, bisected on srgb8 itself; 0 mismatches in 20 M values). The viewer's 4096 px DNG render: 3.65 s -> 1.34 s (host).
- Grid: visible cells Priority.HIGH; ThumbPreloader (the recyclerview-integration artifact is not in the build) preloads 4 rows ahead in the scroll direction at LOW with the cells' exact request (a memory hit at bind), at most 48 in flight, none for a file still being written; LibraryAdapter.setThumbPx rounds to 32 px; GalleryThumb.setGridPx keeps the size (prefs) for the viewer. Glide: disk cache 1/20 of the free space, 250..768 MB (ScameraGlideModule.diskCacheBytes, Glide's directory kept), memory cache 3 screens (was 2). Bitmaps stay ARGB_8888 software: RGB_565 bands skies on OLED, HARDWARE would be read back for the disk cache's encode and the compare screenshot (P117).
- Viewer: a JPEG page shows the grid's cached thumbnail (memory / disk only, ViewerPreview, at most 150 ms on «GalleryPreview» threads) as SSIV's preview with the frame's size and the EXIF rotation set explicitly (the thumbnail turned back; mirrored orientations: no preview), then the tiles as before; HEIC / WebP / AVIF / DNG pages get it as Glide's thumbnail() until the 4096 px picture; Glide bitmaps reset the page's orientation to USE_EXIF (showBitmap). DNG / RAW pages read the file in place (GalleryThumb.fit). Neighbours (offscreen 2) and the full resolution on zoom (tiles) unchanged.
- Log (tag GalleryThumb, ThumbTrace, from GalleryOpenTrace.opened): «first <kind> thumbnail: <source> T ms (WxH -> wxh)» once per kind and source (exif 512x384 / decoded 1/16 [progressive] / dng-preview / dng-raw sparse / raw thumbnail / platform-thumbnail / avif-decoder / mediastore / frame), every 50 decodes «thumbnails decoded since the open: N (kind/source n x mean ms, max)», a failed decode «<kind> thumbnail of NAME failed: ... - Glide's decoders try it»; P617's «first 12 thumbnails ready +T ms (memory a, disk cache b, decoded c)» now goes on «, decoded: jpeg/decoded 8, dng/dng-raw 2» (the open's decodes so far by kind / source).
- For the DNG / EXIF writers (not changed here): our 50 / 200 MP JPEG has no EXIF thumbnail, so every first view of it is the ~200 ms (host) entropy decode; an IFD1 JPEG thumbnail of 512 px on the long side (512x384 for 4:3, the photo's aspect, unturned like the main image, baseline q85, ~15-40 KB, inside the 64 KB APP1) makes it ~1 ms. Our DNG has one IFD (no preview): a reduced-resolution IFD (NewSubFileType 1, Compression 7 = JPEG baseline, PhotometricInterpretation 6 YCbCr or 2 RGB, 1024 px on the long side, the rendered sRGB picture, in IFD0 or a SubIFD) would replace the sparse raw render (and the viewer's 4096 px render, if 2048-4096 px). The HEIC writer could add a thumbnail item ('thmb' iref, ~512 px HEVC) for ThumbnailUtils.
- Host: ThumbPlanTest (kinds by bytes, 50 / 200 MP sample sizes, when an EXIF thumbnail is enough, the JPEG header with an EXIF thumbnail in both byte orders, progressive, damaged EXIF), DngThumbTest (2 of 11 row pairs read, the sparse thumbnail equals the full render within 1, srgb8 steps exact, quickselect = sort), GalleryThumbTest (cache identity follows the file and cover / fit, grid size kept, disk cache size, the decode log), ThumbPreloaderTest, ViewerPreviewTest; the gallery's 42 test classes 223/223.
- To see on the phone: GalleryThumb «first jpeg thumbnail: decoded 1/16 … ms» for the owner's 50 MP JPEG (expected about 1.5-3x the host's 199 ms) and «exif …» for photos of other cameras; «first dng thumbnail: dng-raw sparse …»; P617's first-12 line mostly «disk cache» on a second open; no black viewer page before the tiles; no wrong turn of a portrait JPEG page while the preview shows (the EXIF rotation set explicitly).
