FdRegionDecoder (set on every page) decodes from the descriptor (nothing copied) with up to min(3, cores / 2) decoders on their own descriptors, so a base layer's / a 1:1 zoom's tiles decode in parallel (a tile near the bottom of a 200 MP JPEG entropy-decodes every row above it; one BitmapRegionDecoder decodes one region at a time). The first picture: the grid's cached thumbnail (ViewerPreview). No full-size bitmap: tiles only at 1:1.
  - Viewer, Ultra HDR: the HDR rendition was decoded at SIZE_ORIGINAL (a 200 MP one: 800 MB + gain map) and with DiskCacheStrategy.DATA (the whole JPEG copied into Glide's disk cache each time, pushing out hundreds of thumbnails): now AT_MOST 8192 (200 MP at 1/2 = 8160 x 6144 with its gain map; 50 MP whole as before) and no disk cache.
  - Viewer, HEIC / WebP / AVIF / DNG fallback (Glide, 4096): SAMPLED_INSIDE - CENTER_INSIDE but MEMORY rounding when the picture is twice the request or more: 50 MP sampled 1/2, 200 MP 1/4 by the decoder (CENTER_INSIDE decoded 50 MP whole, 200 MB, and 200 MP at 8160 x 6144, then scaled). A 27 MP photo keeps its 4096 px. A HEIC's HEVC grid is still decoded whole inside the platform decoder (only a thumbnail item at save time avoids it).
  - Swipe back: the 4096 px pictures stay in Glide's disk cache (AUTOMATIC, as before; the bigger cache keeps them), JPEG pages show the preview at once and their base layer again.
  - Histogram (ExifDialogViewModel, 800 px): a DNG / RAW through GalleryThumb (it copied a 200 MP DNG whole, 400 MB). Share: a URI, no decode. Editor (not changed, t_edit's files): the preview is a power-of-two decode to 2048 px; its export reads JPEG tiles through BitmapRegionDecoder.newInstance(InputStream) (EditSource), which copies the whole 200 MP file into native memory - a descriptor (ParcelFileDescriptor) would not.
  - Host: JpegStripsTest (strips of whole MCU rows: height, no DRI / EXIF / MPF, ICC kept, entropy bytes; progressive, a partial-row interval, RSTs out of order, missing strips -> not split), BigPictureLimitsTest (SAMPLED_INSIDE rounding, the HDR cap, decoders a page), DngThumbTest.theViewersBlockKeepsA200MpDngAt4096.
  - To see on the phone: «first jpeg thumbnail: strips 48 x 1/8 … ms» on a 200 MP JPEG, «strips 16 x 1/8» on 50 MP; a 200 MP JPEG page's tiles at 1:1 (no black tiles, no OOM), an Ultra HDR 200 MP page (8160 x 6144), a 200 MP DNG page (4080 x 3072, no OOM).

### P621 - the gallery as the system's default gallery (owner, 2026-11-11: «сделай чтобы нашу галерею можно было выбирать в системе как по умолчанию»): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Before: GalleryActivity (label @string/gallery_name «SGallery», icon ic_gallery_launcher; the launcher alias GalleryActivityLauncher with the same) claimed VIEW image/* (file / content, DEFAULT + BROWSABLE), VIEW vnd.android.cursor.dir/image, VIEW of RAW extensions as octet-stream / file paths, com.android.camera.action.REVIEW image/*, EDIT image/*; no video (no player then, the old manifest note), no PICK / GET_CONTENT (no pick mode), no MediaStore REVIEW actions, no APP_GALLERY. A VIEW of another app's file read the whole library on the main thread and put the file in front of it.
- Manifest: REVIEW filter = com.android.camera.action.REVIEW + android.provider.action.REVIEW + android.provider.action.REVIEW_SECURE for image/* and video/*; VIEW image/* and video/*; PICK (DEFAULT; image/*, video/*, vnd.android.cursor.dir/image|video); GET_CONTENT (DEFAULT + OPENABLE; image/*, video/*, which the system also matches to */*); the alias gets MAIN + DEFAULT + APP_GALLERY (the launcher's / system's «gallery app» selector). Labels and icons: the activity's and the alias's own («SGallery», not translated, like app_name «SCAMERA»; the camera's launcher icon unchanged). Not claimed: MediaStore.ACTION_PICK_IMAGES (the system photo picker's contract: several items, its extras), GET_CONTENT of other types, IMAGE_CAPTURE.
- GalleryActivity.routeOf (Route: VIEWER, SECURE_REVIEW, VIDEO, EDIT, PICK, LIBRARY, CAMERA): a video VIEW / REVIEW (video/* type, MediaStore's video collection, or a video name when the type is missing) plays in VideoPlayerActivity.openExternal (the read grant passed on with ClipData; the gallery activity finishes); a MediaStore / file:// photo opens in its library with its neighbours (as before), another app's content URI (FileProvider, Downloads, documents) shows that item alone without reading the library; REVIEW_SECURE: that item alone, setShowWhenLocked, and leaving the photo (back / swipe down) closes the gallery instead of the library; PICK / GET_CONTENT: the library, a tap returns the item (RESULT_OK, its MediaStore URI with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION and ClipData) when it is of the kind asked for (image / video / any), else a toast «Этот файл сюда не подходит: выберите другой»; one item even when EXTRA_ALLOW_MULTIPLE is set; MAIN + LAUNCHER or APP_GALLERY: the library. A foreign DNG page that cannot be mapped (a pipe) falls back to its stream through Glide's decoders.
- Host: GalleryIntentRoutesTest (each intent its screen, neighbours only for MediaStore / paths, the pick's kind and its readable result), GalleryManifestTest (now: PICK / GET_CONTENT image + video and video VIEW / REVIEW claimed, MediaStore REVIEW / REVIEW_SECURE, foreign HEIC / DNG / AVIF VIEW, the APP_GALLERY category; still no PICK_IMAGES, no other GET_CONTENT, no capture-for-result) - the old «no pick / no video» assertions were turned around with the owner's request, their reason (no pick mode, no player) is gone.
- To see on the phone: vivo OriginOS Settings -> Apps -> Default apps (whether it lists a «Gallery» entry and whether SGallery is offered in it: AOSP has no gallery role, an OEM list may use its own rule); «Open with» from a file manager / Telegram / Chrome downloads for JPEG, HEIC, AVIF, DNG, MP4 (SGallery with its icon, «Always» sticks); a pick from a messenger (the photo arrives; whether the caller can read the MediaStore URI with the grant); the stock camera's thumbnail with SGallery as default (REVIEW); REVIEW_SECURE only comes from a camera on the lock screen.

### P616 - the viewfinder while a shot is processed, round 2 (owner, 2026-11-11: «Ты не исправил тормоза видоискателя во время обработки»; vivo V2454A, SM8750 «sun», Adreno 830, build 31254 5b8d8d04, log adb59147-SCAMERA_Log_2026-11-11): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Read (7 shots, SHOT SUMMARY / SHOT TIMELINE, VF_DRAW, VF_RAW «stages», Pipeline node times; the app's lines carry no timestamps, so a draw is placed by its t=+ and the node times):
  - shot 1 (vf_merge 11.0fps/1348ms, vf_post 0.0fps/1008ms, «frozen for the whole post»): no stall - the settings screen was opened during the merge (SettingsActivity «generateTunablePreferences» right after VF_DRAW t=+2.3s, a pref_scam_hybrid_processing click during the post) and the viewfinder stayed paused until after the post (the GL context made anew after the SHOT SUMMARY: «viewfinder GPU priority ... granted=high», «VF_DRAW t=+5.8s drawn=3 maxGap=3464ms»). Not a cold compile either: post_compile_ms=0/0+52bin/63 (52 programs from the driver binaries in 63 ms).
  - the merges: 28.5 - 29.6 fps with gaps of 64 - 92 ms in four shots (the worker, its own process at medium priority, does not stall the viewfinder); shot 5's 19.6fps/755ms is a lens switch during the merge (onAuxButtonClicked -> restartCamera, camera 3 -> 5); shot 3's 19.3fps/321ms camera 4 just opened, its RAW stream ~17 frames/s («fresh 12.6/s», arrive mean 57 / max 526 ms) and the camera thread's ring copy up to 267 ms (cam 24.8/299.4) near the merge's end.
  - the post: each of the five shots whose viewfinder frames were plain Bayer 4096 x 3072 drawn from the ring slot (24 MB a frame) had one draw of 240 - 339 ms («slow draw ... after node ScamRgb», i.e. inside ScamHdrDenoise, 360 - 490 ms), and VF_RAW's window with it «upload 10.2/296.0» (296 of the draw's 298 ms in glTexSubImage2D; 4 - 5 ms otherwise) and «wait 3.6/149.3». The one shot with 2048 x 1536 Quad cell means (6 MB, shot 4) had none (its 325 ms gap: the camera's stream, arrive max 589 ms). ScamHdrDenoise is WhyResolveDenoise: the SNR's compute pass (GLProg.computeManual's glFinish, then glReadPixels), then 2 strips x 3 passes in 256-row blocks (48 submissions of ~10 ms GPU). The node's CPU time equals its GPU time: the post's thread sat inside the driver (glFinish, glFlush on a full queue) the whole node, and the viewfinder's upload in the same process waited behind it (inferred: the viewfinder's context is high priority, the post's medium; no compile, no GC line, no main-thread work in the window).
- Done: (1) GpuPace (processing/opengl): on the post pipeline's thread between GLBasePipeline.runNodes' start and end, a fence after each block (GLProg.drawBlocks' flushes, the row loops of WhyResolveDenoise / WhyMsDenoise / DenoiseStats now a submission a block) and, with more than 2 pending, a polled wait for the oldest (glClientWaitSync with a zero timeout, 0.25 ms sleeps; given up after 3 s): the GPU holds at most 2 post blocks, the next one queued while the thread waits. GLProg.computeManual / computeAuto's glFinish is the same polled fence there. ### P624 - «Статика»: a third merge route for still scenes, «Lucas-Kanade Reloaded» without the neural denoiser (owner, 2026-11-11: «По поводу статьи, мы с неё возьмём гораздо больше и сделаем третий вариант склейки "Статика". Он будет чисто для статики и мы можем для него взять абсолютно всё что можно из статьи, кроме нейрошумодава»; the same day: Vulkan first with a GLES fallback, «чтобы это работало на большинстве смартфонов и при этом работало быстро»; RawLens 2.2.45 as a reference, «не обязательно копировать один в один»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- The paper (Lecouat, Ponce, Mairal, ICCV 2021, arXiv 2104.06191): y_k = D B W_k x + n, HQS: z-step (gradient on the data term), p-step (one Gauss-Newton step of each frame's motion against the HR estimate), x-step (a learned ResUNet). Taken: the observation model on the RAW mosaic (W_k = the GPU homography + a Gauss-Newton translation field per 64 px tile, B = the box over the RAW pixel, s x s bilinear sub-samples, D = the CFA site), HQS with mu growing (8 sigma -> sigma / sqrt(K)), 3 data steps per iteration, the p-step every iteration of the first four then every second, the 2x HR solve (the 1x photo = its 2 x 2 box: Phase 1, noiseless known motion 52 dB against 41 dB of a 1x solve, whose bilinear model blurs). Not taken: the neural denoiser (replaced, below), the learned step sizes (c = 1.8 with a Jacobi preconditioner - the global Schur bound of RawLens is per pixel here, since the inverse-variance weights of dark pixels would shrink the global step everywhere), the 4x output, the end-to-end training (scalar tuning on synthetic bursts instead).
- The prior: in the z-step, not as a plug-and-play x-step - a Tikhonov smoothness of the white-balanced colour differences (gR R - G, gB B - G: the R / B null space of a 2x Bayer solve; x(1 + 3 (4 - Bayer quadrants the frames reach)): a tripod burst without shift gets the demosaic's colour prior) and a Huber-TV of the white-balanced luma, both x the frame noise variance (relative to the ISO 400 level), the luma term x1 up to ISO 400, x0.3 from ISO 1600 (log-linear). Measured against RawLens's sliding-DCT plug-and-play prior and TV (Phase 1): the DCT prior lost 1-4 dB on the synthetic set.
- Added (the paper's weak point is motion): a static-scene check on the 1/8 thumbnails (a frame with > 3 % moving 32 px blocks is left out; fewer than max(3, half) frames left -> «Качество»), a robust weight per sample (the 5 x 5 mean of its residual against our noise model plus a misregistration term, Cauchy-like, then the Wronski 5 x 5 minimum filter; from the third iteration), > 10 % of samples rejected -> «Качество»; clipped samples (>= 0.98) out of the data term; the «Качество» noise check (flat blocks) scales the header model; the CPU Lucas-Kanade affine when a frame's GPU homography fails; a per-frame brightness gain from the thumbnails (AE / light drift: e193420 drifts 10 % over the burst - left in, the frames' sites disagree and the 2x solve draws a Bayer-period checker, G 1.1 % -> 0.07 %); the green sites balanced from the base frame.
- Phase 1 (host): numpy prototype (scratchpad static_proto/static_lk.py), then the GPU code itself on synthetic bursts (3 scenes from the owner's photos at 4x, hand-held affine motion, pixel integration, our noise model at ISO 100 / 400 / 1600, 14 frames, 256 x 256) against the host worker's «Быстрый» / «Качество» (gamma PSNR after the best common denoise, static vs the better Sabre): 1x map +1.6 / +2.1 / +1.5 dB (ISO 100 / 400 / 1600), room +0.5 / +0.6 / -0.4, tree +1.8 / +1.2 / +0.4; 2x (against Sabre's own 2x grid) map +1.5 / +1.9 / +1.1, room +0.6 / +1.1 / -0.1, tree +1.1 / +1.3 / +0.7; SSIM higher at 1x everywhere. RawLens's numpy reference (128 px crops, ISO 400, 1x): TV prior 40.6 / 37.1 / 36.6 dB, ours 42.2 / 37.7 / 37.5, Sabre 41.3 / 37.2 / 35.7. Real bursts (no truth; crops in the scratchpad): sc (wires against the sky, ISO 100) clean wires without the stair-steps of «Качество» and the coloured dots of «Быстрый»; n124513a (ISO 12800) the same detail, finer-grained noise; b1 (a car, wind) and e193420 (later frames drifting) fall back / leave the moving frames out. Host time (llvmpipe / lavapipe, a loaded 4-core VM): 256 x 256 x 14 frames 5-8 s; GPU share gather 51 %, resid 20 %, field 14 %, init 8 %.
- Worker (scam-static-merge.h, scam-static-gpu.h, scam-static-shaders.h, scam-static-spirv.h): tune staticMerge 1 (+ staticIters / staticZSteps / staticScale / staticChroma / staticLuma / staticHuber / staticRobust / staticMotionMax / staticFrames / staticTile / staticVulkan / staticStripMB / staticProfile); hybridReconstruct takes it before the fast route; fallback = the SCAM merge («Качество») with the same input. Plain Bayer only (Quad / Tetra / DCG -> «Качество»), normal frames only (up to 16), the app's output size (1x, 1.5x = the 2x solve resampled, 2x). Row strips with 16-row margins (sized by staticStripMB and the device's storage block), the P613 strip guard on every output row (a NaN stamp the output pass did not overwrite fails the merge -> «Качество»).
- Programs (one GLSL source, GLES 3.10 and Vulkan GLSL 450): init (Gaussian shift-and-add), resid (residual + base weight / the (r, w) pairs), robust, min (+ counters), gather (the adjoint as a gather - no atomics - with the Jacobi preconditioner and the regularisers: the z-step), field (the p-step: per tile and frame, J^T W J by central differences, a 2 x 2 solve coupled to the neighbours, one workgroup each; a subgroupAdd variant on Vulkan), output. Per iteration 3 + 2 x 3 dispatches, + the field and two copies; one submission and one fence per strip.
- Backends: Vulkan 1.1 compute (libvulkan by dlopen, SPIR-V generated offline by tools/static/gen_static_spirv.cpp with the NDK's glslc, a pipeline cache on disk, compute-to-compute barriers, timestamps per pass) and GLES 3.1 (its own context, program binaries cached). staticVulkan -1 (default, scam_dev static_vulkan): the first static shot of a shader version and driver runs a self-test (a 192 x 128 synthetic burst with a known answer) on both, keeps Vulkan only when it matches GLES (max |difference| <= 2e-3) and the truth (>= 30 dB) and is the faster; the verdict in the program cache directory (static-backend.txt); a Vulkan failure mid-shot reruns the shot on GLES and marks Vulkan bad for that version / driver. A denylist of Vulkan device names (empty; SCAM_STATIC_VK_DENY for tests). fp16: not used for arithmetic (the residuals sit at the noise floor, below fp16's 1e-3 step at 1.0), reported per device.
- Log lines: HYBRID STATIC ALIGN (inliers / rms per frame, LK fallbacks), CHECK (moving-block fraction per frame), NOISE, SELF-TEST (both times, difference, PSNRs, verdict), GPU (backend, device / driver, subgroup size, fp16, pipeline cache hit), FIELD (mean / max |translation| per frame), DATA (rejected % and normalised residual per frame), GPU ms (per pass, Vulkan timestamps), MERGE (frames, sizes, strips, iterations, times), the STAGES line.
- App: «Режим обработки» fast | quality | static (PreferenceKeys.processingMode / staticProcessing; any other stored value reads as fast; the summary - the long-press help - describes «Статика»); staticTuning() adds staticMerge 1, staticIters (pref_scam_hybrid_static_iters 4..16, default 8; SettingsNumericRules) and staticVulkan (scam_dev static_vulkan, DevKeys); hybridOutputMode() returns pref_scam_hybrid_static_sr (sensor | 1.5x | 2x) while «Статика» is on (capture grid, photo size and caps as for Sabre 1.5x / 2x). «Склейка» -> category «Статика» with both rows. Capture unchanged: the burst's N frames of the ZSL ring (20 by default, the merge takes 16), the bracketed frames still captured for the «Качество» fallback, OIS as configured, no sensor-mode change.
- Host: tools/check_static_merge.cpp (host-native-c, ASan/UBSan): static >= best Sabre + 0.5 dB on a static synthetic burst on GLES and on Vulkan, the field takes a known homography error out, strips = one strip within 0.02, a moving object falls back to «Качество», Vulkan = GLES within 2e-3, the self-test and the auto choice (Vulkan parts skipped with a message without an ICD; the lane installs mesa-vulkan-drivers); tools/static/gen_static_spirv.cpp --check (host-shaders: every program compiles for GLES and Vulkan, the SPIR-V header is of the current sources); check_glsl_loop_shadow reads raw strings with any delimiter; StaticRouteTest (workflow list); SettingsModelCheck bounds.
- To see on a phone (X200 Ultra / Adreno 830, X200 Pro / Mali-G925, OnePlus, nubia, Pixel 7): «Режим обработки» = «Статика» on a tripod: the SELF-TEST line once (which backend won, both times), then GPU / FIELD / DATA / MERGE per shot; the time at 12 MP and 50 MP; fine detail (text, wires, foliage) against «Качество»; a scene with a passing car -> «fallback to the SCAM merge» or a clean result without ghosts.

### P615 - CaNetP v4: retrained on the bursts for a lower light floor of the gate (owner, 2026-11-11: «Параллельно займись обучением нашей нейросети по ХА на бурстах»; «Убедись что нейросеть будет одинаково хорошо работать на разных смартах»; after round 1: «Доучить порог»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- What ships is CaNetP (c1 over 8 inputs, P399's weight the 5th; MODE 4's gate, P399's boost, no-flip), not the kit's 4-input CaNet «v6» that P527 / P550 trained and compared. canet_p.glsl ported to numpy op for op and to torch (scratchpad canet7/tools/canetp.py): against the app's shader on Mesa llvmpipe with the app's FLOAT_16 textures every layer agrees to its fp16 step, the output to 0.004 (YB_LO 0.12 and 0.05); torch = numpy to 1e-8.
- Data. Bursts with an input: 25 of the reference app's (OPPO Find X8 Ultra, Snapdragon), its Tetra 20261109_135446 (new). The vivo V2419A night burst (2026-11-10, MediaTek / Mali) was scored in round 1 and has since been deleted from the scratchpad. The uploads newer than P550 hold no burst: SCAM-*.zip have only the stages (1/4 size, nearest sampled: X200 Ultra 10-27 / 10-29, vivo MTK 10-28 / 11-11), SCA_*.zip are final JPEGs, the nubia / OnePlus 16 SCAM-TEST zips are text. Merged with today's worker (292c5f54) at full size in the net's input units (shading colour, WB, colour matrix, merge clip = 1). Train: 21 X8U bursts (lenses 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / the Tetra lens) + Tetra t2 / t3, lens groups sampled equally. Held out: X8U 140250 / 142021 (main), 140606 (lens 4), 142159 (lens 6 Quad), the new Tetra, and the six stage thumbnails (other phones: never trained on).
- Why P550 lost on the real fringe: (1) its target was our merge, blurred, and the merge carries the lens's own fringe (142159's fringe pixels: input chroma 0.0459, that target 0.0441 - keep it); (2) the kit's synthetic fringes are not ours: v3 fine-tuned on synthetic pairs only falls from -37.6 % to -14.5 % (142159); (3) for CaNetP the gate is the ceiling: with YB_LO 0.12 (the light beside a fringe must reach 0.12 .. 0.52 of white) 25 % of the X8U fringe pixels are inside it - no weights reach the rest.
- A missed damage: v3 turns magenta fringes on twigs / wires into yellow / teal lines (hue rotated > 40 °; P550's flip check is > 90 °): 142159 2827 px, 140606 9040; the chroma-magnitude measure counted it as a gain.
- Training (round 2): real pairs only - the merge -> its CA-free estimate (violet / magenta pixels next to a 3 x brighter light, not that light's own glow, take the chroma of the dark fringe-free pixels within 7 px, never more colour), supervised where the cleaner is sure (its fringe, outside the gate, a non-fringe hue); where it is unsure (a gated pixel of a fringe hue it left, and every green pixel) the hue may lose colour but not turn (cost 1.5 x the chroma across the input's) nor pass neutral (3 x); gate at YB_LO 0.05 (fringe pixels inside: X8U 25 -> 41.5 %, X200 Ultra thumbnails 40.5 -> 52.8 %, vivo MTK thumbnails 5.7 -> 24.4 %); v3 as the start, 10 epochs, 6000 pairs. Any synthetic share pulled the real fringe below v3 (round 1); the green fringe as a target gave a lavender rim round white bulbs (W6), so green stays unsupervised.
- Eval (pooled per group; real fringe = chroma of violet .. magenta pixels next to a 3 x brighter light, in -> out; ppm of pixels): X8U, 4 bursts: v3 -6.30 % / v4 -7.50 % (fringe hue left -7.0 / -8.0 %), hue rotated 286 / 100, colour off the fringe hues 18.7 / 11.5, neutral pixels tinted 57.8 / 1.2; per burst 142021 -0.3 / -2.9, 142159 -37.6 / -36.8, 140606 -19.6 / -17.8, 140250 -2.7 / -2.3. X8U Tetra (1 burst, 263 px: too few): -65.3 / -65.3 %. Stage thumbnails (1/4 size, a weak proxy): vivo MTK (2) -1.5 / -4.3 %, hue rotated 21 / 29; X200 Ultra main (3) -13.1 / -12.0 %, 101 / 56; X200 Ultra UW: no violet fringe, untouched. All full size: -6.33 / -7.53 %, hue rotated 230 / 80. Flips and added colour 0 everywhere. Not judged: V2419A (burst deleted; round 1's gate-0.05 model there -20.1 % against -13.5 %), nubia, OnePlus 16, Pixel 7 (no image).
- Synthetic checks through CaNetP: glow kept (blue LED 0.390 -> v3 0.349 / v4 0.390; green 0.579 -> 0.579 / 0.579; violet neon -> ~0.27 for both: P399's boost); white text on dark: no pixel gains > 0.02 chroma (max gain v3 0.020, v4 0.020); a clean window frame untouched; a fringed one: edge chroma error 0.138 -> v3 0.103 / v4 0.097; skin next to a highlight unchanged.
- fp16: the app keeps every intermediate in FLOAT_16 on every GPU (highp arithmetic). Activations <= 22 (fp16 max 65504). fp16 storage vs fp32: mean chroma change 1e-5 .. 3e-5, max 0.18 at one pixel (the boost / dead-zone switch; v3 the same 0.18 on 142159); all-fp16 arithmetic: max 0.12 at one pixel.
- Ship: assets/canet/canetp_v4.bin (v3's layer table; v3's file removed), CaNetP WEIGHTS / sha256, YB_LO 0.05 in canet_p.glsl, Settings and the XML default of «Яркость этого света»; SettingsMigration moves a stored former default 0.12 to 0.05 once (FRINGE_LIGHT_REV; a hand-set value stays). The method's default stays «Классическое». Host: CaNetPTest 5/5, HybridSettingsTest 54/54 (fringeNetLightFormerDefaultMovesOnce new), host-shaders PASS, check_shader_fp16 PASS, check_glsl_loop_shadow PASS, check_settings_model PASS.
- Open / the phone: X8U 140606 / 140250 keep a little more violet than v3 (-1.8 / -0.4 points), the X200 Ultra thumbnails -1.2 points; the JPEG after denoise / sharpening on a phone with «Нейросеть»; bursts (input.nch) from the nubia, OnePlus 16, Pixel 7, X200 Ultra, a vivo MTK to score those phones. Scratchpad: canet7/tools (port, GL check, generator, trainer, eval, synthetic scenes), out_canet8 (crops input | v3 | v4, table.md).

### P631 - Xiaomi 17 Ultra 50 MP on 1x: the full-size module row in a RAW-only session, its colour block measured (owner, 2026-11-11: «Исправь работу фулреза на Xiaomi 17 Ultra»; build 31256 c96317e0, a log and a screenshot: «JPEG 50 MP» on 1x, the viewfinder black with a white strip on the right): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- What «50 MP» was: not the FULLRES size switch (PhotoSize offers no 50 MP on Xiaomi: no device route) but module back1's «Режим сенсора» row 11 of camera 2 (SensorModeTable 43 rows: 0 and 11 8192x6144@30, the binned 4096x3072 rows 1-10), asked with org.codeaurora.qcamera3.sensor_meta_data.current_mode on the session and the requests, the RAW reader 8192x6144 of usage 0 (Camera2 lists RAW 4096x3072 only; capabilities 0 9 3 7 4 5 1 6 2 19 18 20: no ULTRA_HIGH_RESOLUTION_SENSOR, no maximum-resolution map - so no Camera2 MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION route on this camera). The pill reads the stream's size (P319).
- Log: «Поток ISP» Off (ispSurface 2): RAW-only session, viewfinder from the RAW (VF_DRAW 20.7 fps, «50 MP Bayer viewfinder bin»), the shot merged 8192x6144 (HYBRID FAST MERGE ... 8192x6144, JPEG 6144x8192). The owner then set On (1): the 1440x1920 ISP stream beside the 50 MP RAW gave six frames and the HAL stopped (PREVIEW_STALL «frames stopped», then code 5 on close); then «Фиктивное откл.» (3): the HAL failed every request (ERROR_REQUEST, «got error frame N» on every frame), three PREVIEW_STALL restarts of the same session, «leaving the camera as it is» - the black viewfinder. A session that the 0.6x tap's settings injected as Auto (ispSurface 0) configured RAW-only again.
- Second finding, same log: the 50 MP frames came without their black pedestal («RAW black floor: 36864 of 49152 blocks hold samples below 16.0 DN»). MosaicBlockDetector skips every tile whose sum over the declared black 64 does not reach 128 DN, so the viewfinder's measurement had no answer in 12 frames (no MosaicStream line at all) and drew the stream as a plain Bayer (block 1), while the merge took the row's declared Quad (SensorModePick.declaredBlock 2: «hybrid stream colour block: 2 (... pick-11, detector skipped)», merge_quad). One of the two was wrong; the log cannot say which (no pedestal hints at a HAL-made frame, i.e. a remosaic Bayer, but that is not proof).
- Done: XiaomiSensorRow (new). The Xiaomi 17 Ultra's full-size picked row (declaredBlock > 1) leaves the ISP stream out of its session whatever «Поток ISP» (Pick.ispOff, SensorModePick.ispStreamOff); on any Xiaomi a picked row whose session with the ISP stream stalled is RAW-only from the next restart (noteIspRefused, this app run). A picked Xiaomi row's viewfinder detector measures over the frame's own floor when it lies under half the declared black (detectorBlack / frameFloor, the 2 % percentile of the centre); the shot of such a row merges a proved Bayer (stored 1) instead of the declared Quad (shotBlock), a proved Quad or nothing proved keeps the Quad as before. MosaicStream says once when 12 frames gave no verdict (all devices, log only). Gated by Build (Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO; up-front rule only where XiaomiTeleZoom.phone(), the 17 Ultra) and scam_dev xiaomi_row_raw_only.
- Next log must show: «camera 2: the module's sensor mode mode 11 8192x6144 (RAW only) (SensorModeTable, P276)», «camera 2: no ISP stream in the session (the Xiaomi HAL runs the full-size row 11 only without the ISP stream ...; the setting says On / fake off), ISP stream off (RAW viewfinder) (P266)», no PREVIEW_STALL; «Xiaomi sensor row camera 2 mode 11 8192x6144 (RAW only): the result reports mode M, frame 8192x6144 stride 16384, floor F DN (declared black 64, no pedestal ...), 2x2 cell pairs |d| a inside / b across, e % equal of n -> a Quad mosaic / a plain Bayer / the binned frame written twice over» once a session; «MosaicStream: RAW stream colour block 1|2 for 2|8192x6144||0|pick-11» (or «not settled ... after 12 frames»); at the shot «hybrid stream colour block: 1|2 (stored for ...)».
- Open (phone): whether the 50 MP frames are the sensor's Quad or the HAL's remosaic (the frame line and the verdict say it); the RAW viewfinder's look at 50 MP (module «Разрешение видоискателя RAW» was 640: a 512x384 frame); whether row 0 (the other 8192x6144) differs from row 11; the photo's detail against a 12 MP shot.

### P628 - the watermark: redrawn, every field on its own, no «Shot on» (owner, 2026-11-11: «Добавь нормальную кастомизацию для вотермарки, так же поменяй стиль чтобы он соответствовал нашему нынешнему, перерисуй. Так же убери по дефолту надпись "Shot on"»; «Я должен иметь возможность для вотермарки например выводить только дату и время и так далее»; «Не забудь учитывать что фото могут делать в ориентации»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Before: RotateWatermark (the GL rotate pass) blended a 200 px-high signature bitmap - the camera glyph + «SHOT ON» / «SCAMERA» in sans-serif-light capitals, white with a shadow - into the bottom-left corner of the rotated frame (height = pref_watermark_size % of the frame height). It ran before the post-pipeline crops and resizes in ScamProcessor (hybrid CPU resize, Sabre crop, digital zoom crop + upscale, ISZ 4:3 crop): a zoomed shot lost or cut the signature, an upscale scaled it soft.
- Now (processing/watermark): WatermarkSpec (the settings), WatermarkText (three groups from the fields that are on: title = custom text · phone; exposure = 24mm  f/1.8  1/120s  ISO 100; time in one of five formats - an unknown value drops out with its separator; the first group present is the main line, so a lone date is the main line), WatermarkPainter (layout + Canvas drawing on the short side: title = size % x 0.4 of it, so portrait and landscape match; vector text / glyph / plates at the photo's own resolution), WatermarkFonts (SCAM = the bundled Roboto Flex; system condensed, serif, mono), PhotoWatermark (ScamProcessor, after MergeStamp: on the finished upright bitmap, after every crop and resize, before the EXIF / DNG thumbnails and the encoders; the streamed JPEG route is skipped while the switch is on, as for the merge stamp; any failure keeps the photo without it). RotateWatermark keeps only the rotation (WATERMARK 0). Pixels are stored upright in every format (no Orientation tag), the DNG preview is the photo turned back under the DNG's Orientation, the front camera's mirror is applied before: the watermark is upright in the chosen corner for 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 and never mirrored.
- Layouts: «Подпись» (glyph + up to 2 lines on the photo, soft shadow), «Плашка» (the same in a glass pill: #1C1C1E at 70 % / #F4F3F7 at 84 %, the shade's hairline), «Полоса» (a full-width glass band on the bottom / top edge: title over time on one side, exposure on the other; centre: one centred column), «Рамка» (a border over the photo's edges with a rounded window and a wider band for the text: the photo keeps its size, so the gain map, thumbnails and EXIF stay matched; border = «Отступ»). The glyph is the launcher icon's silhouette with its LED in the camera's yellow (#FFD447; #E0A100 on light). «Авто» colour: mean sRGB luma under the watermark (16 x 8 samples; the frame: the whole photo) > 0.58 -> black text / light plate / white frame. Long text: cut to 64 characters, then shortened with «…» to its width (the band's exposure keeps up to 45 %); a watermark taller than a third of the photo is scaled down.

### P627e - «Статика» on Quad / Tetra: clean edges (owner, 2026-11-11, out_static5 tetra_tc / car / t3: «На всех кропах у статики New есть полосы и зубцы на краях объектов, которых нет на Быстром и Качестве; на P627B их меньше»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Cause: P627d turned the along-edge pass off (the b-px stairs of the colour-block solve came back) and kept the floors off steep edges; and the priors scale with the frames taken (Dg = K / 2s^2), so a burst with few static frames (car 5 of 16, tc 8, t3 the base alone) kept the smoothing of a K-frame solve over the noise of K frames - its high-pass beside every edge (the "stripes": not ringing, the profile across the edge stays flat out to 10 px) at 10 - 15x Quality's flat noise. Not the field or the robust weights (t3 is one frame).
- Fixes: the along-edge pass back (staticAlongEdge 1; Tetra two passes, staticTetraAlongEdgePasses 2: one pass's taps +-2 / +-4 px left half of the 4 px stairs); the floors also on steep edges (staticEdgeK 64: the gather's flat weight held at g^2 / (g^2 + edgeK sigma^2) or above, frame-table global 15, CPU twin too); the priors as of at least 16 (Quad, staticPriorFrames) / 32 (Tetra, staticTetraPriorFrames) frames (StJob::priorFrames; a Quad burst of 16 frames unchanged). Tried, not taken: the along-edge pass only on strong coherent edges (a structure-tensor mask: stairs / stripes worse than ungated), a clamp of the ringing beside strong edges (nothing on car / t3, texture -3 %), luma floor 3 - 12 alone (t3's stairs stayed above Fast's), the priors of 16 / 32 frames without the along-edge pass (stairs x1.5 - 2), two passes on Quad (texture bm -3 %, its edges already under the Sabre routes').
- Edge metrics on the six 1024 x 768 crops (scratchpad p627e/edges.py: stairs = the luma's second difference along strong straight edges at the step b / local contrast; stripes = the luma high-pass 2 - 6 px off those edges, across them; Quality / Fast / P627b / P627d / new): stairs bm 0.148 / 0.149 / 0.096 / 0.177 / 0.112, 142001 0.144 / 0.154 / 0.100 / 0.147 / 0.105, d101423a 0.081 / 0.056 / 0.039 / 0.123 / 0.038, car 0.128 / 0.120 / 0.115 / 0.239 / 0.085, tc 0.152 / 0.136 / 0.155 / 0.227 / 0.123, t3 0.124 / 0.135 / 0.186 / 0.373 / 0.094; stripes bm 0.087 / 0.087 / 0.072 / 0.090 / 0.080, 142001 0.129 / 0.123 / 0.102 / 0.114 / 0.107, d101423a 0.084 / 0.082 / 0.074 / 0.090 / 0.073, car 0.060 / 0.072 / 0.080 / 0.138 / 0.052, tc 0.056 / 0.051 / 0.060 / 0.083 / 0.051, t3 0.074 / 0.143 / 0.161 / 0.257 / 0.082. Dark single px / MP 0 on all six (P627d 3 / 6 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 22). Every crop at or under max(Fast, Quality) on both.
- Texture detail (Quality / P627d / new): bm 0.211 / 0.207 / 0.197, 142001 0.426 / 0.401 / 0.390, d101423a 0.112 / 0.116 / 0.101, car 0.047 / 0.051 / 0.046, tc 0.0204 / 0.0217 / 0.0191, t3 0.059 / 0.076 / 0.057 (part of P627d's figure was the stripes and grain themselves); flat noise P627d -> new car 0.0101 -> 0.0037, tc 0.0041 -> 0.0023, t3 0.0275 -> 0.0129 (Quality 0.0007 / 0.0002 / 0.0018: Quality merges the moving frames, the static merge leaves them out); colour checker car 0.0019 -> 0.0011, tc 0.0005 -> 0.0003, t3 0.0027 -> 0.0013. Synthetic (check_static_merge, all passed): Quad hand-held 31.41 dB (P627d 33.50; without the post passes 32.90), Tetra 27.95 (30.08): the along-edge pass smooths the synthetic texture too. Crops: scratchpad out_static6/<burst>.png (Качество | Быстрый | Статика P627b | Статика P627d | Статика new).

### P627f - «Статика»: more detail than «Качество» (owner, 2026-11-11: «Деталь должна быть лучше у статики. Можешь использовать всё, движение мы не будем на него снимать»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- What limits the detail (ten 1024 x 768 crops: Quad bm / 142001 / d101423a, Tetra car / tc / t3, Bayer Ark church 140550 a / b and school 142144 a / b at --max-normals 20; scratchpad p627f/det.py: texDet = band-pass G0.7 - G2 of the luma on Quality's 10 % most textured 16 px blocks, lap = LoG(1) RMS there, both / Quality's): P627e's static merge sat at 0.90 - 0.97 of Quality's texDet on Quad / Tetra and 0.82 - 1.03 on Bayer. Tried, little or nothing: all frames (staticMotionMax 1: +0 - 5 % where the scene is still; the moving bus t3 and the school's parallax frames 9 - 15 ghost and draw a checker, 93 % of their samples rejected - the frame check stays), robust test 6 sigma / off (+2 %), 16 iterations (+3 %), weaker luma / chroma priors (+3 - 9 %, the checker and dark pixels back on bm), no post passes (+5 %, P627e's stairs back), the edge-gated or ring-gated boost (the textured places are the edges' surroundings: no gain).

### P630 - «Oldstyle»: a third camera mode with the 2.7 / 3.1 tone of the owner's specification, permanent manual controls and live picture adjustments (owner, 2026-11-11, the spec «tonemapping-port-spec» and two reference screenshots of a «Pro» mode): DONE in code, host (unit, Robolectric, moderngl); not seen on a phone
- Rule (owner): our own code from the specification's text, formulas and tables only - never its zip, its .tone profiles (ARM guest images with generated kernels: the original apps' code), the emulator, APKs or binaries.
- Mode (settings/OldstyleMode): «Спорт» | «Фото» | «Oldstyle» in the bottom switch (BottomChrome.bindModes, mode_oldstyle, icons cv_os_cassette(_fill): a 135 film cassette - knob, stub, end caps, slit - with a perforated strip of film); pref_oldstyle_mode global, never with pref_motion_mode (select). The photo mode's capture, merge (every route: Fast / Quality / Static, Bayer / Quad / Tetra / DCG) and sensor mode unchanged; ES / L bracket kept (their headroom feeds the short exposure). Entering / leaving swaps the «Про» row's stored values (pref_manual_<model> <-> pref_oldstyle_manual_* / pref_photo_manual_*): values per mode, read back by the panel when the camera reopens; the session restarts as for «Спорт».
- Viewfinder (ui/camera/OldstyleControls): the «Про» panel (circularbarlib ExpandingManualPanel: EV, ISO, S, WB, AF, «Всё» - its Camera2 paths) held open, «Про» faded out and disabled; a round 44dp button above the row's right end opens a card (PRO_CARD, 22dp corners): the value, a centred tick ruler -50..50 (a tick per step, long every 10, edges fading, haptic tick, double tap -> 0), tiles «Яркость», «Насыщенность», «Контраст», «Резкость», «Тон» (V1 / V2 flip); enter spring + rising tiles, exit curve; long press: help; hidden with the shade up; the LUT tray closes the card, not the row.
- Adjustments (processing/oldstyle/OldstyleAdjust, utils/import_oldstyle_adjust.glsl): sharpness c + k (c - blur) (k 1.5 s / s), blur the 3x3 binomial at long side / 1600 px; brightness c^(2^-0.8b); contrast c + 0.9k c(1-c)(2c-1); saturation around Rec.709 Y. Viewfinder: main_fs splices the same file (MainRenderer.oldstyleSplice, uOsOn / uOsAdjust, also the developed-RAW 2D pass); photo: OldstyleAdjustNode (oldstyle/adjust.glsl) with the press's values (ShotLook.Oldstyle); no pass / no maths at all zero.
- Tone (postpipeline/OldstyleTone in place of the Why tone; a film simulation keeps the Why tone; P630b: replaced by the owner's tone-port module, see below): why/v2_clean (our WB / LSC / CCM), strided samples -> OldstyleAe.plan (our design: long TET = target / log-average, short TET keeps the 99.7 % light at 0.95; the merge's exposure, its digital gain included, is TET 1: nothing applied twice; ceiling 8 with merged short frames). V1: 1.45 skip / 6.804 max ratio, two RGB8 exposures through the 1024 curve (index floor(v g 1023 + .5)), 2.7 weights. V2: IsSceneHdr 1.33, ShouldRunHdr ratio <= maxHdrRatio x forgiveness, else the capture plan's adjustment (f = share with long weight > 64), gainShort / gainLong exactly as written (0.97561^(L/S) before the multiply, maxDigitalGain x 1.001 clamp), signed 12-bit samples, 3.1 weights, 10 levels (8 «postview»), the 4096 curve at the end. V2 above 100 MP takes V1.
- Pyramid (OldstyleFusion = CPU twin, shaders/oldstyle down / top / collapse + utils/import_oldstyle_level0): the spec's 4x4 down with its rounding order, 9-3-3-1 up (+8 >> 4), signed band blend (128 - w, w, +64, >> 7), uint8 saturation. Our choices where the spec is open: t at 2i-1..2i+2 with edge repeat, ceil halving, top (B w + D (128-w) + 64) >> 7, depth 1 + floor(log2(min side / 4)) (6 at 128 px), pad to 32 by repeat (global phase kept). Level 0 computed where read (never stored); levels RGBA8UI (V1) / RGBA16I (V2). V2's RAW route ours: exposures saturate at 4095 (negatives kept), mask W31[long max >> 4] (LUT-independent, as the spec's identity-LUT equivalence needs), fusion in a log encoding (4095 log2(1 + x/64) / log2(1 + 4095/64), tables uEnc / uDec) - the linear-domain fusion gave halos of thousands of codes at a 4x ratio.
- Spec values: SHA-256 of the 1024 curve 5bbd14e3, inverse 454a21c8, RAW LUT 8c0a5088, WEIGHT 2.7 d741e78d, WEIGHT 3.1 e6afacce, the LUT sample table, the weight table rows - all exact. Step test y=64: 9 of 18 codes exact per version, the rest within 3 (x=127 +3 / +2, x=0 G 1; 7 search families of level design tried, none closer). Fixture hashes (ramp / edge, raw-ramp RAW8 / RAW10 at 1/4, 1/1, 0.75/2): none match (the RAW kernel's algorithm is not in the spec; even 1/1 is not LUT[x]).
- Settings: «Oldstyle Тон» (oldstyle_tone_screen) right under «Настройки тона»: pref_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_version, _target (0.16), V1 _v1_skip_ratio (1.45), _v1_max_ratio (6.804), V2 _v2_max_ratio (8), _v2_forgiveness (1.1), _v2_max_gain (16), _v2_levels (10 / 8); the other version's rows greyed (SettingsAvailability.oldstyleVersionReason).
- Tests: OldstyleLutsTest, OldstyleFusionTest, OldstyleAeTest, OldstyleAdjustTest, OldstyleModeTest, OldstyleScreensTest (ui_oldstyle_mode / _manual_row / _adjust), OldstyleSettingsShotsTest; tools/check_oldstyle_tone.py in the shader lane (GPU == CPU bit for bit: steps on both axes, impulses, a saturated channel, black, grey scale, random, sizes off 32, V1 from linear, V2 8 / 10 levels; adjustments GLSL == Java; glslc ES 3.10, 51 define sets); SettingsMenuTest's root order; tools/check_shader_fp16.py splices the adjustments into main_fs as MainRenderer does (main_fs stays checked).
- Renders (host, Ark burst b1, our worker's merge, tone only): Why V1 (tone/app_tone.py) | Oldstyle V1 | Oldstyle V2 (shipped shaders through moderngl, plan by the shipped Java) | Ark JPEG; a sunny scene: the plan found no HDR (ratio 1, gains 1.14), Oldstyle a little darker than Why V1 / Ark (luma 106-107 vs 121 / 122).
- Open (phone): the look against the owner's memory of 2.7 / 3.1; the plan's exposures on real scenes; manual values per mode across restarts; the card's ruler under the finger; Mali / Adreno compile of the integer shaders; memory and time at 50 / 200 MP.

### P630b - «Oldstyle»'s tone from the owner's tone-port module (owner, 2026-11-11: «Используй как основу для Oldstyle», tone-port-27-31.zip): DONE in code, host (module regression, JNI on the host, unit, Robolectric); not built into an APK, not seen on a phone
- The archive: a self-contained C++17 module, the owner's own code (no emulator, no profile images, no binaries) - so used directly, unlike the earlier zip. Vendored unchanged as app/src/main/cpp/third_party/tone_port (third_party/README.md: «tone-port by the SCAMERA owner», the project's licence; not in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES: not third-party). Its CMake (static tone_port, C++17, -ffp-contract=off) under add_subdirectory; library scameraTone = oldstyle-tone-jni.cpp + tone_port (-O3 -fexceptions -ffp-contract=off); CI checks libscameraTone.so in the APK. Built with the NDK 27 arm64 toolchain locally (the two targets alone).
- Host: its regression, both profiles, --full-frame: 2.7 26/26, 3.1 64/64 byte for byte. Through the module the specification's numbers all match (curve / inverse / RAW LUT SHA-256, the step test rows of 2.7 and 3.1, the ramp / edge fixture hashes, the six raw-ramp RAW8 / RAW10 hashes) - which our own pyramid of P630 did not (9 of 18 step codes, no fixture hash): its 4x4 reduction pairs the edges otherwise (avg(avg(top, right), avg(bottom, left))), levels keep a 2-sample border (clamped, mirrored from depth 3), no saturation between levels, depth while w > 6 << depth (at most 9); 3.1 is not a linear-RGB pyramid but a gamma-encoded max(R, G, B) tone code (raw_mask weights, 2766..3674) giving a per-pixel factor >= 1 on the signed channels, then the LUT, the adaptive shadow curve and its colour output.
- Integration (postpipeline/OldstyleTone): our merge (every route) -> why/v2_clean + strided samples -> OldstyleAe.plan (ours: target / log-average, light at 0.95, V1 1.45 / 6.804, V2 1.33 / maxHdrRatio x forgiveness / the capture plan's adjustment with f = the samples whose long tone code is under the mask ramp's middle) -> oldstyle/linear (the same colour chain without the clamp at 0; V1 before our CCM, V2 after; RGBA16I) read back in 256-row strips (GL_RGBA_INTEGER / GL_INT) and deinterleaved natively into one planar int16 frame (12-bit scale, 4095 = white) -> one module call on the whole frame -> RGB8 -> the main texture (oldstyle/rgb8) -> our adjustments -> tail.
  - V1: finish_raw27_rgb with our CCM (intermediateToSRGB x sensorToIntermediate, row-major; the module quantises it to Q16) and yuv_curve at the long TET; HDR (ratio >= 1.45): the frame at the short TET is the RGB8 of the 2.7 YUV route and tone_rgb8_hdr_luts(v27) builds the two virtual exposures from it (retone(invert(curve), curve, Q8 of long / short) and of 1), padded to 32 (edge repeated, phase at 0, 0) and cut back. Highlights above 4095 kept to the CCM (int16).
  - V2: render_raw31_hdr with raw_hdr_gains_31(shortCurrentTet = the frame's scale, the plan's two TETs, maxDigitalGain) - the frame scaled so its brightest sample is white (the operator only lifts), postview 8 / full 10 levels, saturation_adjustment the new row pref_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_saturation (0); without HDR render_raw31_sdr at the long gain. V2 above 100 MP takes V1.
  - GPU: our GLES pyramid (oldstyle/down / top / collapse, import_oldstyle_level0) and its CPU twin (OldstyleFusion, OldstyleLuts, OldstyleTables) removed: not bit-exact with the module (see above), so the module runs on the CPU (one thread: its loops; tiling is not seamless - the pyramid and the 3.1 shadow histogram read the whole frame - so one call per frame).
  - Timing (host x86, one thread, 12.5 MP): finish_raw27 0.16 s, the 2.7 8-bit HDR 1.45 s, render_raw31_hdr 0.91 s, render_raw31_sdr 0.54 s; b1 / 142001 renders (4096 x 3072) V1 0.3 / 2.5 s, V2 0.75 / 1.1 s. Phone (arm64 big core, estimate only): about the same per MP - 12 MP V1 HDR ~1.5-2.5 s, V2 ~1-1.5 s; 50 MP x4; 200 MP (V1) ~25-40 s. Memory at 50 MP ~1.2 GB native for V2.
- Settings: «Oldstyle Тон» keeps our plan's rows (target, V1 skip / max ratio, V2 max ratio / forgiveness) and the module's (V2 maxDigitalGain, postview levels) and gains the module's V2 saturation_adjustment (-0.5..0.5, 0).
- Tests: tools/check_tone_port.py (shader lane: the module's regression both profiles --full-frame, the specification's numbers through it, the host-built JNI driven by the shipped Java == direct module calls for V1 SDR / HDR and V2 SDR / HDR / postview, the GL_INT strip deinterleave, raw_hdr_gains_31 == OldstyleAe, the vendored copy == the archive with --archive); OldstyleNativeTest (JNI signatures, the vendored files, CMake, the CCM order); OldstyleAeTest (the frame's scale and sample, longKeeps; the plan); tools/check_oldstyle_tone.py now the adjustments, oldstyle/linear's sample == OldstyleAe.sample, glslc of the mode's shaders. OldstyleFusionTest / OldstyleLutsTest gone with their code (the module's regression and the spec numbers through the module cover what they checked).
- Renders: out_oldstyle/b1_compare.jpg (Why V1 | Oldstyle V1 | V2 | Ark; the previous own-implementation render kept as b1_compare_prev.jpg) and 142001_compare.jpg (HDR: ratio 1.77).

- Maths (utils/import_oldstyle_adjust.glsl oldstyleStyle, one function in both places; OS_TAP: the photo texelFetch at whole-pixel offsets, the viewfinder the frame at whole screen pixels shifted by what its gain / filter / LUT did): sharpness (3x3 binomial at long side / 1600), aura (two 8-tap rings at 1.5 % / 3 % of the long side, screened), halo (a ring at 0.6 %, the brighter part on bright edges), exposure (+-1.5 EV, linearised), tone (power + S-curve), colour (grey cool <-> saturated warm salmon tint), warmth of the light (R / B on the highlights), hue (rotation round grey, 35 degrees), highlights / shadows (luma-weighted lift / cut), warm / cool boost (saturation by R - B), vignette (round in the picture, any orientation), grain (a cell of long side / 1200, mid-tones). At most 33 taps a pixel (all on); each block skipped at 0.
- Viewfinder vs photo: the same function and the same taps where the screen's pixels are the picture's (tools/check_oldstyle_tone.py: the photo pass and main_fs's 2D variant render the same picture per parameter and all at once, max difference < 2e-6); on a phone the screen is not the picture: the taps are at screen pixels through linear filtering (the radii, the blur step, the vignette and the grain cell are shares of the long side in both, so the look matches, the samples do not), the grain's pattern is per screen pixel cell, and the camera's external texture is read at its driver's precision (main_fs now asks highp for its 2D sampler).
- Tests: OldstyleStyleTest (ranges, order, packing, HUD, the function's two hosts), OldstyleModeTest.styleAndTheShotSnapshot (persistence, snapshot, reset), OldstyleScreensTest (ui_panel_palette / _palette_drag / _advanced_exposure / _halo / _vignette / _reset_dialog, the reset flow, back, leaving the mode), check_oldstyle_tone.py (viewfinder == photo per parameter, each parameter's direction: exposure, tone, colour, warmth, hue keeps greys, highlights, shadows, warm / cool boost on their patches only, sharpness, vignette, aura, halo, grain keeps the mean).

### P630e - «Oldstyle» by the owner's supplement «HDR AE, цвет и postview для профилей 2.7 и 3.1» (owner, 2026-11-12: «Я тебе скинул то, чего тебе не хватало, доделай»; + «То, что относится к yuv, перенеси или переделай под RAW путь»; capture like the originals; «Sabre при этом у нас должен работать»; the style with the tone): DONE in code, host (supplement / module / JNI checks, unit, Robolectric, moderngl, renders); not built into an APK, not seen on a phone
- Supplement vendored as the document's C++ block unchanged (third_party/tone_supplement/tone_supplement.cpp + hdr-ae-color-27-31.md; compiled in oldstyle-tone-jni.cpp, -ffp-contract=off). tone_port gets one hook (third_party/tone_port.p630e.diff, reversible; check_tone_port.py reverses it and, with --archive, compares to the archive): a tone_rgb8_hdr_luts overload calling a function on pair.bright between make_exposures and tone_pair; the original overload calls it with none (regression 26/26 + 64/64 and every specification number unchanged).

- Exposure (processing/oldstyle/OldstyleAe): plan27 / plan31 (RAW payload: max 8 x 1.4) / cap_capture_ratio / compensate_tet / fusion_gains ported; the supplement leaves the AE estimator external, ours: S* = the light (99.7 % of max RGB) at 0.95 of white (before a shot one stop lower when the viewfinder's light is clipped); L* / S* a log-space fit of the two tables (features: light, geometric and arithmetic mean luma; 14 of 15 scenes take the tables' HDR decision per profile, the miss is the checkerboard 12); F = the share of samples the long candidate does not clip, centre-weighted (Gaussian 0.47 of the frame; scenes 09 / 10 / 13 / 14 within 0.005 of the tables). HDR: gains fusion_gains(S0 = the frames' actual TET, S, L, 1, M); SDR: one gain L* / S0. The 0.16 target and the ratio rows are gone (the supplement fixes them). EV compensation where the supplement puts it (2.7 in the candidates, 3.1 compensate_tet).
- Capture (owner via coordinator): Oldstyle exposes the whole burst at one exposure after the shutter (HybridPlan.oldstyle, CaptureController.meterOldstyle): the newest plain ring RAW metered (64 x 48 quads, black / white of the stream, its WB) -> the profile's rule -> frames at S (HDR) or L* (SDR), time first up to the handheld cap / HAL motion cap at whole flicker periods, then ISO; no Bento, no Shasta; a manual ISO / shutter keeps N; frames = the photo mode's ring count; sensor mode untouched. The plan (S*, L*, F, HDR, S, L, factorisation) is logged and carried in ShotLook.Oldstyle.capture; OldstyleTone re-runs the rule on its candidates over the merged frames' actual TET (exposureTime x ISO), so the gains never double the capture's. Shadow noise vs «Фото»: «Фото» merged K ring frames at N plus up to 3 Shasta frames at ~2 N (82 % of pixels weighted from them on the OPPO, P313); Oldstyle merges K frames at S (an HDR scene: S ~ 0.4-1 N) and lifts the shadows digitally by L / S: for K = 8, S = 0.5 N about 4 N of exposure in the shadows against ~14 N - roughly 1.9x the noise (0.9 EV) there; an SDR scene at L* (>= N usually) is as clean as «Фото» without its long frames. The shot is no longer zero-lag (taken after the press, as the manual-shutter PSL).
- The YUV routes' stages on our RAW route (JNI): dehaze / tint after the tone (RGB8 -> rgb8_to_yuv444 Q7 -> dehaze_yuv444 on the frame grown to multiples of 8, tiles from the origin -> yuv444_to_rgb8 Q6) with its gain grid from our lens-shading map (the colour chain's mean LSC over its centre, U = V; off: the unit grid); defaults max_dark 24 (48 lifted 140250's black point to 18: deep shadows crushed), percentile 0.2 %, corner 0.2. Output saturation (output_saturation_params at the long gain, make_saturation, saturate_rgb8 with the vector-domain rule) as rows, neutral by default: finish_raw27_rgb and pack_raw31_rgb8 already carry their own saturation pass (the document: «Для RAW-выходов использовать их встроенный цветовой проход»), so nothing is applied twice. The low-frequency colour (V1 HDR, on): the reference is our merge itself, 8 x 8 box means at the long gain through finish_raw27_rgb (the long exposure's CCM and curve), the current the bright exposure's 8 x 8 means, both 3 x 3 low-passed, chroma only, threshold 16; through the hook. V2: not done - its two exposures come from the same 16-bit linear frame inside render_raw31_hdr (no 8-bit retone to repair), a reference from that frame is that frame. V1 inputs clamped at 2 x white before finish_raw27_rgb (its Q16 CCM wraps past int16: a black hole in 140250's sun before; host check).
- Sabre 1x / 1.5x / 2x: unchanged in the mode (OldstyleModeTest: output mode and photo size equal with the mode on / off), the tone takes the merged grid as it is. Native memory per pixel (host peak RSS, input planes + output 9 B/px included): V1 SDR 18, V1 HDR 34, V2 SDR 30, V2 HDR 24; V2 runs while its buffers fit 60 % of the available memory (else V1, logged; unknown memory: the 100 MP rule). Host x86 one thread, module / stages: 12 MP V1 HDR 1.8 s / 0.3, V2 HDR 1.0 / 0.3; 27 MP (12 MP 1.5x) 4.4 / 0.8, 2.9 / 0.8; 48 MP (12 MP 2x) 11.3 / 1.6, 5.3 / 1.5 (V1 HDR 1.6 GB); 50 MP 9.9 / 1.6, 5.2 / 1.5 (1.7 GB); 113 MP (50 MP 1.5x) ~22 s / 3.8 GB V1 HDR, ~12 s / 2.7 GB V2 HDR; 201 MP (50 MP 2x) ~40 s / 6.8 GB V1, ~21 s / 4.8 GB V2 (extrapolated: B/px constant 12-50 MP). Padding to 32 (2.7 HDR) and 8 (dehaze) right / bottom only, phase at (0, 0) at any size.
- Style and tone: «Экспозиция» acts before the tone (both TETs x 2^(1.5 x value), OldstyleStyle.exposureEv), the rest after it (uniformsAfterTone; the node only when something but the exposure is set) - highlights / shadows stay after: the fusion evens them out and would undo most of a change before it. The viewfinder does the same order.
- Viewfinder: render_raw31_hdr postview takes ~70 ms (1024 x 768) / ~150 ms (1440 x 1080) a frame on one host core - far over 33 ms, so a GLSL approximation (utils/import_oldstyle_tone_live.glsl, spliced into main_fs before the style): the ISP frame linearised (2.2), the version's tone of a neutral (OldstyleNative.previewLut: the module itself on a ramp, made per version on the GL thread) at the shot's gains (metered on the ring's newest RAW every 300 ms: OldstyleAe.viewfinderGains), HDR blended by the version's long weight (V1 weights27 of the bright RGB8, V2 the module's RAW mask) of the low-passed light. V1 / V2 switched in the panel shows at the next metering. ### P633 - the watermark in the gallery editor: add, change, remove (owner, 2026-11-11: «По поводу вотермарок, дай возможность их редактировать у нас в галерее, добавлять, убирать на наших фото, если они включены и так далее»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Record (processing/watermark): when the camera draws the watermark (PhotoWatermark.applyRecorded, ScamProcessor) it first keeps the original pixels under it - WatermarkArea: the plan's own boxes (each text line, the glyph, the badge's pill, the bar's band + hairline, the frame's four border strips with the window's rounded corners) grown by the draw's spread (text shadow 1.8 x radius + 1.5 px + .03 u, .12 u glyph overhang, 2 px AA), put on a 16 px grid from the photo's corner (the JPEG 4:2:0 MCU, the HEVC CU) and dilated by one block (codec spill: chroma upsampling of the next MCU, HEVC deblock / SAO, AV1 loop filters), merged into rectangles; WatermarkPatch: those pixels in the photo's own format and colour space (ARGB_8888 sRGB / P3; RGBA_1010102 of the 10-bit HEIC plus its 8-bit version made by Bitmap.copy as the camera's 8-bit files), cut into pieces of <= 4 Mpx, each lossless WebP when its decode gives every word back (checked on the spot) else the pure-Java predictive code (G, R-G, B-G, LOCO-I median predictor, zig-zag, deflate; 8 / 10 bit), CRC-32 per piece, the spec (WatermarkSpec.toJson) in the header. Coded on a worker beside the photo's own encoding (<= 64 MB of pieces held; more - a 200 MP frame - coded piece by piece on the spot).
- Storage (WatermarkStore), chosen over APPn / HEIF items / XMP / a sidecar: appended at the file's very end after the encoder wrote it, in the form each container ignores, so no offset written before moves - JPEG / Ultra HDR: after the last EOI (the gain map's MPF offsets count from the primary image, unchanged; decoders stop at EOI, ExifInterface copies what follows its scan); WebP: a «SCWM» RIFF chunk, the RIFF size grown; HEIC / AVIF: a top-level «uuid» box (item offsets point into mdat). Every form ends with the same 12 bytes (length + «SCWMEND1»), read from the end. APPn would need 64 KB chunks and shift the Ultra HDR MPF image offsets; an HEIF item needs rewriting iinf / iloc; a sidecar keyed by URI + hash breaks on every move / copy / backup and needs its own cleanup. PhotoOutput.save appends it to every file of the shot in that file's precision (tenBitFile: the 10-bit HEIC / AVIF the 10-bit record, the JPEG / WebP / 8-bit HEIC the 8-bit one) inside SavingFiles. The Ultra HDR gain map is not kept: it is computed from the HDR rendition before the watermark (no watermark in it) and the editor's copy is SDR (P351). DNG: nothing (its RAW has no watermark; the editor develops the RAW).
- Overhead (WatermarkRecordTest.sizeOverheadFor12And50Mp; area kept / record): real 12 MP phone JPEG (decoded; its own file 4.4 MB): Caption default 1.2 % / 150 KB (3.4 % of the file), all fields 4.1 % / 401 KB (9 %); Badge 1.4 % / 171 KB (4 %), all 5.2 % / 455 KB (10 %); Bar 6.6 % / 667 KB (15 %), all 8.6 % / 840 KB (19 %); Frame 21.8 % / 2.2 MB (51 %), all 23.9 % / 2.4 MB (55 %); 6.2-8.2 bit / px kept. Synthetic texture with grain (pessimistic, ~9 bit / px): 12 MP Caption 151 KB, Badge 177 KB, Bar 1.15 MB, Frame 3.1 MB; 50 MP Caption 524 KB, Badge 648 KB, Bar 4.4 MB, Frame 11.8 MB. Host coding time 50 MP: Caption 0.15 s, Frame 1.2-1.4 s (beside the encoding on the phone). Lossless is the cost of exact removal: the Frame / Bar cover 8-24 % of the photo.
- Editor (gallery/editor): tab «Знак» / «Mark» (8th, ui_ic_tag; EditWatermarkPanel): «Как есть» / «Убрать» / «Изменить» (a photo with a record: «Изменить» = removal + a new watermark starting from the stored spec) or «Добавить» (no record: from the camera's settings); «Убрать» without a record is greyed, a tap says why (toast) and the panel's first line explains it (older photo, another app, re-encoded). Controls = the camera's settings with their names, ranges and help texts (long press: SettingHelp sheets): style, position chips, colour, font, size, opacity, margin, the fields as switch rows with this photo's value under each («24mm») or greyed «нет в EXIF», own text typed in place, date format chips in this photo's own date, «Как в настройках камеры». Facts from the photo's EXIF (WatermarkExif: Make / Model as PhotoInfo, focal 35 mm first, FNumber, ExposureTime, PhotographicSensitivity / ISOSpeed, DateTimeOriginal + OffsetTimeOriginal, else DateTime).
- State: EditState.wmRemove + wm (spec JSON) in JSON "wm" {"rm", "s"}; undo / redo; «before» shows the photo as it is; paste carries the watermark, not the removal; a damaged spec falls back to defaults per field.
- Removal path: EditSource.readWatermark reads the record at open (size = the photo's stored size, orientation 1, every piece's CRC), makes previewClean; EditorView uploads the clean or plain preview by state (switching drops the zoom regions decoded the other way: Region.clean); the readers (JPEG region decoder, ImageDecoder / Glide bitmap) paint the record into every region they give with restoreWatermark on (pixel for pixel at full size; scaled with halving for previews / reduced exports); the export's proxy, tiles and the zoom take the same pixels.
- Drawing: the preview is WatermarkOverlayView over the GL picture: the plan laid out for the copy's size (EditExporter.outputSize of the crop), drawn scaled into the displayed crop rect (EditorView.Callbacks.picture, fit or zoom), «Авто» from a 160 px thumbnail of the edited crop (EditorView thumbnails now queue several sinks). The copy: EditExporter.drawWatermark - PhotoWatermark.draw with the camera's code on the finished copy (upright, chosen corner, short side), then writeCopy appends the copy's own record after copyExif, so the copy can be un-watermarked again; a copy without a watermark carries none.
- Tests (host): WatermarkRecordTest 12 (every pixel the drawing changes lies in the kept rects: 1944 draws - 4 layouts x 4 field sets x 6 positions x sizes 3 / 7 / 20 x margins, landscape / portrait / 16:9; restore = the unwatermarked render word for word for 4 layouts x 3 positions x landscape / portrait x ARGB_8888 sRGB (WebP and the predictive code) / P3 / RGBA_1010102 + its 8-bit files; JPEG file: inside the record = the render, outside = that render's own JPEG, every byte before the record kept; lossless WebP = the render everywhere, RIFF chunks walk to the end; ISO BMFF: the uuid box last, boxes walk to the end; coded-later = coded-now; changed spec = the new watermark on the original; damaged / foreign / lying records refused; spec JSON; size stats), WatermarkExifTest 3, PhotoOutputWatermarkTest 2, EditWatermarkTest 11 (our JPEG opens with its record: preview and full-resolution regions = render inside the record exactly, the photo outside; no record / record of another size not offered; state JSON / undo / paste / before; panel flows with and without a record incl. the greyed «Убрать» toast; greyed EXIF fields; the copy = the camera's drawing, EXIF kept, its record removable again, no record without a watermark; preview plan = copy plan; screenshots); existing gallery.editor / watermark / settings / ui.settings / processor / PhotoOutput / Jpeg suites green (617 tests); check_ui_language, check_settings_model, make_ui_icons --check.
- Phone-only: HEIC / AVIF / Ultra HDR files with the appended record opening in the system gallery, Google Photos and our viewer (decoders ignoring the tail; ExifInterface / MediaStore on HEIC), the camera's real jpegli / HEVC / AV1 spill staying inside the one-block margin (host proves it for libjpeg-turbo JPEG and lossless WebP only), lossless WebP on Android 8-10 (WEBP q100; else the predictive code), record coding time beside the encode at 50 / 200 MP, the preview overlay over zoomed / cropped pictures, the 10-bit HEIC decode + record paste in the editor.

### P631b - black viewfinder on every lens outside «Oldstyle»: the tone LUT's sampler shared the external frame's texture unit (owner, 2026-11-12, Xiaomi 17 Ultra, build 31257 e8889734: «Чёрный экран у 17U»; log 7d04382b-SCAMERA-current-log_2): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- Log: not the full-size row and not P631's code (no «the module's sensor mode» / «Xiaomi sensor row» line; module rows on Auto) - plain 12 MP sessions of cameras 2, 3, 4, mode «Движение», ISP + RAW streams, sessions configured, frames delivered (MosaicStream verdicts, WB TEACHER, VF_RAW «stages» with ring / upload times). From the first frame on every latch of the ISP texture says «[SurfaceTexture-1-…] bindTextureImage: clearing GL error: 0x502» (302 times in 14 s; 0 in the 31256 log) - GL_INVALID_OPERATION left by the draw before it; 0.3 s after each session start «E LiveRawRenderer: upload GL error=1282; using ISP preview» (5 times: every camera switch), then «viewfinder: the photo's WHY tone not drawn (no frame)» on every draw (590) and no «RAW developed» line at all (2 in the 31256 log). No shader compile / link error, no PREVIEW_STALL, no session failure; the `Device error received, code 4 / 5` bursts are the buffers of the closing camera at each lens switch.
- Cause (regression of P630e in e8889734): main_fs got `uniform highp sampler2D uOtLut` (utils/import_oldstyle_tone_live.glsl, spliced by MainRenderer) and MainRenderer.oldstyleTone gave it its unit 13 only while the Oldstyle tone is live - `if (t == null) return;` came first. Outside that mode the sampler kept the default unit 0, where sTexture (samplerExternalOES, the camera's frame) is. GL ES: samplers of different types on one unit fail the draw with GL_INVALID_OPERATION (LiveLensFilter.apply's comment says the same of its pyramid samplers). So the ISP viewfinder's pass drew nothing; and its error, still pending, was what LiveRawRenderer.check("upload") read after the next RAW frame's upload - the RAW viewfinder turned itself off for the session («using ISP preview»), back onto the pass that cannot draw. tools/check_oldstyle_tone.py did not see it: it puts every sampler on a unit of its own by hand, also with the tone off.
- Reach: every phone whose GL driver applies that rule (the spec's; Adreno here), every lens and mode except «Oldstyle» with its tone live, with the RAW viewfinder or the ISP one (by the code; the log is one phone's). In the 2D copy of the program (the developed RAW with a lens filter) both samplers are 2D: no error there.
- Done: MainRenderer.oldstyleTone sets uOtLut's unit before the tone-off return, on every draw; MainRenderer.pinSamplers puts every sampler of both main programs on its unit right after they are linked / loaded (samplerUnit: sTexture 0, uLut 1, uLfHiTex 2, uLfLinTex 3, uOtLut 13; a sampler the table does not know gets a spare unit from 14 up and a warning, never the frame's unit). LiveRawRenderer drops GL errors another pass left before its own calls (draw and bindFrame; said in the log, 3 times at most) instead of failing its initialize / upload / draw check on them.
- Next log must show: no «bindTextureImage: clearing GL error: 0x502», no «LiveRawRenderer: upload GL error»; «MainRenderer: viewfinder requestedRAW=… displaying=developed RAW», «LiveRawRenderer: RAW developed session=…», VF_RAW «fresh N/s toned N/s» above 0; with the RAW viewfinder off, the ISP picture. A «GL error=… left by another pass before the RAW frame's draw» line would name a pass that still fails.
- Tests (host): MainRendererSamplerUnitsTest 6 (new, in the workflow list: the spliced source's samplers, a unit of its own for each and only the frame on 0, the units set with the tone off, a removed sampler skipped, a sampler spliced in later on a spare unit, the renderer's call sites), the viewfinder package's tests, OldstyleStyleTest, XiaomiSensorRowTest, XiaomiRowViewfinderTest pass; check_shader_fp16, check_glsl_loop_shadow, check_ui_language pass (no shader changed).
- Open (phone): the picture itself on the 17 Ultra and the other phones; P631's 50 MP row on build 31257+ was not reached in this log (the module row was on Auto).

### P635 - «Полное разрешение (рецепт)»: a per-lens full-resolution recipe engine, the Xiaomi 17 Ultra's proven 50 MP, trial presets for nubia and the OnePlus 16 (owner, 2026-11-12: «Изучи, этим ты возможно сможешь починить видоискатель на 17U, Нубии и 1+16. Реализуй как переключатель в настройках линзы.»; his two documents «Full-Res RAW 50 MP - Full Recipe (Xiaomi 17 Ultra / nezha)» and «09 - Hasil probe ulang Xiaomi 17 Ultra», 2026-10-26 .. 2026-11-10): DONE in code, host; not run on a phone
