So P631's «RAW only» row 11 most likely delivered doubled frames (its frame line of the 2026-11-11 plan would say «the binned frame written twice over»): the recipe stands in for it when on.
- Engine (no phone constant in it - FullResRecipeTest checks the sources): FullResRecipe (the profile: capture RAW size, reader usage, stream use case, companion off / YUV WxH / auto / viewfinder, vendor tags {key, i32 / i32[] / u8 / u8[] / i64 / f32, values, session / request / both / still}, still and session templates, fps, pixel mode never / annotate, viewfinder isp / raw / both, frames a shot 1-8, session operation mode; a text form a field, overlay of the owner's edits, blockers), FullResRecipePlan (pure: the outputs with use case / usage / pixel modes, the targets and tags of the repeating request and of a still, consistency of pixel modes, the log line of the whole field set), FullResRecipeTags (the tags on a builder by type), FullResRecipeSession (the running plan for VendorTagUtils.builderSessionApply), FullResRecipeStore (the lens's switch and edits, the failure memory: fields + firmware), FullResTruth + FullResRecipeShot (the truth check), FullResRecipePresets (the only place with numbers).
- Session (CaptureController, the P626 per-shot layout made general: perShot()): mImageReaderRaw = the capture RAW (the stills' alone: sizes, the shot arena, the photo-size pill follow it), mImageReaderRawView = the camera's own largest RAW stream for the RAW viewfinder (its frames go to the viewfinder only, never into the ZSL ring), mRecipeCompanion = the YUV reader (frames dropped). The ISP stream / RAW viewfinder by the profile's «viewfinder», whatever «Поток ISP» says; no CROPPED_RAW use case; the profile's operation mode, session template, fps and session tags; request tags on every request; a still = the profile's template left as it is (no preview settings copied over it, its capture intent kept) -> capture RAW + companion (or the ISP viewfinder as the companion), the still tags, SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE only when annotated; no ring: N after the shutter, the plan cut to the profile's frames (HybridPlan.limitedTo). The recipe is decided before every other full-size route (the nubia probe, the Pixel's, a module's picked row and with it P631's forced RAW-only: only when the recipe is off / failed); FULLRES of the size switch (the vivo / OPPO native route) is not touched; photo modes only.
- Truth check (every recipe shot's first frame, while it is copied: SaverImplementation.getFrame): median 2x2 std, the share of boxes of four equal sites at each of the four phases and whether such boxes differ from their neighbours, Laplacian variance of a centre crop against its nearest-2x baseline, the four phase means. «FULLRES RECIPE: frame WxH 2x2std=… equal=…% … lap=… baseline=… ratio=… parity=[[…]] -> real full-res | UPSCALED | cannot tell». UPSCALED: every still of the shot is taken back to the binned frame (one site a box) and the shot merges as a normal one; a notice; the profile is remembered as failed and the camera restarts to its normal session. A recipe shot's colour block is measured on its own frames every time (no stored block).
- Failures -> the normal session, the lens remembers (until a field / the firmware changes or «Сбросить к пресету»): onConfigureFailed, an exception of createCaptureSession, a camera error, a disconnect before the first frame or under a shot, PREVIEW_STALL, a shot without a still, an upscaled verdict, no viewfinder stream left. The log line names the reason and the whole field set; the switch's line on the lens page says why.
- Presets: Xiaomi 17 Ultra camera 2 - the documents' recipe exactly, viewfinder «raw» (their dual-stream run; «isp» is the untested SurfaceTexture layout), 4 frames (their 5 repeating frames ran; a burst of stills is not proven); nubia (a camera with a full-size row), experimental - P626's QCFA snapshot (0x8012, ZTE feature 0x20 on the session, app_mode 1 on every request, CustomRemosiac on the stills, annotated) plus an auto-sized YUV companion of the maximum-resolution map in the still; OnePlus 16 camera 2, experimental - row 25 at 8192x6144 with agingtest.mode.select 25 on the session and every request, a 640x480 companion, the ISP viewfinder kept (P604: every RAW-only session of the row died at +0.7 s). Camera 4 of the 17 Ultra: none.
- UI: the lens page (SensorConfigPreferenceGenerator -> FullResRecipeRows): the switch «Полное разрешение (рецепт)» with its state line (preset, why it cannot run, why it failed), while on the 12 fields (the preset's values until edited, each checked), «Сбросить к пресету»; long-press help on every row; keys pref_sensorconfig_<slot>_recipe… (module copy / reset, lens pins as any sensor row; SessionKeys: a new session). scam_dev fullres_recipe 0: off everywhere (DevKeys).
- Next log, Xiaomi 17 Ultra (switch on, 1x): «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 on: «Xiaomi 17 Ultra 50 MP» …», «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 «Xiaomi 17 Ultra 50 MP»: streams {raw_preview 4096x3072 …} {raw_capture 8192x6144 fmt 0x20 usage 0x100003 useCase 0x80103} {companion 640x480 fmt 0x23}; repeating -> [raw_preview]; stills x4 template still -> [raw_capture, companion], no sensor pixel mode; … session tags: …», «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 session parameters: …», the viewfinder's «RAW developed … size=4096x3072» lines, at a shot «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 shot: 4 stills …», «FULLRES RECIPE: frame 8192x6144 2x2std=… ratio=… -> real full-res», «hybrid stream colour block: block 1 …», the 6144x8192 output; or «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 failed (…)» with the field set. nubia / OnePlus 16: the same lines with their presets' names.
- Tests (host): FullResRecipeTest 9, FullResRecipePlanTest 5, FullResTruthTest 6, FullResRecipeStoreTest 5 (new, in the workflow list), ModuleRowsTest +1 (the lens page: off / on / edit / reset / help / state lines; renders p635-*.png), SettingsMenuTest's fixed row order of the lens page with the new row; the workflow's whole unit list 3055 tests pass; gates check_settings_model, check_ui_language, make_ui_icons --check.
- Open (phone): everything - the SurfaceTexture-free «raw» layout inside our session (the app's repeating request is a PREVIEW-template one with its own keys), stills with a manual exposure, 4 stills in a row and heat, the «isp» / «both» layouts, the companion as the viewfinder; nubia and OnePlus 16 presets are guesses to be read from their logs. The 17 Ultra's 75 mm: no recipe.



### P635b - Xiaomi 17 Ultra «50 MP» black with a pale strip: the 8192-wide rows give the binned frame in a quarter of the buffer; the truth check sees the buffer, the row runs as the recipe (owner, 2026-11-12, build 9843316b, log 3 and a screenshot: 1x, «JPEG 50 MP», the viewfinder black on the left three quarters with a pale pink strip on the right, the shot's thumbnail the same): DONE in code, host; not run on the phone
- What the frames hold (log 3): the module's rows 11, 0 (8192x6144) and 22 (8192x4608), RAW only. «Xiaomi sensor row … floor 0 DN (declared black 64, no pedestal …), 2x2 cell pairs … 1 % equal of 190008 -> a plain Bayer» (4000, 5297, 6627, 8073, …): 190008 pairs of the ~1 000 000 the centre has (144144 of ~754 000 for row 22) - 19 %; MosaicStream «block 1 (confident; tile votes b1/b2/b4 5391/0/0 of 23751)» (2156) of ~125 000 tiles - 19 %; the shot's «RAW black floor: 27648 of 36864 blocks hold samples below 16.0 DN» (8261) and log 1's «36864 of 49152» - exactly 75 % both. So a quarter of the buffer holds data and three quarters are zeros; the centre 80 % sees 19 % of it either as the first quarter of the rows or as a quarter of the columns. The viewfinder's strip is on the right of the portrait screen = the sensor frame's first rows (orientation 90); P608's nubia frame was the same («the 4096x3072 frame in the top of the 8192x6144 buffer», the binned frame at its own pitch: 4096x3072x2 B = the first 1536 rows of 16384 B, two binned rows side by side in each); and the documents' own ablation frames without the companion fit it too (mean 31.8 against 149 of the real frame = a quarter; parity [[30.5, 33.2], [30.5, 33.2]]: the same in every row, alternating by column - two Bayer rows side by side - which no «2x nearest upscale» gives; their «2x2 std 0, Laplacian 0» is the empty three quarters). The log cannot tell rows from columns for certain: the new line's valid box does.
- Why black + pink: the viewfinder bins and develops the whole 8192x6144 buffer as one Bayer frame - three quarters of zeros (under the black: black) and a strip in which two binned rows of different CFA phase sit side by side (no picture, the white balance gains on mixed sites: a pale pink / white band); the photo is merged from the same buffers (the 8192x4608 shot of 13:59:04: 21 frames, «no pedestal» route, saved).
- Why P631 passed it: its frame line counted only the pairs 32 DN above the floor and the colour-block detector only the lit tiles - both called the filled quarter «a plain Bayer: the HAL's remosaic», and «no pedestal» was the zeros' percentile, not the picture's. P635's own truth check would have passed it as well (the Laplacian's centre crop lies in the zeros: baseline 0, no verdict) - fixed here.
- Done. FullResTruth: a valid-area map (64 px cells; a cell is empty when its 16 samples are one value under half the declared black), the picture's box, its share, the floor of the picture's own samples; verdict PARTIAL when the box leaves 10 % of the buffer empty (packedQuarter: every column of the first quarter of the rows), pedestalLost (the picture's floor under half the declared black), notReal(pedestalMatters); the line names the box, the shares and the floor. A recipe shot: the check runs on the whole buffer before any crop; PARTIAL of the packed-quarter layout is unpacked to the binned frame (unpackQuarter) and merged as a normal photo, any other not-real buffer is refused (no black + strip photo), the profile fails, the camera restarts. A picked row (Xiaomi): its first viewfinder frame goes through the same check («FULLRES ROW: …»); not real: the module's row back to Auto, the normal session, a message that names «Полное разрешение (рецепт)» (or says the recipe failed on this lens); scam_dev fullres_row_truth 0: the line only. A recipe session of a profile not proven on this firmware sends one proof still after its first preview result (the still's template, targets and tags): judged, «FULLRES RECIPE proof: …»; not real / failed / no frame in 4 s: the profile fails and the normal session opens before a shot; real: remembered (module_recipe_ok_<slot>, fields + firmware; «Сбросить к пресету» forgets it); a real shot proves it too.
- The rows run as the recipe: a module whose picked row is as wide as its camera's proven preset (the 17 Ultra's camera 2: rows 0, 11 and the 16:9 row 22 - the recipe's 8192x6144 frame, the documents prove no other size; the 16:9 crop is the app's «16:9») runs the preset's recipe with the switch off too (FullResRecipeStore.autoRoute; never an experimental preset, never a narrower row); the session line and the switch's line on the lens page say so. A recipe that failed leaves the row to the row check above (Auto + the message).
- Next log must show (17 Ultra, 1x, row 11 picked or the switch on): «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 on: … (module back1, instead of the module's sensor mode row 11 …, not proven on this firmware yet: one proof still follows, P635)», the streams line, «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2: proof still sent …», «FULLRES RECIPE proof: frame 8192x6144 valid 8192x6144+0+0 (100% …) floor ~50 (declared black 64) 2x2std=… ratio=… -> real full-res» - or «… valid 8192x1536+0+0 (25% …) … -> PARTIAL (… the binned frame at its own pitch in the first quarter of the rows)» and «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 failed (…)» with the field set; at a shot «FULLRES RECIPE: frame …». With the recipe failed and the row still picked: «FULLRES ROW: frame … -> PARTIAL …», «sensor mode row 11 … gives no full frame …: the module is back on Auto».
- Tests (host): FullResTruthTest 11 (+5: the packed quarter and its unpacking, why the old statistics saw a plain Bayer, a strip of columns, the pedestal, the shot's policy), FullResRecipeStoreTest 8 (+3: the rows that run as the recipe, the proof's memory, the wiring of the row check / proof still / shot), ModuleRowsTest (the switch's line for a routed row); the workflow's whole unit list 3063 tests pass; gates check_settings_model, check_ui_language.
- Open (phone): whether the recipe's still in our session is the real frame at all (the proof line says it at the first camera open); rows vs columns of the partial buffer (the valid box); the proof still's cost at the first open of a lens.

- Fix: RaisedPedestal (processing) - a frame's floor = the third-lowest block mean over the four CFA sites, the session keeps the lowest; above the declared black by more than 1/8 of the declared range it is the black (a pedestal is never above a frame's darkest area; a white wall on a normal stream falls back to the declared black with the first shade). CaptureController.recipeViewFloor measures a recipe session's viewfinder frame before anything reads it (first frame at once, then 4 a second); liveLevels() = RawLevels.current + that black, taken by the developed viewfinder (liveRawMeta) and every reader of a viewfinder frame's samples (motion level, Unspektra / native / ETTR / plain meters, the WB teacher, the vivo audit). Its still-scene check called still scenes moving: tk took 1 frame of 16 (15 «moving» at 17 - 25 % of blocks), tc 8, nr 8, nb 9, Quad d101423a 7 - and one or a few frames solve into a noisy picture with dots along edges. Two causes in hybridStaticMoving on the colour-block thumbnails: the frame's level against the base was the ratio of the whole thumbnails' means, which changes with the content the shift brings in (2 - 5 % on a window: every flat block off by it), and a block of 1024 sites at ISO 50 has ~0.1 % noise, so the 4 sigma test fired on what no term models. Now (b > 1 only; Bayer bit for bit): the level is the median of the aligned blocks' ratios (also the solve's photometric factor), the block mean has a tolerance of staticBlockTol 0.005 of its level, the misregistration term takes one-sided differences (a 2 thumbnail px colonnade has no central one), and a frame is moving from staticBlockMotionMax 0.017 of the blocks (the fractions read lower now: still scenes 0.000 - 0.003; 0.017 gives the moving scenes the frames the old test gave them at 0.03).

### P637 - the viewer opened from the camera is black for seconds (owner, 2026-11-12: «галерея очень долго открывается, займись исправлением»; screen recording video_20261112_134230, vivo V2454A, the current build: the camera's thumbnail tapped ~2.5 s after an «Oldstyle V2 x4» shot, the viewer's bars on a black screen for 6.0 s - no photo, no title - then the photo; back in the camera the viewfinder black for ~4 s more; no log of that build): DONE in code, host; not seen on the phone
- What the recording shows and what the code says (no log, so the 6 s are not split yet - the new lines below split them): the thumbnail was the provisional viewfinder frame (the shot still processed), the viewer has no MediaStore observer and showed the NEW photo exactly when the shot was saved - so either the media list or the first page waited for the end of the shot. Causes in the code, each fixed: (1) the viewer drew nothing before `GalleryViewModel.loadAsync` published its lists (ImageViewerFragment.initImageAdapter is the first thing that puts a page into the pager): the open's first pixels waited for three MediaStore queries over the whole library plus the main thread's turn; right after a shot MediaStore's generation has changed, so the scan is never reused. (2) A shot still processed has no file and no row: the viewer could only show the photo before it, and the new one only after its save, the scanner and another read. (3) Every decode thread of the gallery ran at background priority - Glide's source threads nice 9, the viewer's tiles (SubsamplingScaleImageView's AsyncTask) nice 10, «GalleryPreview», «ExifRead» (the page's title) and «GalleryStrips» at NORM_PRIORITY - 1 = nice 10 - while a shot's CPU work (ParallelWork's 7 helpers, the encoders) runs at nice 0: CFS weights 110 : 1024, about a tenth of a core for the page's chain header -> preview -> tile init -> base tiles -> EXIF. (4) A JPEG page showed nothing before its base tiles unless the grid's thumbnail was already cached (ViewerPreview: cache only) - never the case for a photo taken a moment ago; a HEIC / AVIF / DNG page likewise (`.thumbnail(GalleryThumb.cached)`), and the grid's HEIC thumbnail was a decode of the whole HEVC picture (ThumbnailUtils: the camera's HEIC has an EXIF thumbnail, P620, but no HEIF thumbnail item). (5) The VIEW route (another app's photo with its neighbours) still read MediaStore on the main thread before the first frame (P617 left it synchronous). Checked and left: P633's watermark record is read only by the editor (EditSource), the text index starts 6 s after the library and waits for ProcessingKeepAlive.busy (P617), the editor's layout is inflated on navigation, Glide's module does one statfs.
- CameraHandoff (gallery/ui; same process, nothing read from MediaStore or a file): the camera hands the gallery it opens (a) the viewfinder at the shutter of every shot (PixelCopy 540 px wide, turned upright by the icons' turn; the camera's own 200 px provisional thumbnail is scaled from it, instant shots only as before), (b) at the tap (CameraFragment.launchGallery) its thumbnail (a copy), whether a shot is in work (ProcessingKeepAlive.busy), the tap's time and its last saved file - `saved(path)` from notifyImageSavedStatus, the scanner's row from MediaScannerConnection's callback (`scanned`), or MediaStore's newest photo the thumbnail was made from at the camera's resume (`latest`); (c) while the viewer is open, each save and each scanner answer (Listener, main thread).
- Viewer (ImageViewerFragment + ViewerCover, a view over the pager and under the bars that takes no touches): opened by the camera it shows in its first view, before any posted task - PENDING: the shutter frame under «Обработка снимка…» (title «Сегодня, 13:41 / Обработка…»), the older photos bound under it when the lists arrive; the bars' actions answer «Снимок ещё обрабатывается»; a swipe drops the cover (the older photos); every 0.5 s ProcessingKeepAlive.busy - two idle polls without a save show the last saved file or drop the cover (a failed shot). On `saved` (60 ms settle: the photo format follows a RAW of the same shot) the file is put first in the list (GalleryViewModel.showFront: a file:// item, id -1) and the viewer moves to it; the cover stays until that page reports ready, then fades (120 ms). PAGE (no shot in work): the camera's thumbnail over the pager and the camera's last photo bound as a one-item list at once (`showFront` in GalleryActivity.onCreate, before loadAsync); when the lists arrive the viewer is rebound on the same photo behind a copy of the page shown (`coverWithPage`: no black frame between the two binds; a page with a hardware bitmap is rebound plainly). `frontScanned`: the front item gets its MediaStore row in place (GalleryItem.setFile; the page is not bound again), the library reads MediaStore when next shown (updatePending); until then share / edit / compare / delete / favourite on it answer «Снимок ещё сохраняется» (a file:// URI must not leave the process). A later read that has the file (by path or row) drops the front item; only «ALL» and the list before the first read get one. A viewer showing another photo keeps it when a queued shot is saved (the new photo is put first, bound behind a copy of the page).
- First picture of a page: ViewerPreview takes the file's own EXIF (IFD1) thumbnail from the header it already read (512 px, the camera writes it since P620; host: 2-6 ms), then the cached grid thumbnail as before; HEIC / WebP / AVIF / DNG / RAW pages: `GalleryThumb.first` = the cached thumbnail, else for a RAW the grid's thumbnail decoded now (a DNG's preview or sparse render, tens of ms beside a render of a second), else `GalleryThumb.embedded` (ThumbDecoder.EMBEDDED_ONLY: a JPEG's / HEIC's / AVIF's EXIF thumbnail of any size with the picture's aspect, a DNG's JPEG preview - DngPreview.read(previewOnly) - never a decode of the picture; a file without one fails that request silently). The grid's HEIC / AVIF thumbnail is the EXIF thumbnail when it is large enough (ThumbDecoder.exifThumb, androidx ExifInterface on its own descriptor), else the platform's as before.
- Priority (DecodeBoost): Glide's source and disk-cache executors get a thread factory that registers their tids (as Glide makes them: nice 9); every gallery open puts them at the default priority (nice 0; -2 while a shot is in work) for 4 s, a save while the viewer waits again; FdRegionDecoder raises its AsyncTask thread to at least the default for every tile init / region (AsyncTask resets it per task); «GalleryPreview» and «ExifRead» are NORM_PRIORITY. The shot's threads are not touched.
- VIEW route (GalleryActivity.handleExternalViewIntent, a new gallery): the photo asked for is the viewer's one-item list at once, MediaStore read by loadAsync, then `amongNeighbours` (its item in «ALL», else put first) selected and bound behind the page's copy; a recreation after process death keeps the synchronous path (its saved position).
- Log (tag GalleryOpen; the watch thread only on the phone): «open: camera (tap -> gallery T ms)» (the camera's pause), «decode threads at priority P for 4000 ms (N threads[, a shot is processed])», «camera's last photo NAME bound +T ms (tap +T ms) (its file, no MediaStore row yet | its MediaStore row), before the media lists», «placeholder shown +T ms (tap +T ms): shutter frame 540x720, the shot is still processed | camera thumbnail 200x267, the last photo», «placeholder on screen +T ms», «first pixels +T ms: placeholder | photo», «media listed +T ms: N items, read R ms off the main thread (queued Q ms, read, posted P ms late)», «shot saved +T ms: NAME, shown from its file | put first (another photo is viewed)», «final photo ready +T ms, S ms after it was saved», «placeholder dropped +T ms: <why>», «viewer first photo ready +T ms (camera), tap +T ms», and for 12 s after each open a ping of the main thread every 100 ms: «main thread busy >350 ms from +T ms of the open, at: <14 frames of its stack>» / «main thread free again +T ms: it was busy N ms» (at most 4 an open).
- Expected on the phone (from the code and host times; none measured there): first pixels (the placeholder) in the gallery's first frame, i.e. the «placeholder on screen» line within ~100-250 ms of «open» whatever MediaStore and the shot do; an idle camera: «viewer first photo ready» ~100-300 ms after «open» without waiting for «media listed» (the reference OPPO log of the old path: listed +144 ms, ready +328 ms); a shot in work: «final photo ready» ~150-400 ms after «shot saved» (the EXIF preview in the first of them), not after the scanner and a read. If the main thread itself is blocked after the first frame (the recording's second black, the camera's viewfinder after Back, hints at the camera's side), the placeholder is still on screen and the «main thread busy» line names the frame that blocks.
- Host: CameraHandoffTest 7, ViewerCoverTest 5 (the placeholder is on its view synchronously: 0-10 ms), ImageViewerPlaceholderTest 3 (the real viewer fragment in activity_gallery: the shutter frame and the pill are in its first view before a posted task or a list; the saved file becomes page 0 and the scanner's row replaces its URI without a rebind; a shot that ends without a file gives the pages back; an idle camera's last photo is a page before the lists), ViewerEmbeddedPreviewTest 3 (the EXIF thumbnail as the preview from a JPEG whose picture cannot be decoded at all; EMBEDDED_ONLY never decodes the picture), DecodeBoostTest 3, GalleryViewModelTest +5 (front photo), GalleryOpenTraceTest +2, GalleryActivityRoutesTest +1, DngPreviewTest +1; gallery.* 57 classes 312/312, ui.camera.* 58 classes 289/289; check_ui_language PASS. The five new classes are in the workflow's list.
- Not done / open: the 6 s of the recording are not attributed (needs the next log: «tap -> gallery», «media listed … queued / posted», «main thread busy»); the camera's black viewfinder for ~4 s after Back from the gallery during a shot (the same recording) is the camera's reopen, not touched here; the pending shot is a cover, not a page of its own (a swipe drops it); MediaStore's rescan after each save (P617's last line) unchanged; an order-dependent host trap that is not new: GalleryViewModelTest's loader thread initialises PreferenceKeys.Key without ScameraApp (application = Application.class) and poisons it for ScameraApp tests run after it in the same JVM (gallery.* together with ui.camera.* in one command: 24 NoClassDefFoundError; each alone, and the workflow's order, pass).


## P640 - X200 Ultra: the stock camera's viewfinder black after ours until a reboot (owner, 2026-11-12)

Owner: «На X200 Ultra после какого-то времени использования нашей камеры в сток камере становится черный видоискатель, помогает
только ребут смарта». No log of the state; the cause below is from the code, not measured on the phone.

What the app leaves in the phone. One thing only: the vivo SDK lease (VivoSdkRawSession) - VivoCameraManager 40 (SDK RAW) = 1 and
33 (VCF) = 2, the camera service's own state, set before an ISZ / picked-row / native FULLRES camera opens (the owner's logs:
cameras 3, 4, 5 on the X200 Ultra) and given back when it closes. The stock AE observer (root + Frida) is dead code since P129
(useStockBracketPlanner false, its assets gone, CI checks the APK has none); the merge worker runs as the app.

How it stayed set (all by code):
1. Two sessions of one process: the FULLRES session's give-back pending («not restored», retried) and the ISZ lease taken
   meanwhile read OUR values as «found» and wrote them to the journal; the first gave the phone's values back, the second then
   gave ours back and cleared the journal. Nothing left to say what had been there: every later lease found 1 / 2 and gave 1 / 2
   back - only a reboot ended it. The same from any open that met a lease still set.
2. A refused open (CameraAccessException, IllegalArgumentException, RuntimeException - no device, no onClosed) gave only the
   FULLRES session back, not the ISZ lease; closeCamera with no device likewise.
3. The give-back hung on CameraDevice.onClosed alone.
4. A process that died with the camera open (a native crash, a kill) left the lease until OUR app opened a camera again
   (the P179 journal) - the stock camera opened first met it.

Done:
- One lease a process (Held, by provider): sessions share it, the last holder gives back; a failed give stays on the books.
- SDK RAW found set with no lease of this process is never «found»: the journal's values, else the last clean start's
  (Journal.baseline, kept over clear), else 0 (the reports' «restored SDK40=0»).
- sweep: a pending give, a dead process's journal, values set with no journal (no camera in use) go back - at the app's start,
  before every camera open, 1.2 s after a camera closed (with a lease the controller still holds with no camera).
- closeCamera gives the ISZ lease back on the lease thread once CameraDevice.close() returned; the four refused-open exits and
  the no-device close give it back too.
- LeaseGuardService (process :leaseguard, nothing of the app in it): holds a Binder of the camera process while the lease is
  held, gives the values back 250 ms after its death (5 tries); scam_dev vivo_lease_guard 0 = off. An uncaught exception gives
  back first (ScameraCrashReporter -> VivoSdkRawSession.onCrash).
- Log: «vivo SDK lease taken (...) (found SDK RAW a, VCF b)», «vivo SDK lease left set (<when>): <result>», SCAM_LEASE_GUARD.

Tests (host): VivoSdkRawSessionTest 15 (the double give-back, a pending give, never our own value, the sweep's cases, the guard's
watch and restore, the crash, the wiring by source). Not proven: that SDK RAW = 1 is what blacks the stock viewfinder (no log);
that vivo lets the :leaseguard process be bound and live 250 ms after the camera process (the journal and the sweeps are behind
it). A force-stop kills both processes: the next start of our app gives back.

Ask the owner: when the stock camera is black again - open ours, close it, try the stock one; the log lines «vivo SDK lease».


### P630f - «Oldstyle» on the released build (owner, 2026-11-12, OPPO PHY110, build 9843316b: «После первого снимка или включения лога чёрный экран. Также фокус не работает в Oldstyle»; log SCAMERA-current-log_4, a screen recording): DONE in code, host (unit, Robolectric); not seen on a phone
- Black viewfinder: the Oldstyle tone's LUT texture (MainRenderer, P630e) is made once per version and its name kept in the renderer - which outlives its GL context. After the gallery (the shot's thumbnail) or the settings (the log switch) GLSurfaceView makes a new context (log: «GLPreview: viewfinder GPU priority …» again at 10:26:56.897 after the gallery), the old texture is gone, the name and version still say «ready»: the LUT is never uploaded again, the sampler reads a texture with no image, every colour of the live tone is 0 - black while the mode is on, frames still drawn (VF_DRAW 30 fps). P631b's sampler units were not it. Fix: MainRenderer.ToneLut (texture + version of this context), forgotten first thing in onSurfaceCreated.
- Focus: not the mode - P252's ParkedLens. Log 10:26:41.996: «camera 2: the HAL's AF left the lens at 7.1428566 dpt beyond its 5.00 dpt near limit (exposure x ISO 32.1): hyperfocal 0.153 dpt until the scene gets brighter», the shot's frames «focusDistance=0.1527486»; the recording: the focus tile 22 cm -> 14 cm (sharp keyboard) -> 6,5 м and blurred from then on. 7.14 dpt is where this lens stands with a subject at 14 cm; the night fallback (a parked lens in a dark far scene) took it after 1.5 s in room light and held AF off at the hyperfocal distance - in any mode. Fix: the fallback takes the lens only in a dark scene (exposure x ISO >= 100: the night's frame had 230, the room's 32) and only while the AF does not report focus (CONTROL_AF_STATE PASSIVE_FOCUSED / FOCUSED_LOCKED). Tap focus and the manual focus were not blocked by the mode (the style panel's host takes no touches when closed; the tap asks for the manual focus at Auto, as «Фото»).
- Burst: log «hybrid plan: Oldstyle one exposure N=9.988ms*ISO4935 S*=1.421e+11 L*=2.680e+11 F=0.942 … -> 20 x 120.000ms*ISO1184 (TET x2.883 of N …)». The TET scale is right (ns x ISO: N = 4.93e10; the light at 0.329 of white -> S* = 0.95 / 0.329 = 2.88 N, L* / S* 1.886: HDR by 2.7's rule). Wrong: the factorisation took the shutter to the bracketed frames' 125 ms cap (down to 120 ms by the 100 Hz flicker) for every frame of a hand-held burst, and took the ring's 20 frames whatever their length: 2.4 s of capture, each frame smeared. Fix (HybridPlan.oldstyleCap / oldstyleFrames): the burst's shutter no longer than the viewfinder's own or 1/60 s when that is shorter (the HAL motion cap under it), the rest of the TET in gain; the frame count fits 0.7 s of capture (at least 4). That scene should have been 20 x 10 ms x ISO min(14 210, the sensor's top) - 0.67 s. Without a capture plan (a hand-set ISO / shutter) the burst keeps N's own shutter and ISO exactly (P630e re-split the same TET shutter-first: a hand-set 1/120 s became 1/60 s).
- Viewfinder too bright (the recording: the keys burnt out): the plan's gains are over the RAW frame (2.75 / 5.44 here) but the live tone multiplied the ISP frame, which its own gain and curve had already brightened ~3.5x. Now both gains over OldstyleAe.ispGain = 0.18 / the metered RAW mean (1..16): 0.78 / 1.54 there. An estimate (the ISP's curve is not known), the photo is not affected.
- «Фото» / «Спорт»: the LUT and the burst are the mode's only; ParkedLens is every mode's (macro in room light keeps its AF there too), its night case unchanged (ParkedLensTest's old cases as they were).
- Tests: MainRendererOldstyleToneTest.theLutIsUploadedAgainInANewGlContext; ParkedLensTest.aNearSubjectInRoomLightIsNotTheNightsParkedLens; HybridPlanTest.oldstyleBurstOfTheOwnersRoomStaysHandHeld (+ oldstyleTakesOneExposure / oldstyleShutterOnWholeFlickerPeriods to the new cap); OldstyleAeTest.viewfinderGainsOverTheIspFramesBrightness.
- Next log: no «the HAL's AF left the lens …» line in room light; «hybrid plan: Oldstyle one exposure … -> 20 x 10.000ms*ISO…» (shutter <= max(N, 16.7 ms), frames x max(shutter, 33 ms) <= 0.7 s); the viewfinder not black after the gallery / the settings in Oldstyle (VF_DRAW ~30 fps as before); «Oldstyle V1 (tone-port 2.7) plan(capture) …» with frameTET near the plan's S or below it (gains make up the rest).
- Open (phone): the AF state the HAL reports at night on this lens (the fallback now needs «not focused»); the ISP-gain estimate against the photo on the screen; ISO range honoured by the HAL for the burst (ExposureLimits).

### P630g - «Oldstyle»: the viewfinder's live tone on the screen frame's own level, steady; the manual row under the style panel (owner, 2026-11-12, a vivo's recording: «Вот так работает Oldstyle, исправь видоискатель»; a screenshot: «у нас иногда не скрываются ручные настройки»): DONE in code, host (unit, Robolectric, moderngl + the module); not seen on a phone
- The recording: the Oldstyle viewfinder burnt out (the wall white, hard edges), right in «Фото», the saved V2 photo right. The «flicker» is the shot: at the press (the shutter's dot, the controls dimmed) the viewfinder shows the series frames for ~2 s - AE off, the ISP without its usual gain - and those looked right under the same gains, then the ISP frames again, burnt. So: the plan's gains are the RAW frame's, the live tone multiplied the ISP frame its own gain had brightened (P630f's 0.18 / RAW mean was a guess of that gain).
- Fix (processing/oldstyle/OldstyleLive, the one state of the live tone): the photo fixes where it puts the scene's light - gain x RAW light, before the curve - whatever the viewfinder's exposure; the screen's gains are the plan's over k, the screen frame's gain over the RAW frame. k from the frame itself: LiveSceneMeter (the 64 x 64 tile it already draws, now every 2nd frame while the tone is on) gives the frame's linear mean; k is the gain for which the RAW's luma samples, clipped at the screen's white, give that mean (screenGain: the screen clips what its gain takes past white, the plain ratio of means would be too low). The screen's white stands for all the RAW light past it: drawn at the mean of what the photo makes of those samples (whiteBoost, uOt.w: the frame's top from 0.92 of white lifted before the gains; a RAW-clipped window stays white, an ISP-clipped wall the RAW keeps comes out at the wall's level). Calibrated on the module: every metering the tone-port module renders the 64 x 48 samples as the shot would (photoMean: the burst's exposure, the plan, default stages; < 1 ms) and the gains are scaled so that the shader's picture of the same samples (screenMean, the LUT in Java) has that mean - 3.1's frame-dependent shadow curve and the dehaze are in.
- Steady: the plan's targets (ln of gain x RAW mean - invariant to the viewfinder's AE) smoothed with 0.5 s; the HDR / SDR decision flips only after the other has held 0.9 s, and SDR is the fusion's formula with both gains equal (no jump of the look); the level follows with 0.15 s and at once when it jumps by 25 % (the series frames: the picture stays where it was); the solved k and the white boost smoothed as the plan; nothing is drawn with the tone before a plan AND a level (toneNow null: the frame as it is). OldstyleAe: the clipped step of S* comes in softly from 0.90 to 0.98 of the ceiling (a light hovering at the clip level moved S* by a stop between meterings) and L* / S* is fitted for the light S* keeps (L* followed S* down by the whole stop before).
- The developed-RAW frame through the filter pass (hProgram2d) is not measured: the plan over an assumed level (0.18). The RAW viewfinder's direct draw has no Oldstyle tone or style (as before).
- Simulation (tools/check_oldstyle_live.py, shader lane: shipped OldstyleAe / OldstyleLive through javac, the shipped viewfinder shader in moderngl, the module's LUT and photo through the host JNI; RAW frames with noise and 1 % AE hunting, ISP frames with a gain and a knee): 2.7 / 3.1 x (lit wall, window past the RAW's white, lamp-lit patch = HDR) x ISP gain 1 / 2 / 3.5 / 6: frame-to-frame change of the screen's mean 0.24-0.84 % (limit 1 %); the screen's mean vs the photo's -4.2 .. +4.1 % up to gain 3.5, up to +6.2 % at 6 (limits 5 / 8 %); burnt out on the screen never above the photo's. P630e's state at gain 3.5: +60 .. +78 % of the photo's mean, 46 % of the wall scene burnt.
- Manual row under the open style panel: three actors moved the row's alpha - OldstyleControls (alpha 0 while open), the shade's return (ExpandingManualPanel.setShadeShown fades to 1) and the parent's LayoutTransition (camera_container animates layout changes: its APPEARING animator fades a child that became VISIBLE 0 -> 1 some 300 ms later, on its own clock, not cancelled by ours). A panel opened in that window, or the shade going up and down under the open panel, left the row at 1 under the panel. Fix: one rule in ExpandingManualPanel - shown() = the shade down and nothing in its place (setCovered); both setters through applyShown; the row's visibility changes without the parent's APPEARING / DISAPPEARING transition; a row that is not shown is INVISIBLE and takes no touches from the first frame of its fade (dispatchTouchEvent); OldstyleControls re-asserts it on every change and refresh (coverManual) and gives a row back when rebuilt or when the mode is left.

- What the log says (5e90b8c0-SCAMERA-current-log_5.txt). The recipe session runs (lines 275, 388, 389: streams raw_preview 4096x3072 + raw_capture 8192x6144 usage 0x100003 useCase 0x80103 + companion 640x480, tags @both). The documents measured the same thing without naming it (09 reprobe, the dual-stream table): one session, one scene - still 94.0 / 138.4 / 138.4 / 113.9, binned preview 608.9 / 684.5 / 684.5 / 645.9 = ~558 + 1.7 x (still - 64). The binned stream beside the full-size mode sits on a pedestal near 560 DN while its results declare the full-size mode's 64 / 1023; the viewfinder subtracted 64 - half of the range on every channel, times the gains 2.3 / 1 / 1.5: magenta, washed, the AE at its floor. Not the pedestal memory (no «RAW black floor» line, the stream key is «off» for a recipe), not the CFA (colours of the photo and the block are right), not the gains (the result's transform, 596).
- Fix: RaisedPedestal (processing) - a frame's floor = the third-lowest block mean over the four CFA sites, the session keeps the lowest; above the declared black by more than 1/8 of the declared range it is the black (a pedestal is never above a frame's darkest area; a white wall on a normal stream falls back to the declared black with the first shade). CaptureController.recipeViewFloor measures a recipe session's viewfinder frame before anything reads it (first frame at once, then 4 a second); liveLevels() = RawLevels.current + that black, taken by the developed viewfinder (liveRawMeta) and every reader of a viewfinder frame's samples (motion level, Unspektra / native / ETTR / plain meters, the WB teacher, the vivo audit). The photo's levels are its own frames' (Parameters), untouched. scam_dev recipe_vf_floor 0: the declared black.
- Log line, once a session and when the black used moves by 2 % of the range: «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 viewfinder levels: frame 4096x3072 block means by CFA site floor a/b/c/d median … p99 … max N (… blocks); declared black 64.0 white 1023 -> black used 5xx (the frames' own floor: a pedestal above the declared black); WB gains r/g/b; t ms ISO n (P635c)».
- Autofocus. The log has the AF states of the taps only (1263-1360 and on): CONTINUOUS_PICTURE, PASSIVE_SCAN and PASSIVE_FOCUSED alternating between consecutive results (partial and total results disagree), after AF START «FOCUSED_LOCKED … after 4-6 frames» five times, «after 29 frames» once, «AF trigger UNACKNOWLEDGED» twice; no focus distance anywhere, so whether the lens moves cannot be read. The requests are already explicit (the ordinary preview builder: AF mode, regions and triggers of TouchFocus; TEMPLATE_PREVIEW + the two tags). Added: «FULLRES RECIPE camera 2 AF: mode …, states A>B>… (n changes in m frames), lens x..y dpt, moving k frames, AF triggers t, AF region …; viewfinder request tags on|off, the result's: sensor_meta_data.current_mode=[…] remosaic.enabled=[…] (P635c)» - every second for the first 10 s of a session, then on a change (RecipeAfTrace, FullResRecipeTags.read).

The preset keeps yes: the documents' dual stream ran with the tags on the session and on every request and nothing ran without, and on this HAL the sensor mode is the session's (configure), so a clean viewfinder request probably changes neither the pedestal nor the AF - the next log's two lines say. (d) AF in the normal session, the recipe session at the shutter: not built (a session switch a shot, ~1 s); to be decided by that log.
- Manual focus / tap in a recipe shot (by code): a recipe still is its template alone (no preview settings copied) with the preview's AF mode copied - with manual focus that was AF off without the distance (the template's own). recipeFocus puts the hand-set distance on the stills and on the proof still. A tap's AUTO mode and regions were already copied.

### Dual gain: inference (labelled as such in the code and the log)
- The ultra wide's DSG row is 3: the only 4:3 30 fps row the map leaves unnamed, and the static list declares one 12-bit dual-gain
  mode. The vendor's photo flow never uses it by name.
- A 12-bit dual-gain frame arrives as packed MIPI RAW12 behind RAW_SENSOR (the 14-bit one's analogy) or as plain 12-bit samples.
- Which key makes a third-party session of a physical camera run the row is unknown: hence the ladder.

### Done
- XiaomiDualGain: kinds DCG / LOFIC (main), DCG (75 mm), DSG (ultra wide); the vendor's rows checked against the camera's table; per
  kind a ladder - «hdr» {EnableHDRDCGMode 1}, «hdr+row» {+ current_mode row}, «type+row» {EnableHDRDCGMode = the list's type, row},
  «row», on the main «night+row» (session mode 0x9203, the 15 Ultra's route); LOFIC: the same with enableLofic 1. Keys on the
  session parameters and every request. Proof: a depth above 10 bits - the results' dynamic black (16 x -> 14, 4 x -> 12) or a
  checked frame (packed RAW14 / RAW12 with dark samples at the packing's scale, plain samples above the white) within 90 results
  (scam_dev xiaomi17_dxg_window); current_mode is logged as an echo when the variant sends it. Proven: remembered per
  Build.FINGERPRINT (prefs xiaomi_dual_gain), used first, never demoted by a session it does not prove in (logged «did not give the
  mode this time»). Not proven / refused / no frame / camera error: marked failed, the session is configured again with the next one
  (after a shot in flight). All failed: LOFIC -> DCG, DCG / DSG -> off, with a message; the lens row's choice clears the failures.
- Dcg14Mode: a third state LOFIC (the 17 Ultra only; a stored 2 reads as DCG elsewhere); the top bar's button cycles off - DCG -
  DCG+LOFIC on the main camera, reads «DSG» on the ultra wide; lens page row «DCG / DCG+LOFIC (двойное усиление сенсора)» / «DSG …»
  (pref_sensorconfig_<slot>_dualgain, not persistent: the same switch) with the state per kind and «not proven on a phone».
- RawPayloadCheck: in a dual-gain session (setKeepDepth) packed RAW14 keeps its 14 bits (elsewhere >> 4 as P72), packed RAW12 is a
  layout, and a known depth no longer hides a packed payload (check() returned «unchecked» above white 4095 - the 15 Ultra's plain
  14-bit route keeps that). Levels: RawLevels' known depth follows the evidence (black = the frame's dynamic one, white the depth's
  or the measured clip), taken back when the HAL leaves the mode.
- The merge: Dcg14Mode.frames is true for the proven session (12 bits count there: DSG), so dcgShot (NCH flag 32), no ES / L frames,
  the histogram's linearity proof and the two-zone noise fit run for all three kinds. dcgIsoScale: not applied (the report's DCG
  session reports ISO 50 with the plain noise profile - ScamProcessor.isoInflationSeen).
- The 75 mm with the switch on (or a picked row) opens camera 4 alone, not through the logical SAT camera (XiaomiTeleIsz.directReason).
- scam_dev: xiaomi17_dxg, xiaomi17_dxg_row, xiaomi17_dxg_variant, xiaomi17_dxg_window, xiaomi17_row12.

### Not done / open
- DCG + LOFIC's overflow read (the vendor's second stream, RAW10 of use case 524554) is not asked for: the LOFIC choice runs the

  not routed through the logical camera.
- customizeFunctionMask / trdCloudSwitch (the whitelist's flags as session keys): bit values unknown, not sent.
- Phone: test by day on a contrasty scene. Log lines to send: «XIAOMI DCG|DCG+LOFIC|DSG camera N: asks row … by variant …», «… variant
  X, row N asked: results report current_mode …, modetype …, DCGMode …, dynamic black … -> … bit», «… frame K: packed MIPI RAW14 …»,

Verdict: the stock firmware has no row of 4x density that streams except row 0 (7 fps, the whole array). The vendor's map and zoom
thresholds never name row 12 (ISZ = rows 9 / 20 only, from 8.6x); the stock camera never runs it, which is why the fault does not
show there. Levers considered: current_mode 12 (the row itself is broken - refused by XiaomiTeleIsz unless scam_dev xiaomi17_row12);
EnableInsensorZoom + zoom ratio (the HAL's multi-level ISZ would pick the same row 12, and its thresholds stop at row 9); stream use
cases 524547 / 524550 / 524560 (full size, 200 MP, the 26 MP crop of the binned readout - none is a 1x1 crop); operation modes (pick
stream sets, not rows); replacing the sensor module or its registers (/odm is read-only and verified, an app has no register access;
camxoverride / persist.vendor properties need root). A centre crop of row 0's frame is the same photosites at 7 fps; the owner

## P641d - Xiaomi 17 Ultra: DCG + LOFIC merged as a pair of frames of one exposure (2026-11-12)

Owner: «Как будет работать наша склейка при съемке DCG+LOFIC? Придумай вариант чтобы склеивать их вместе». Not run on a phone.

Evidence (report lines):
- LOFIC is two reads on two streams in the vendor's sessions: LoficFormat [324, 37] (346006), «Lofic zsl 4ev0, 4ev-» with ev 0 / -3
  pairs in sensor_mode 17 (320549), DCGPlusVS = long 14 + short 10 bit (288816-288824).
- The main camera's stream sets hold, beside the RAW14 and the RAW10 stream, a second RAW10 stream: «raw10 stream of wide dol2
  short», format 37, usage 3, stream_use_case 524554 (0x8010A), isZSL, isDol2 (132399; the SAT set and the eco set).
- RAW10 4096x3072 is a listed output of camera 2. Use case 524554 is not in availableStreamUseCases (191206: 0-6, 65536-65547) -
  nor is 524547, which the proven 50 MP recipe sets on its second RAW stream of the same camera (owner's logs 2026-11-12), so an
  unlisted vendor use case and two RAW streams are accepted by this HAL.

Inference: the overflow (LOFIC) read is what arrives on the 524554 stream when the sensor runs row 5; a third-party session gets
it; the two frames of one exposure carry one sensor timestamp. None of it is in the report: the rung is trusted only on its frames.

Design (done in code):
- Capture: the LOFIC ladder's first rung «lofic-pair» {enableLofic 1, EnableHDRDCGMode 1, current_mode 5} + a RAW10 reader of the
  main RAW's size with use case 0x8010A, in the repeating request and the stills. Its frames are copied into a ring of 8 by
  timestamp (LoficPair.Ring, 8 x 15 MB). A checked main frame (the payload watch's turns) and the overflow frame of its timestamp
  (within 0.5 ms) are measured: block means (48 x 36 blocks), a line overflow = a x (main - black) + b over the blocks unclipped in
  both. Its slope gives the ratio (as shares of the ranges; the vendor's 3 EV would be 8), its intercept the overflow stream's black,
  its residual the stability. PAIR: residual under a tenth, ratio at least 2, and the main frame's clipped blocks unclipped and
  brighter than the clip point in the overflow frame; COPY (ratio near 1), UNSTABLE, NO_HIGHLIGHTS, NO_DATA otherwise. The rung is
  proven by the depth (as every rung) and two pairs in a row of one ratio (10 %), within twice the window; else it fails for the
  firmware and the single-frame LOFIC rungs, DCG and the plain session follow as before. No reader / refused session / no frame /
  camera error: the rung failed.
- Merge (no worker change): at the shutter the two newest ring frames take the overflow frames of their timestamps along
  (ImageFrame.overflow). ScamProcessor.addOverflowFrames, after the DCG linearity proof (only when the codes are shown linear),
  measures each pair again at the shot's final levels and against the session's ratio, rescales the overflow frame to the main
  levels (black on black, white on white) and adds it to the burst as an EXTRA_SHORT frame of the main frame's metadata
  (ImageFrame.pairedMain), timestamp + 1 ns, exposure = main / ratio, noise {main slope / ratio, main offset + the 10-bit
  quantisation} (a model; the worker's noise check has the last word). ScamHybridBurst: such a frame is a short frame (the
  ultrashort role, Bento where the N frame clips), the base frame's own first, kept in «Движение»; the DCG rule still drops LONG
  brackets, and P320's rule drops everything of another exposure while linearity is not proven. orderMs of the overflow frame is
  its main frame's: zero offset.
- Text: the lens row says «кадр DCG + кадр переполнения LOFIC той же экспозиции, склеиваются вместе … не проверено на телефоне».

Tests: LoficPairTest (pairing, a true x8 pair accepted with ratio within 3 % and black within 2 DN, x6 and a raised black measured,
copy / unrelated / no-highlights / flat refused, packed samples, rescale, the numbers for the merge, the ring, the rung's proof),
ScamHybridBurstRolesTest.aDcgShotKeepsItsOverflowPairsAndDropsRealBrackets. No host replay: the worker's merge is a GPU program
replayed on a phone only (tools/replay_*.py drive adb); an end-to-end synthetic merge was not run.

Open / to send from the phone (daylight, a scene with blown highlights, DCG+LOFIC chosen in the lens settings):
«XIAOMI DCG+LOFIC camera 2: asks row 5 by variant 1 of 6 lofic-pair …», «… overflow stream 4096x3072 RAW10 …», «… overflow pair of
timestamp …: PAIR|COPY|UNSTABLE|… ratio …, overflow black …», «… PROVEN by variant lofic-pair …» or «… FAILED: the main stream
reached 14 bit, but the second stream gave no proven overflow pair», and from a shot «DCG+LOFIC shot: …», «DCG+LOFIC: frame K + its
overflow read: measured ratio …», «DCG+LOFIC: n of m overflow pair(s) go to the merge», «hybrid DCG+LOFIC: …», «HYBRID NOISE CHECK
DCG», plus one kept burst (Diagnostics «Сохранять RAW-серию»). Unknown until then: whether the session with the second stream is
accepted, what the stream delivers, its timestamps, the real ratio and black, whether the worker's Bento takes a short frame this
clean without its motion checks misfiring.

### P639 - «Статика»: 153 s for 12 MP, the viewfinder at 2 fps, a strip dropped (owner, 2026-11-12, vivo X200 Ultra, Adreno 830, build 9843316b: «"статика" нереально долго обрабатывается и видоискатель при этом работает словно в 2 фпс. Нужно тоже исправить»): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- The log (SCAMERA_Log_2026-11-12, Bayer 4096 x 3072, 16 of 16 frames, 1x, ISO 2706; no per-pass GPU ms in it - GLES had no timestamps): align 222 ms, check 101 ms, uploads 477 ms; attempt 1 (GLES, 512 MB: 19 strips of 162 rows, each strip's ~100 dispatches ONE submission): strips 0 / 1 took 1.84 / 1.94 s (the viewfinder's «slow draw 1836 / 1944 / 2003 ms», 3 - 8 fps), strip 2 «not written» at +6.5 s; attempt 2 (128 MB: 192 strips of 16 rows, each solving 48 rows of HR and ~56 of the frames' samples for its 16): 145.4 s = 757 ms a strip (the viewfinder 11 fps, draws of 410 - 460 ms: one strip's submission each); chroma median 300 ms, detail 431 ms; merge 153.5 s, post 1.2 s. Why Vulkan was not used cannot be read from this log: the first choice's line was overwritten by the retry's (now reported at a failure: «HYBRID STATIC GPU: failed on ...»).
- Cause of the dropped strip: a strip's passes went to the GPU as one command batch of ~2 s. The Adreno kernel driver gives a batch about 2 s before its hang detection drops it (P29's note at HybridGpu::dispatchRows: «a single dispatch that runs for seconds trips the kernel's GPU hang detection»); strips 0 / 1 ran 1.84 / 1.94 s, the third went over. The guard was right (the rows were not written); not memory (3.8 GB free), not the guard reading early (it reads after the fence). The same batch is what the viewfinder's draw waited behind (same context priority: first in, first out).
- Fix 1, pacing (StBackend::slice, stSliced): every pass is split by rows / frames (StParams::row0 - the 32nd scalar, 128 B - and frame0) into submissions of about staticSliceMs (6 ms, sized from the time the program's last ones took), each waited for by its fence with the next already queued on GLES (two in flight: the GPU does not idle while the worker's thread wakes; Vulkan one). No batch is near the driver's limit, and the viewfinder's draw waits behind 12 ms at most. The same invocations on the same inputs: bit-identical to one submission (check_static_merge). Report: «HYBRID STATIC PACE: N submissions aimed at 6.0 ms (mean, longest)», «HYBRID STATIC GPU ms (per pass, its slices waited for)» now on GLES too. scam_dev static_slice_ms (0 = as before).
- Fix 2, the work. Same result (PSNR vs the old code 101 dB): the field pass only on the strip's tile rows (was 64 x 48 x 15 work groups a step whatever the strip - the 16-row strips' fixed cost), the start image's nine samples a frame through the inverse homography's Jacobian (a homography and a field look-up per frame, not per sample: the init pass 7.2 -> 1.1 s on the host), the gather's inverse homography read once per frame, the counters on one sample in 16. The short schedule (staticPlan 1, scam_dev static_plan): 2 blocks of 6 data steps (Tetra 10), a field step after each (on every second colour period of a frame), the robust weights from the second block, 2 final steps on the final weights; a weights pass leaves the gather its (residual, weight) pairs, so the step after it has no residual pass. Was 8 x (weights + 3 steps) + 6 field steps: 32 residual / 24 gather / 6 + 8 robust-min / 6 field passes -> 14 / 14 / 2 / 2. Why it holds: on check_static_merge's burst the truth's PSNR follows the FIELD, not the number of data steps (24 steps with the field of two short rounds 35.84 dB; 2 x 6 + 1 steps 36.03; the P624 schedule 36.00) - a field step against an estimate that had six steps is worth three against one that had three. Tried, not taken: a coarse stage at the RAW grid (3x faster, the crops' metrics equal, but its field is biased by the aliasing: synthetic -1.1 .. -2.2 dB), Chebyshev / momentum steps (no gain at 2x: over-converged weak modes are noise, 35.3 - 35.7 dB), the P624 schedule cut at 5 / 6 of 8 iterations (-0.05 / -0.02 dB, 1.4 - 1.6x only), a solve at 1x (stairs schoola 0.124 against 0.071, dark px x7).
- Quality (check_static_merge, all passed, the short schedule against the P624 one on the same code): Bayer 35.92 vs 35.75 dB (route), 35.57 vs 35.58 (the job with frame 3 off by 0.5 px; field found -0.329 / 0.313 vs -0.327 / 0.322), Quad hand-held 31.46 vs 31.51, tripod 27.28 / 27.28, Tetra 28.34 vs 28.30, tripod 23.25 / 23.25. Crops 1024 x 768 (scratchpad p639, texDet / lap vs Quality, P624 schedule -> short): churcha 1.09 / 1.08 -> 1.09 / 1.08, churchb 0.91 / 0.38 -> 0.92 / 0.38, schoola 1.11 / 1.12 -> 1.12 / 1.13, schoolb 1.15 / 1.17 -> 1.15 / 1.18, quad 142001 1.03 / 0.97 -> 1.03 / 0.96, car 1.07 / 1.02 -> 1.07 / 1.02, tc 1.06 / 1.10 -> 1.07 / 1.10, t3 1.02 / 1.06 -> 1.03 / 1.07; flat noise the same on Bayer / Quad (churchb +5 %), Tetra +5 % (car 4.17 -> 4.39, tc 9.22 -> 9.73 of Quality's; +10 % with 8 steps, +2 % with 12); stripes beside edges the same (+-1 %); stairs the same but the school crops +6 - 8 % (schoola 0.071 -> 0.077, schoolb 0.091 -> 0.096; P627e had 0.111 / 0.123; more steps do not bring it back - the P624 schedule's frozen last iterations did); dark px / MP schoola 95 -> 100, schoolb 33 -> 41. PSNR of the short against the P624 result 49 - 74 dB. quad_bm / d101423a's bursts were gone from the scratchpad (another cleanup): not re-measured.
- Speed, host (llvmpipe, user + system CPU s of the worker, old code -> new): schoola (14 frames) 93.6 -> 39.4, churchb (10) 69.7 -> 29.0: x2.4; Quad x2.0; Tetra x1.4 (10 steps). Phone, expected (not measured): without the dropped strip the old code would have taken 19 x ~1.9 s = ~36 s; x2.4 less work = ~15 s for 12 MP x 16 on the Adreno 830, 15 - 20 s with the viewfinder taking its share of the GPU - against 153 s. NOT the 10 s aimed at: 14 gathers of 16 frames at 2x are ~60 % of what is left, and what the Adreno spends inside a pass (storage-buffer reads? ALU?) the host cannot tell. Next, with the per-pass ms of a phone log: the frame table as a uniform block, the gather's geometry per work group, Vulkan (why it was not chosen), 768 MB strips. 50 MP: ~4x the 12 MP time (~60 - 80 s), 200 MP 2x: not estimated.
- The alarm: 300 s per 12 MP on a GPU (was 840: «worker alarm 881 s»), 1200 s on the CPU transcription (re-armed when the solve steps down to the CPU mid-shot), at most 3540 s; the app waits for the CPU's + 60 s (ScamHybridBurst.workerTimeoutSeconds: 12.5 MP 1308 s, 50 / 200 MP 3600 s); a stall is WorkerWatchdog's (90 s without a heartbeat).
- Viewfinder: «gap=draw ... in node» is the viewfinder's own draw call blocked in the driver behind the worker's batch (not the upload, not the camera: «cam» and «arrive» stayed at 33 ms). With 6 ms submissions, two in flight, the draw waits <= 12 ms: 20+ fps expected; the worker's context stays at medium priority (P364), gpu_low_priority 1 is the further step if a log shows gaps.
- Checks: tools/check_static_merge.cpp (+ short submissions bit for bit on both schedules, the short schedule within 0.05 dB of the P624 one on Bayer / Quad / Tetra hand-held and tripod, its field, strips, CPU twin; stSliced on a counting backend: every row of every frame once, the first submission one group row, sized to the time aimed at, one or two in flight; the alarm), ScamHybridBurstAnyResolutionTest (the waits), DevKeysCoverageTest / LabScopeTest (static_plan, static_slice_ms). SPIR-V regenerated.
- With P638 (the audit's fix of the same log, merged here): kept - its retry rule (the first GLES failure halves the strip's rows, 162 -> 80, only a second one goes to the smallest memory; the CPU branch back on the full rows), the guard's line with the stamps left and the strip's GPU ms, its check «one failed GLES strip» (SCAM_STATIC_GLES_FAIL_AT). Its glFlush after every GLES pass became StBackend::flush(), called for a pass that is NOT sliced (staticSliceMs 0): a sliced pass's submissions are slice()'s - shorter (6 ms against a whole pass of 20 - 100 ms) and waited for, which the bare flush was not (it kept the batch under the driver's limit but queued a strip's passes at once: the viewfinder still behind them). check_static_merge on the merge: 73 ok, all passed.
- Next log, send: «HYBRID STATIC PACE», «HYBRID STATIC GPU ms», «HYBRID STATIC GPU:» (all of them), «HYBRID STATIC MERGE», «HYBRID STATIC: worker alarm», «SHOT SUMMARY», the «VF_DRAW» lines during the merge.

## P642 - the watermark and the ES / L stamp inside the streamed JPEG (P638 finding 6; owner, 2026-11-12: faster processing in every mode): DONE in code, host; not seen on a phone
- Finding: P628 turned the watermark on by default and ScamProcessor.jpegStreamRoute refused the stream for `MergeStamp.on() || PhotoWatermark.on()` (the stream has no bitmap to draw on), so every shot of up to 16 MP lost P483: a full ARGB bitmap (48 MB at 12 MP, 64 MB at 16 MP), its copy out of the readback, the EXIF block and the encode after it - save 7 - 20 ms became 183 - 217 ms at 12 MP in the owner's logs of 11-12 (PHY110 217: block 99, encode 107; V2454A 183), and the final output's copy 58 - 105 ms on top.
- Done: PostPipeline.JpegPlan gets draws() / draw(pixels, w, h, stride) - called in the stream's sink before wrap(), on the part crop() kept (the ISZ 4:3 cut), so the EXIF thumbnail and the DNG's preview show the marks as the bitmap route's do. ScamProcessor draws there in the bitmap route's order: MergeStamp.drawInto, then PhotoWatermark.applyRecordedInto (its «Авто» ink and its record see the stamp), keeps the record for PhotoOutput.saveStreamedJpeg, which appends it as save() does (WatermarkStore, «SCWMEND1», the 8-bit record, after the file and its EXIF).
- How the marks are drawn (processing/watermark/RgbaRows): the bitmap route's own functions - MergeStamp.draw and PhotoWatermark.draw with its plan, ink, WatermarkPatch record and WatermarkPainter - on a «window»: a bitmap of the photo's size that holds the photo's words only in the rectangle the mark reads and changes (WatermarkArea's rectangles + the points «Авто» samples; the stamp's plate grown by its text size), loaded and stored by sprite copies (SRC, the words as they are). The same calls at the same coordinates on a bitmap of the same size, so what Skia writes there is what it writes into the whole photo. The window's other pages are never touched (a bitmap's storage is calloc'ed zero pages: resident memory = the rectangle, ~0.6 MB for the default mark at 12 MP; 48 MB of address space for a moment).
- Tried first and refused: a small bitmap of the rectangle with the canvas moved by its corner - a rounded corner's edge came out different on 2 pixels by 3 - 5 levels (the plate of the stamp at 1200x900, pixels 981,110 and 981,111): Skia cuts the corner's curve in single precision, at other magnitudes after the move. Invisible, but not the bitmap route's bytes, so not shipped.
- The readback: GLCoreBlockProcessing maps the pixel-pack buffer GL_MAP_READ_BIT | GL_MAP_WRITE_BIT only when the plan draws; a driver that refuses gets the read-only mapping and the sink gives the photo to the bitmap (as before P642). A stream that fails after the drawing takes the drawing back (RgbaRows.Undo: the rectangle's bytes of before, the watermark first, then the stamp), because the bitmap is then made from the same mapping and the bitmap route draws on it itself; a buffer lost while mapped re-reads the tiles from the GPU as before.
- Not streamed (the bitmap route as before, the rows untouched): a watermark whose rectangle is over 1/4 of the photo (the frame layout, the largest bars: PhotoWatermark.NotStreamed), and everything jpegStreamRoute already kept on the bitmap - HEIC / AVIF / WebP, Ultra HDR and HDR output, Display P3, 10-bit, the fast JPEG, a lab shot, a digital zoom crop, the Sabre resize, a debug overlay - and every photo above 16 MP: the stream exists only on the pixel-pack path (GLCoreBlockProcessing.PBO_MAX_PIXELS; the 38 / 50 / 200 MP shots of the logs were «path=tiles» before P628 as well). Their bitmap (200 MB at 50 MP, 800 MB at 200 MP) and their 220 - 338 ms of save are NOT touched by this entry: that needs the encoder fed tile by tile, a job of its own. ExifBeside (P636) stays for all of them.
- scam_dev jpeg_stream_marks 0: a shot with a mark goes through the bitmap, as before (DevKeys, NOT_IN_LAB).
- The same file, host (Robolectric with the native Skia): StreamMarksTest - 480 cases (6 photo sizes: landscape, portrait = the upright photo of a rotated shot, 16:9, odd sides 1023x769 / 771x1031 / 640x481; x 4 layouts x 4 field sets x 5 corners, the colour / size / margin / opacity / font varied over them; rows with and without a stride pad and a crop's lead; the stamp on half of them; the record coded at once and beside): 342 streamed with every byte of the rows equal to the bitmap route's bitmap, the record's bytes (WatermarkPatch.toBytes) equal and verified, the ink equal, no byte outside the photo's pixels written, and the drawing taken back = the readback; 138 left to the bitmap route (all 120 frame-layout cases and 18 of the largest marks) with the rows untouched. The stamp alone on every size; nothing drawn with every field off. The encoder and the file's assembly are P483's stream (the same pixels -> the same JPEG bytes on either route: JpegExifStreamTest; jpegli itself does not load on the host), so equal pixels and an equal record give the equal file.
- Unproven (phone): the read / write mapping on Adreno / Mali / PowerVR (refused -> the bitmap route, logged «no read / write mapping»; whether it changes the readback's time is in «final output ms»); that a bitmap's untouched pages stay unbacked on every Android allocator (if not, the cost is the bitmap route's memory, not more); the phone's Skia against the host's is not compared - not needed for the identity (both routes use the phone's own, with the same calls), only for the test's 2-pixel finding.
- Expected (estimate from the logs, not measured): at 12 MP with the watermark on, save 183 - 217 -> ~10 - 20 ms and the final output's copy into a bitmap gone (-60 .. -100 ms; the jpegli encode moves into «final output ms» as before P628), ~0.25 s a shot; 48 - 64 MB less at the shot's peak.
- Finding 8 of P638 («Режим обработки» read when the shot is processed, not at the shutter) - not done here: the mode is read through PreferenceKeys.processingMode / fastProcessing / staticProcessing / staticTuning by the burst's route, its tuning, the worker's timeout and the capture plan (HybridPlan.staticMode at the shutter already); a per-shot value has to be carried through all of them - not a few lines.
- Checks: StreamMarksTest (new, in the workflow list), JpegStreamRouteTest (+ marksStreamUnlessSwitchedOff), PhotoOutputWatermarkTest (+ theStreamedJpegGetsItsRecord: the file = the bitmap route's append), MergeStampTest, the Watermark*Test classes, JpegExifStreamTest, ExifBesideTest, PhotoThumbnailTest, DevKeysCoverageTest, WorkflowTestListTest; check_ui_language, check_settings_model.
- Next phone log (12 MP, watermark on): «streamed JPEG marks (P642): watermark drawn into the rows in N ms», «watermark drawn into the streamed JPEG's rows through a window of WxH px», «final output ms: path=pbo -> jpeg (no bitmap)», «JPEG streamed saved in N ms», «watermark record N bytes appended», SHOT SUMMARY save=; or «no read / write mapping» / «streamed JPEG not taken (...)» when it fell back. In the gallery: «Знак» -> remove / change on such a photo.

## P643 - «Oldstyle»: the capture is the photo mode's, the tone stays 2.7 / 3.1; P643b - the viewfinder's preview of the tone redone (owner, 2026-11-12)
Owner: «Для Oldstyle убери своей AE, используй такой же как и у режима фото»; «Тонмапинг должен оставаться от 2.7/3.1»; two screenshots of one office - «Вот такой сейчас у нас видоискатель, он сломан, нужно исправить». DONE in code, host (unit, Robolectric, the shipped shader on llvmpipe, the module through the host JNI); not seen on a phone.
- Capture (P643). The mode's own capture is gone: CaptureController has no branch for it at the shot (no metering of the ring's frame for an exposure, no burst after the shutter, no cleared ring), HybridPlan.oldstyle with its shutter cap / burst length / flicker factorisation is deleted, ShotLook.Oldstyle carries no exposure plan. An Oldstyle shot takes the photo mode's path as it is - the ring at the viewfinder's AE exposure, HybridPlan.build / manualLong / buildNormalBack / flash / zslOnly, EV compensation, ETTR, the manual row, sizes, tripod. What the mode still sets is decided where the photo mode decides it: no ultrashort and no long frames (HybridPlan.oneExposure beside «Спорт» and the HDR tile; PreferenceKeys.noHdrFrames for the worker's tuning and the frame counts) and the frame count when «Кадров в серии» is set (PreferenceKeys.getHybridZslFrames, within the photo mode's 4 .. 65; 0: the photo mode's).
- Brackets row: NOT added. The capture side is one switch, but the tone on a merge with short frames needs the merge's real clip level in its meter (the ceiling it is given is WhyV2Stats.MAX_CEILING, not where the merged data clips) to keep a burnt area where the module puts white - not checked, so not a small safe change. An Oldstyle series is one exposure, as the owner fixed in P630e.
- Tone (unchanged: the owner's module byte for byte for a given frame and gains - tools/check_tone_port.py 318 PASS without an edit, the module's regression in it). OldstyleAe.plan(rgb, w, h, params, ceiling) is the one plan: metered on the frame it is given, plan27 / plan31 / fusion_gains with the frame's TET (1, or V2's input scale) as the actual short TET. The capture plan (OldstyleAe.Capture, capture(), viewfinderGains*, ispGain, the "before a shot" step of the meter) is deleted.
- What differs now that frames come at the photo mode's exposure, exactly: (1) the frame is no longer exposed at S or at the SDR TET, so the gains are digital - S / 1 and L / 1 instead of ~1 and L / S; the tone's brightness decision is the same, the noise is that of the photo mode's exposure. (2) A light clipped in the frame cannot be exposed shorter. Our meter (the supplement leaves the estimator to us) keeps such a light where the frame has it: from 0.98 of the ceiling S* goes from 0.95 / light up to the frame's own TET at 0.995 (so fusion_gains gives the short gain base ^ (L / S) x S, what a burst exposed at S got), and from 0.90 an L* under S* comes up to S* in the log domain (without HDR no gain under 1 on a clipped frame: a clipped white is not turned grey). An unclipped frame (light under 0.90 of white; the 15 control scenes go up to 0.9775 for S*, 0.88 for the L* rule's scenes) is metered bit for bit as before. On the host the module's picture of a burnt window is 255 with HDR (V1 gS 0.937, V2 gS 0.945) and of a burnt lamp on a bright wall 255 without it (gain 1.000). The three defects on the host with the shipped shader of a425aa73, the owner's «Фото» frame as the ISP frame and a RAW modelled from it (scratchpad out_oldstyle/vf_before_*.png): with an ISP that lifts shadows V1's plan is SDR at gain 6 - 48 % of the frame burnt (the desk); the saturation of dark neutrals 0.35 -> 0.6 .. 0.7 in every model (the violet ceiling: the per-channel curve at the gains on the linearised ISP frame); patches on the walls where the per-pixel blend's weight (16 taps for the module's pyramid) switched exposures. Our estimator (the supplement leaves the per-frame AE estimator external) adapts in one place: S* of a light clipped in the frame (from 0.98 to 0.995 of white) goes from 0.95 / light up to the frame's own TET (1) - it cannot ask for a shorter exposure than the frame it has; the rules take that S* as any. P643's floor of L* under S* is reverted (it changed the estimator's L* for a rule-free reason). One reading of the supplement changed: without HDR the frame is the one exposure at the AE's TET - «Значения S* и L* при SDR служат для диагностики решения» - so the SDR gain is 1 (x the style's and the mode's EV), not L* / S0 (P630e's glue when the burst was exposed by the mode's own plan). HDR's gains stay the estimator's TETs over the frame's (fusion_gains, S0 = 1). «HDR» Выкл: the frame as it is. Hints and greying of the meter's rows follow (they decide HDR and its gains only).
