The viewfinder is unchanged. The YUV ring holds 4 Images in the «after the shutter» capture (12 / 24 MB each; it only meters), frames + 2 in the ZSL capture.
- Shot («YUV: кадры серии» = «После спуска», default): the ring is not used; YuvMergePlan (capture) from the viewfinder's metered exposure: N frames (6, «YUV: кадров в серии» 2-12), 2 ES at -3 EV where the newest ring frame's Y clips (>= 0.2 % of Y >= 250; the gain lowered first, then the shutter; skipped above x0.6 at the sensor floor), 1 L at +2 EV where its shadows are deep (>= 8 % of Y <= 24; the gain first, the shutter up to 66 ms; skipped under x1.4), cut to 288 MB of packed frames (8 MP: 16 frames at 8 bits, 12 at P010). The series' requests: the preview's keys, then TONEMAP_MODE_CONTRAST_CURVE with 64 points of the sRGB curve (8 bits; HLG10 needs none), NOISE_REDUCTION_MODE MINIMAL (OFF where MINIMAL is not listed), EDGE_MODE OFF; the series is not drawn on the viewfinder (its curve would flash there). «Из буфера ZSL»: the ring's frames at the camera's curve, no bracket (zslOnly). Sport strips the brackets (HybridPlan).
- Frames: post-shutter YUV / P010 Images (SaverImplementation.getFrame -> processing/yuv/YuvFrames) and ring frames (CaptureController.drainZslNormalFrames: ImageFrame.yuvPacker, RingFrame.image) are packed planar into one native buffer (YuvMergeNative.pack: Y, U, V; P010 >> 6 to 10-bit samples). YUVSaver keeps them as RAW16Saver keeps RAWs.
- Processing (ScamProcessor, yuvShot): the same steps as a RAW shot minus the RAW ones (no RAW crop / bin / sharpness / black floor / mosaic neutral / Sabre crop / lab / DNG: «DNG: none for a YUV shot»), then processing/yuv/YuvBurst instead of the worker: the native merge (library scameraYuv, app/src/main/cpp/scam-yuv-merge.h + scam-yuv-jni.cpp) to linear RGB float (1 = the normal exposure's white, the bracket's highlights above), the colour route YUV_ISP (white point 1, identity matrices, no lens shading map: the frames carry the camera's balance and CCM), the post pipeline's noise model fitted from the merge's measured noise in linear light (variance S x + O of one frame, divided by the merged count as for a RAW shot), and the merge's per-pixel frame count as the denoise's effective-frame map (code 64 = the median count). Then PostPipeline as for a RAW shot: our denoise, «Why тон» V1 / V2 or Oldstyle, colour look, sharpening. A merge that throws gives the reference frame alone (decoded to linear light), logged «YUV MERGE failed (...): the reference frame alone».
- The merge (scam-yuv-merge.h, C++17, our naming): (1) the port of the owner's 2.7 / 3.1 YUV merge (32 x 32 tiles, YUV444 tiles from YUV420, 16 block thresholds from the noise LUT in the document's index layout 32 x 16 x 16, the colour and luma tile checks with their soft limits, the per-pixel |Y - Ybase| acceptance with the profile's order of the two FP32 products, dithered division, eligible / countPacked), generalised to 16-bit samples; (2) ours: the working area of whole tiles (3264 x 2448 -> 3264 x 2432, the 16 rows outside from the base), the pyramid global shift plus per-tile candidates (none, the projections' estimate, the left and upper neighbour) verified by Y SAD and refined by +-1 steps (bracket frames aligned on their Y remapped to the base exposure through the curve), the sharpest normal frame as the base, the noise LUT measured on the burst (below), guided chroma upsampling, the linear decode (JFIF BT.601 for 8-bit; BT.2020 narrow for HLG P010, full range detected by the frame's Y extremes, HLG's reference white (75 % of the signal, 0.265 of its peak) scaled to 1; the capture's 64 points inverted exactly, sRGB as the estimate of the camera's curve), the linearity check and the bracket fusion (below).
- Our noise LUT (a): for each normal donor after alignment, every 8 x 8 block of every tile where the base's own spread is 0.5 - 1.6 x half the base-donor difference variance (texture / motion / misalignment make them part) and nothing clips; per 8-bit level bin (8 levels) the median half-variance of >= 12 blocks (/0.9895, the chi-square median at 63 dof), >= 4 bins = measured; gaps: the camera's NOISE_PROFILE through the capture curve x the median measured / model ratio, or the measured neighbours interpolated; [1 2 1] smoothing; Y only (every U / V bin of a Y bin holds its sigma). The Nexus 5 / 6 tables of the archive are not used, not in the repo, not in the APK (they were read only in the scratch directory to run the archive's verify.cpp against its own header).
- Bracket (c, d): the frames' light against the base's (median of per-pixel luminance ratios over mid-range samples where both are unclipped) must be within x0.8 - x1.25 of the frame's exposure ratio, else that frame is left out («some frames failed the linearity check» / «the frames' light does not follow their exposure»); frames whose results do not report CONTRAST_CURVE are taken at the camera's curve with the bracket off («the frames report tonemap mode ..., not our curve»). Not done: inverting the camera's curve measured from the bracket (the fallback is: brackets off). ES: only where the merged base nears its clip (smoothstep 0.80 - 0.97 of its largest channel); in the transition it must agree with the base within deghost x sigma (+5 %), where the base is clipped it must be at least 0.9 of the base's light (an object darker than the clip that moved in is not taken); several ES frames averaged; the result never below the clipped base. L: only where it is well under its own clip (fade 0.6 - 0.9) and the base is not near clip, weighted by its exposure ratio (shot noise) with a soft agreement to the base (within 1 - 2 x deghost x sigma of both).
- Measured on the host (tools/check_yuv_merge.cpp, CI lane host-native-a, ASAN + UBSAN, ~85 s):
  - equivalence: every stage (tile extraction and colour means, the 16 thresholds and the tile threshold with nearClip, projections and their shift, both forgiveness bands, the luma metric, the smoothed donor, colour limit, attenuation) and the whole prepared frame on 60 random bursts (both profiles, UV / VU, exact / Q15 division, 1 - 16 frames, disabled donors, random placements and scales) are byte-for-byte the reference's; the document's profile case gives Y 80 / 93 and countPacked 0x11 / 0x22. 16-bit: the same accepted pixels as the 8-bit merge of the picture x 4, output within 3 codes of 4 x the 8-bit one.
  - alignment: shifts (0,0) .. (24,-22) found exactly, 48 / 48 interior tiles without residual; a 64 x 64 block moved by (5,-3) found by its tile.
  - our LUT: 11 of 32 bins measured from a 6-frame burst, mean |error| 8.4 % of the true sigma (sigma = 0.9 + 0.018 Y). Merge of 6 frames with a small object that came in (12 x 12 px, +14 codes): one frame 37.10 dB / 2.64 codes in the object; our LUT 43.14 dB / 4.58; a fixed sigma 0.6 table 37.18 dB / 2.64 (merges nothing); a fixed sigma 8 table 43.53 dB / 8.55 (ghosts) - ours is the balance (static noise -6 dB, half the ghost of the high table).
  - profiles 2.7 and 3.1 on the same burst: identical (43.141 dB both; they differ only where a tile's scale was lowered, by one level of rounding). Default 3.1.
  - sharpest base: the one unblurred frame of 4 chosen. Guided chroma on a colour edge at odd pixels: R'G'B' PSNR 21.17 dB nearest -> 46.63 dB.
  - bracket on a synthetic HDR scene (window to 6x the white, deep shadow 0.6 %; 4 N, 2 ES at 1/8 with a dark object moving through the window, 1 L at x4 with an object in the mid tones; shot + read noise in linear light, the capture curve's 64 points, 8-bit JFIF 4:2:0): highlights back within 2.4 % median of the truth (clipped at 1 without the bracket), 0.00 % of the ES object's pixels darker than the clipped base, the L object's area unchanged (0.00 %), mid tones the L frame clips changed by 0.00001 on average (noise there ~0.014), deep-shadow RMS error x1.48 lower; linearity x0.996 / 0.999 / 1.003; frames encoded with another curve than the one decoded: linearity x0.38 / x1.38, bracket refused.
  - 10-bit HLG P010 (BT.2020 narrow and full range): linear luminance within 1.0 % / 0.9 % median, the full-range stream found by its Y extremes.
  - speed (host, 4 cores, 3264 x 2448, 6 N + 2 ES + 1 L, 8-bit): ~1.5 - 1.8 s with 4 threads, ~3 s with one. On the phone: unknown.
- Unit tests: YuvMergeSettingsTest (the default only on the X200 Pro's camera 1, the stored switch per module, the whole group walked from preferences.xml with the route on and off - every row classified, the YUV rows' own dependencies, a module switch flips the greying), YuvMergePlanTest (N only without clip / shadows, 2 ES gain first, 1 L within 66 ms, no bracket at the camera's curve or switched off, the memory budget at P010, the camera's AE without an exposure, the capture curve, the series' controls on a real builder). SettingsMenuTest's group and lens-page orders take the new rows. check_ui_language, check_settings_model PASS.
- Settings: «Шумоподавление и склейка» › «Склейка YUV» (pref_scam_hybrid_yuv_*: capture after / zsl, frames, 10 bit, profile 3.1 / 2.7, threshold scale, global search, tile search, tile colour check, noise from the series, sharpest base, colour by brightness, brackets, ES EV, L EV, ghost protection; all read by the capture plan or the merge). Greying (SettingsAvailability.yuvReason, the fact from DeviceAvailability: the current module's lens route, read at every refresh of the page): route off -> the YUV rows and group «Только при «Склейке YUV»»; route on -> the RAW merges' rows and groups «Не действует при «Склейке YUV»»: «Кадров в склейке», 50 / 200 MP frames and ZSL, the «Спорт» page, alignment, rejection, kernel (its footprints too), Quad / Tetra, the final pass (SettingsAvailability.RAW_MERGE_ONLY + QUALITY_ONLY + mm_ / mosaic_ rows; P644 removed «Статика» before the merge). Rows the YUV route reads stay open: «Все шумодавы» and its rows (luma / motion revert, grain), the resolve's speckle filter, the pyramid denoise (general / luma / chroma), «Буфер ZSL» (the ring of the ZSL capture). Inside the YUV group: brackets need «После спуска», ES / L / ghost protection need the brackets.
- Files other agents may touch: CaptureController (UpdateCameraCharacteristics' route decision and sDemotedFrom for P010, the HLG10 output, retryConfigureFallback's P010 step, zslRingCapacity, captureStillPicture's yuvAfter / yuvRing branches and controls, drainZslNormalFrames), ScamProcessor (yuvShot guards), HybridPlan.of, ImageFrame / RingFrame / SaverImplementation / YUVSaver, SettingsAvailability / DeviceAvailability / SettingsNumericRules / SensorConfigPreferenceGenerator / DevKeys (yuv_merge), preferences.xml (the category after the frames group), SettingsMenuTest, CMakeLists (scameraYuv), the workflow (two test classes, the libscameraYuv.so check), tools/ci/host-native-a.sh.
- Provenance: tools/yuv-merge-ref/yuv_burst_merge.hpp is the owner's reference header, unchanged, used by the host check only (not built into the app); no calibration table of another phone is in the repo or the APK.
- Not done / unproven: sub-pixel alignment (integer shifts, as the document's merge); the camera's curve measured from the bracket (fallback: brackets off); a DNG of a YUV shot (none); the HAL honouring CONTRAST_CURVE / MINIMAL / EDGE OFF on the MediaTek front camera, HLG10 beside the STANDARD viewfinder, the P010 plane layout, JFIF full-range YUV, the timing and memory on the phone, the photo's look - all wait for the phone.

ES pixels ... decode ...», «YUV MERGE result: ...», «colour: YUV_ISP», and any of «the P010 session did not configure», «the frames report tonemap mode», «YUV MERGE failed»; the photo itself.
